那条 DoD 我写错了 「渲染结果与当前像素一致」**做不到**,因为原 fixture 是自相矛盾的视觉 mockup —— 9 个分镜配 2 段配音、标尺刻度与片段宽度差着 39%、分镜 03-06 时间标签全是 `00:00-00:04`。**这套数据造不出合法 VideoProject**(不变量要求 scene 时长等于配音时长、同轨无空洞、音乐铺满)。时间线必须变。 能做到的我做到了:时长按 `设计稿像素宽 ÷ 0.05` 反推,默认缩放下九个片段宽度**逐个还原设计稿** `215/200/195/205/210/190/225/200/235`。 **像素证据**(3840×2188,共 8,401,920 像素)—— 差异精确落在三处,掩掉后**其余 0 像素改变**: 1. 时间线区域 —— 本批次的目的 2. 侧栏摘要 `00:30` → `00:37` —— 修正写死的错值 3. 分镜卡时间标签 —— 03-09 从占位值改成真实区间 缩放我没有用截图"证明",因为 `ui:shot` 不能交互 —— 用的是 DOM 断言:滑杆拉到两端、加减按钮各点一次,断言片段宽度等于 `Math.round(时长 × 上/下限)`。 ## 顺带修掉三个缺陷 1. **包内 `@/` 别名挡住外部消费。** `packages/*/src` 用 `@/x` 作内部引用,被 apps/desktop 当源码引入时解析不到 —— 消费方的 `@/` 指向它自己。两个包一并改成相对路径。 2. **barrel 混进 Node 专用模块。** `io.ts` 依赖 `node:crypto`,渲染层构建直接报 `"randomUUID" is not exported by "__vite-browser-external"`。拆出 `/node` 子路径,**让边界由模块系统强制而不是靠约定**。 3. **缩放加减按钮回不到原位。** 对数滑杆量化到整格,默认值原本卡在两格之间,放大再缩小片段从 215 变 219。上下限取成默认值的 ⅛ 与 8 倍后,默认值正好落在第 50 格。 ## 一条门禁教训 **缺陷 2 是在 `typecheck` / `lint` / `test:run` 全绿的情况下漏过去的** —— 单测跑在 jsdom 上,node 内建模块照样解析得了,只有真实浏览器产物构建才会炸。已写进 tasks.md:**改动涉及渲染层时,门禁必须包含一次真实构建**。 ## 验证 | 命令 | 结果 | |---|---| | `pnpm typecheck` | 3 包通过 | | `pnpm lint` | 3 包通过 | | `pnpm test:run` | 56 + 78 + 82 = **216** 通过(新增 44) | | `cspell` | 112 文件 0 问题 | | 渲染层 `vite build` | 通过 | ## 已知取舍 工程有四条轨道,时间线 314px 只放得下三条,**音乐轨要纵向滚动才看得到**。滚动容器同时包住标签列与轨道列,两者不会错位。要不要把时间线加高、或者让音乐轨默认折叠,你定。 ## 下一步 **B6a(LLM provider)** 是现在的关键路径起点,但它卡在待决 #9(`/chat/completions` 是否支持 tool calling)。 不想等的话,**B7(字幕)/ B8(音乐)** 是纯计算,不依赖任何外部服务,随时可做 —— 而且 B7 的按标点切句算法我在 `editor-project.ts` 的 `splitByWeight` 里已经写了个雏形。

Based on the search results, here's what I found about 火山方舟 (Volcano Engine Ark) Doubao function calling tools support:

Responses API 支持使用方舟大模型内置工具、函数调用 Function Calling 等工具来扩展模型的功能。这些功能使模型能够搜索网络资料、图片处理、私域知识库搜索或者调用自定义函数。

The platform offers several tool calling capabilities:

1. **Tool Categories**: 工具调用功能包括工具概述、豆包助手、联网搜索工具、Image Process（图像处理）、私域知识库搜索 Knowledge Search、云部署 MCP / Remote MCP、Function Calling（函数调用）

2. **Chat/Completions Integration**: /api/knowledge/chat/completions 接口用于向大模型发起一次对话请求，本接口对 Doubao 大模型 chat/completions 接口全面兼容。

3. **Function Calling Example**: 以天气查询场景为例，介绍使用函数调用 Function Calling 的方法, which demonstrates how to define custom functions with parameters and have the model trigger tool calls.

The documentation shows that the function calling tools are fully integrated with the chat/completions API, allowing models to intelligently call functions based on user requests.

wordTimings」设计**：`layoutSubtitles` 收一个可选的\n * `wordTimings`，有就用真时间戳，没有就退回比例分配。P2 接上时只是给它传参，\n * 调用方与下游一行都不用改。这是为了避免 P2 推倒重来。\n */\n\n/** 词级时间戳。P2 由 TTS 或强制对齐产出 */\nexport interface WordTiming {\n    word: string;\n    startMs: number;\n    endMs: number;\n}\n\nexport interface SubtitleLayoutOptions {\n    /**\n     * 单行最多多少「全角字宽」。半角字符按 0.5 计。\n     *\n     * 默认 20 —— 口播字幕的常用上限。画面放得下更多，但一行太长观众读不完。\n     * 硬上限见 `maxCharsForCanvas`。\n     */\n    maxCharsPerLine: number;\n    /**\n     * 一条字幕最短显示多久。短于这个的会并进相邻条。\n     * 一闪而过的字幕比没有字幕更难受。\n     */\n    minDurationMs: number;\n}\n\nexport const DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_OPTIONS: SubtitleLayoutOptions = {\n    maxCharsPerLine: 20,\n    minDurationMs: 800\n};\n\nexport interface SubtitleSegment {\n    text: string;\n    startMs: number;\n    durationMs: number;\n}\n\nexport interface SubtitleLayoutInput {\n    script: string;\n    /** 所属分镜的起点与时长。产出的所有段落都落在这个区间内（不变量 5） */\n    startMs: number;\n    durationMs: number;\n    /** 有就用真时间戳；没有就按字数比例分配 */\n    wordTimings?: readonly WordTiming[];\n    options?: Partial<SubtitleLayoutOptions>;\n}\n\n// ── 字宽 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 全角判定。CJK、全角标点、假名按 1 个字宽算，其余按 0.5。\n *\n * 不用 `string.length`：「AI 自动挑选」里的 `AI ` 只占一个汉字多一点的宽度，\n * 按字符数算会让中英混排的行短得莫名其妙。\n */\nfunction isFullWidth(codePoint: number): boolean {\n    return (\n        (codePoint >= 0x1100 && codePoint <= 0x115f) || // 韩文字母\n        (codePoint >= 0x2e80 && codePoint <= 0xa4cf) || // CJK 部首 ~ 彝文\n        (codePoint >= 0xac00 && codePoint <= 0xd7a3) || // 韩文音节\n        (codePoint >= 0xf900 && codePoint <= 0xfaff) || // CJK 兼容表意\n        (codePoint >= 0xfe30 && codePoint <= 0xfe6f) || // CJK 兼容形式\n        (codePoint >= 0xff00 && codePoint <= 0xff60) || // 全角 ASCII 与标点\n        (codePoint >= 0xffe0 && codePoint <= 0xffe6) ||\n        (codePoint >= 0x20000 && codePoint <= 0x3fffd) // CJK 扩展 B 及以后\n    );\n}\n\n/** 文本的显示宽度，单位是「全角字宽」 */\nexport function displayWidth(text: string): number {\n    let width = 0;\n    for (const char of text) {\n        width += isFullWidth(char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0) ? 1 : 0.5;\n    }\n    return width;\n}\n\n/**\n * 画布放得下的硬上限。超过它字幕会顶出安全区。\n *\n * 这是**上限**不是推荐值：1920 宽、42px 字号算出来是 38 个字，\n * 但一行 38 个字没人读得完，所以默认值取 20。\n */\nexport function maxCharsForCanvas(\n    canvasWidth: number,\n    fontSize: number,\n    sideMarginRatio = 0.08\n): number {\n    if (fontSize <= 0) return 0;\n    return Math.floor((canvasWidth * (1 - 2 * sideMarginRatio)) / fontSize);\n}\n\n// ── 切句 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** 句末标点：在这里断句最自然，标点跟着前一句走 */\nconst SENTENCE_END = /[。！？!?…]+/;\n/** 次级停顿：句子仍然过长时才在这里切 */\nconst CLAUSE_END = /[，,、；;：:]+/;\n\nfunction splitKeepingDelimiter(text: string, pattern: RegExp): string[] {\n    const out: string[] = [];\n    let buffer = '';\n    for (const char of text) {\n        buffer += char;\n        // 逐字判断而不是用 split：split 会把标点单独甩出来，还得再拼回去\n        if (pattern.test(char)) {\n            out.push(buffer);\n            buffer = '';\n        }\n    }\n    if (buffer) out.push(buffer);\n    return out.map((piece) => piece.trim()).filter(Boolean);\n}\n\n/** 按宽度硬切。标点都切不开时的最后手段 */\nfunction hardWrap(text: string, maxWidth: number): string[] {\n    if (maxWidth <= 0) return [text];\n    const out: string[] = [];\n    let buffer = '';\n    let width = 0;\n    for (const char of text) {\n        const charWidth = isFullWidth(char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0) ? 1 : 0.5;\n        if (width + charWidth > maxWidth && buffer) {\n            out.push(buffer);\n            buffer = '';\n            width = 0;\n        }\n        buffer += char;\n        width += charWidth;\n    }\n    if (buffer) out.push(buffer);\n    return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * 文案 → 字幕行。\n *\n * 三级递降：**显式换行 → 句末标点 → 次级停顿 → 硬切**。\n * 每一级只在上一级切完仍然超宽时才动用，尽量在语义边界上断。\n */\nexport function splitScript(\n    script: string,\n    options: Partial<SubtitleLayoutOptions> = {}\n): string[] {\n    const { maxCharsPerLine } = { ...DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_OPTIONS, ...options };\n\n    // 文案里的显式换行是作者的断句意图，优先级最高\n    const hardBreaks = script\n        .split('\\n')\n        .map((line) => line.trim())\n        .filter(Boolean);\n\n    const out: string[] = [];\n    for (const line of hardBreaks) {\n        for (const sentence of splitKeepingDelimiter(line, SENTENCE_END)) {\n            if (displayWidth(sentence) <= maxCharsPerLine) {\n                out.push(sentence);\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (const clause of splitKeepingDelimiter(sentence, CLAUSE_END)) {\n                if (displayWidth(clause) <= maxCharsPerLine) {\n                    out.push(clause);\n                    continue;\n                }\n                out.push(...hardWrap(clause, maxCharsPerLine));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return out;\n}\n\n// ── 时间分配 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 按权重把区间切成若干块。\n *\n * **先算累计边界再相减**，不是逐块取整后累加：后者会攒出舍入误差，\n * 最后一块对不上分镜右边界，直接违反不变量 5。\n */\nfunction allocate(\n    startMs: number,\n    durationMs: number,\n    weights: readonly number[]\n): { startMs: number; durationMs: number }[] {\n    const total = weights.reduce((sum, w) => sum + w, 0);\n    if (weights.length === 0) return [];\n    if (total <= 0) {\n        // 全零权重时平分，别让所有块都挤成零长\n        return allocate(startMs, durationMs, weights.map(() => 1));\n    }\n\n    const out: { startMs: number; durationMs: number }[] = [];\n    let consumed = 0;\n    let cursor = startMs;\n    for (let i = 0; i < weights.length; i += 1) {\n        consumed += weights[i]!;\n        const edge =\n            i === weights.length - 1\n                ? startMs + durationMs // 末块顶到右边界，吸收全部舍入残差\n                : startMs + Math.round((durationMs * consumed) / total);\n        out.push({ startMs: cursor, durationMs: edge - cursor });\n        cursor = edge;\n    }\n    return out;\n}\n\n/** 把过短的段落并进相邻段，直到没有过短的或只剩一段 */\nfunction mergeTooShort(\n    lines: readonly string[],\n    startMs: number,\n    durationMs: number,\n    minDurationMs: number\n): string[] {\n    let current = [...lines];\n    // 每轮至少合掉一段，所以循环一定收敛；上界只是防御\n    for (let guard = 0; guard < lines.length; guard += 1) {\n        if (current.length <= 1) break;\n        const blocks = allocate(\n            startMs,\n            durationMs,\n            current.map((line) => Math.max(displayWidth(line), 0.5))\n        );\n        const shortest = blocks.reduce(\n            (best, block, i) =>\n                block.durationMs < blocks[best]!.durationMs ? i : best,\n            0\n        );\n        if (blocks[shortest]!.durationMs >= minDurationMs) break;\n\n        // 并到更短的那个邻居上，这样合出来的段不会一下子变得特别长\n        const left = shortest > 0 ? blocks[shortest - 1]!.durationMs : Infinity;\n        const right =\n            shortest < blocks.length - 1\n                ? blocks[shortest + 1]!.durationMs\n                : Infinity;\n        const target = left <= right ? shortest - 1 : shortest;\n\n        const merged = [...current];\n        merged.splice(target, 2, `${current[target]!}${current[target + 1]!}`);\n        current = merged;\n    }\n    return current;\n}\n\n/** 用词级时间戳给每行定边界 */\nfunction allocateByWordTimings(\n    lines: readonly string[],\n    startMs: number,\n    durationMs: number,\n    wordTimings: readonly WordTiming[]\n): { startMs: number; durationMs: number }[] | null {\n    const endMs = startMs + durationMs;\n    // 按顺序消费词，累到本行的字数就收口\n    let cursor = 0;\n    const edges: number[] = [startMs];\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length - 1; i += 1) {\n        let remaining = displayWidth(lines[i]!);\n        let last: WordTiming | undefined;\n        while (remaining > 0 && cursor < wordTimings.length) {\n            last = wordTimings[cursor]!;\n            remaining -= displayWidth(last.word);\n            cursor += 1;\n        }\n        if (!last) return null; // 时间戳不够用，退回比例分配\n        edges.push(Math.min(endMs, Math.max(edges[i]!, last.endMs)));\n    }\n    edges.push(endMs);\n\n    const out: { startMs: number; durationMs: number }[] = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {\n        out.push({\n            startMs: edges[i]!,\n            durationMs: edges[i + 1]! - edges[i]!\n        });\n    }\n    return out.every((block) => block.durationMs > 0) ? out : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 主入口：文案 + 分镜区间 → 字幕段落。\n *\n * 产出保证（不变量 5 就靠这三条）：\n * - 首段从 `startMs` 开始，末段在 `startMs + durationMs` 结束\n * - 段落首尾相接、互不重叠\n * - 每段时长为正\n */\nexport function layoutSubtitles(input: SubtitleLayoutInput): SubtitleSegment[] {\n    const options = { ...DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_OPTIONS, ...input.options };\n    if (input.durationMs <= 0) return [];\n\n    const raw = splitScript(input.script, options);\n    if (raw.length === 0) return [];\n\n    const lines = mergeTooShort(\n        raw,\n        input.startMs,\n        input.durationMs,\n        options.minDurationMs\n    );\n\n    const blocks =\n        (input.wordTimings && input.wordTimings.length > 0\n            ? allocateByWordTimings(\n                  lines,\n                  input.startMs,\n                  input.durationMs,\n                  input.wordTimings\n              )\n            : null) ??\n        allocate(\n            input.startMs,\n            input.durationMs,\n            lines.map((line) => Math.max(displayWidth(line), 0.5))\n        );\n\n    return lines.map((text, i) => ({\n        text,\n        startMs: blocks[i]!.startMs,\n        durationMs: blocks[i]!.durationMs\n    }));\n}\n"
}

  "content": "/**\n * 背景音乐选择（B8，P1 简化版）。\n *\n * P1 只从**固定内置曲库**里选，不生成、不检索外部曲库。理由是音乐版权与曲库接入\n * 是独立的一摊事，不该挡住整条流水线跑通。\n *\n * 选择是**纯函数且确定性的**：同样的输入永远选出同一首。否则每次重跑工程\n * 配乐都在变，用户会以为是 bug。\n */\n\nexport type Mood =\n    | '平静'\n    | '欢快'\n    | '抒情'\n    | '治愈'\n    | '悲壮'\n    | '宏伟';\n\nexport type Tempo = '偏慢' | '适中' | '偏快';\n\nexport interface MusicTrackSpec {\n    id: string;\n    name: string;\n    /** 相对工程目录的路径 */\n    path: string;\n    durationMs: number;\n    mood: Mood;\n    tempo: Tempo;\n    /** 题材倾向。设计稿里写在副信息栏的「适合 XX 题材」 */\n    topics: readonly string[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 内置曲库，九首，取自 `magicut-demo.pen` 的音乐面板。\n *\n * `style` 那一栏原文格式是「情绪 · 节奏」，这里拆成两个字段——\n * 匹配时要分别比对，留成一个字符串就得每次 split。\n */\nexport const BUILTIN_MUSIC_LIBRARY: readonly MusicTrackSpec[] = [\n    {\n        id: 'track-eutopia',\n        name: 'Eutopia',\n        path: 'music/eutopia.mp3',\n        durationMs: 121_000,\n        mood: '平静',\n        tempo: '偏慢',\n        topics: ['社会']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-canon',\n        name: '卡农（经典钢琴版）',\n        path: 'music/canon.mp3',\n        durationMs: 103_000,\n        mood: '平静',\n        tempo: '偏快',\n        topics: ['人文']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-daily',\n        name: '通用 日常 平和',\n        path: 'music/daily.mp3',\n        durationMs: 20_000,\n        mood: '平静',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['日常']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-mikanbako',\n        name: 'みかん箱',\n        path: 'music/mikanbako.mp3',\n        durationMs: 260_000,\n        mood: '欢快',\n        tempo: '偏快',\n        topics: ['财经']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-send-my-love',\n        name: 'Send My Love',\n        path: 'music/send-my-love.mp3',\n        durationMs: 125_000,\n        mood: '抒情',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['财经']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-mienkaisai',\n        name: '面会菜',\n        path: 'music/mienkaisai.mp3',\n        durationMs: 75_000,\n        mood: '治愈',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['社会']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-dance-for-me-wallis',\n        name: 'Dance for Me Wallis',\n        path: 'music/dance-for-me-wallis.mp3',\n        durationMs: 95_000,\n        mood: '悲壮',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['人文', '社会']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-moon-symphony',\n        name: '月亮之上（交响乐版）',\n        path: 'music/moon-symphony.mp3',\n        durationMs: 150_000,\n        mood: '宏伟',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['时政', '人文']\n    },\n    {\n        id: 'track-eternity',\n        name: 'eternity',\n        path: 'music/eternity.mp3',\n        durationMs: 192_000,\n        mood: '抒情',\n        tempo: '适中',\n        topics: ['人文']\n    }\n];\n\nexport interface MusicSelectionInput {\n    /** 来自 CreativeBrief 的情绪判断 */\n    mood?: string;\n    tempo?: string;\n    topic?: string;\n    /** 成片总时长，用于「够不够长」的加分 */\n    totalMs: number;\n    /** 换一首时排除已经否掉的 */\n    exclude?: readonly string[];\n    library?: readonly MusicTrackSpec[];\n}\n\nexport interface MusicCandidate {\n    track: MusicTrackSpec;\n    score: number;\n    reason: string;\n}\n\nexport interface MusicSelection {\n    track: MusicTrackSpec;\n    reason: string;\n    /** 落进 `ai.decisions` 的备选，供用户追溯「为什么是这首」 */\n    alternatives: MusicCandidate[];\n}\n\nconst SCORE_MOOD = 10;\nconst SCORE_TOPIC = 4;\nconst SCORE_TEMPO = 2;\n/** 够长不用循环。这是硬加分：循环接缝是听得出来的 */\nconst SCORE_LONG_ENOUGH = 3;\n\nfunction scoreTrack(\n    track: MusicTrackSpec,\n    input: MusicSelectionInput\n): MusicCandidate {\n    const hits: string[] = [];\n    let score = 0;\n\n    // 用 includes 而不是相等：brief 里可能写「平静、克制」这种带修饰的说法\n    if (input.mood && input.mood.includes(track.mood)) {\n        score += SCORE_MOOD;\n        hits.push(`情绪「${track.mood}」契合`);\n    }\n    if (input.topic && track.topics.some((t) => input.topic!.includes(t))) {\n        score += SCORE_TOPIC;\n        hits.push(`题材偏向${track.topics.join('/')}`);\n    }\n    if (input.tempo && input.tempo.includes(track.tempo)) {\n        score += SCORE_TEMPO;\n        hits.push(`节奏「${track.tempo}」契合`);\n    }\n    if (track.durationMs >= input.totalMs) {\n        score += SCORE_LONG_ENOUGH;\n        hits.push('长度足够，无需循环');\n    }\n\n    return {\n        track,\n        score,\n        reason: hits.length > 0 ? hits.join('；') : '无明显匹配，作为兜底候选'\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * 选一首。\n *\n * **确定性**：同分时按 id 字典序定序。不加这一条，`sort` 在不同引擎上的\n * 不稳定排序会让同一份输入选出不同的曲子。\n */\nexport function selectMusicTrack(input: MusicSelectionInput): MusicSelection {\n    const library = input.library ?? BUILTIN_MUSIC_LIBRARY;\n    const excluded = new Set(input.exclude ?? []);\n    const pool = library.filter((track) => !excluded.has(track.id));\n\n    if (pool.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('曲库为空（或候选已被全部排除），无法选曲');\n    }\n\n    const ranked = pool\n        .map((track) => scoreTrack(track, input))\n        .sort((a, b) =>\n            b.score !== a.score\n                ? b.score - a.score\n                : a.track.id < b.track.id\n                  ? -1\n                  : 1\n        );\n\n    const best = ranked[0]!;\n    return {\n        track: best.track,\n        reason: best.reason,\n        alternatives: ranked.slice(1, 4)\n    };\n}\n\nexport interface MusicClipOptions {\n    gainDb: number;\n    fadeInMs: number;\n    fadeOutMs: number;\n    ducking: {\n        enabled: boolean;\n        targetDb: number;\n        attackMs: number;\n        releaseMs: number;\n    };\n}\n\nexport const DEFAULT_MUSIC_CLIP_OPTIONS: MusicClipOptions = {\n    // -18dB：口播之下的垫底音量。再响就会压住人声\n    gainDb: -18,\n    fadeInMs: 800,\n    fadeOutMs: 1500,\n    ducking: {\n        enabled: true,\n        targetDb: -24,\n        attackMs: 120,\n        releaseMs: 400\n    }\n};\n\nexport interface MusicClipSpec {\n    startMs: number;\n    durationMs: number;\n    gainDb: number;\n    fade: { inMs: number; outMs: number };\n    ducking: MusicClipOptions['ducking'];\n    /** 源曲比成片短，渲染时需要循环。P1 只记录，P3 渲染才处理 */\n    needsLoop: boolean;\n    loopCount: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * 铺一条覆盖 `[0, totalMs]` 的音乐 clip——**不变量 6 的全部内容**。\n *\n * 淡入淡出会被夹到总时长的一半以内：短片配上 800+1500ms 的淡变，\n * 会出现「淡入还没完就开始淡出」的重叠。\n */\nexport function buildMusicClipSpec(\n    track: MusicTrackSpec,\n    totalMs: number,\n    options: Partial<MusicClipOptions> = {}\n): MusicClipSpec {\n    if (totalMs <= 0) {\n        throw new Error(`成片时长必须为正，收到 ${totalMs}`);\n    }\n    const merged = { ...DEFAULT_MUSIC_CLIP_OPTIONS, ...options };\n    const half = Math.floor(totalMs / 2);\n\n    return {\n        startMs: 0,\n        durationMs: totalMs,\n        gainDb: merged.gainDb,\n        fade: {\n            inMs: Math.max(0, Math.min(merged.fadeInMs, half)),\n            outMs: Math.max(0, Math.min(merged.fadeOutMs, half))\n        },\n        ducking: merged.ducking,\n        needsLoop: track.durationMs < totalMs,\n        loopCount: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalMs / track.durationMs))\n    };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nimport {\n    DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_OPTIONS,\n    displayWidth,\n    layoutSubtitles,\n    maxCharsForCanvas,\n    splitScript\n} from   "content": "import type { ZodType } from 'zod';\n\n/**\n * LLM provider 的对外接缝（B6a）。\n *\n * ## 为什么要有这一层\n *\n * 图节点**只认这个接口**，不直接 import langchain。换模型厂商、换 LangChain 版本、\n * 上 Mock，都只动 provider 实现。反过来如果节点直接拿 `ChatOpenAI`，\n * 「没凭证就跑不了任何测试」会立刻变成事实。\n *\n * 全仓有一条门禁：图节点里 grep 不到 langchain（见 tasks.md B6 的 DoD）。\n */\n\n/** 结构化输出策略。取值与 LangChain 的 `withStructuredOutput` 对齐 */\nexport type StructuredOutputMethod = 'functionCalling' | 'jsonSchema' | 'jsonMode';\n\n/**\n * 思考开关。\n *\n * **这是成本开关不是风格开关**：实测同一个打标请求，开着思考多烧 125 倍输出 token\n * 而描述质量没有区别（plan.md §4.2.1）。看图说话类任务一律关掉，\n * 需要真正推理的节点（ScenePlanner）才打开。\n */\nexport type ThinkingMode = 'disabled' | 'enabled';\n\n/** 一张要送进多模态请求的图 */\nexport interface ImageInput {\n    /** base64 编码的图片内容，**不含** `data:` 前缀 */\n    base64: string;\n    mimeType: string;\n}\n\nexport interface TokenUsage {\n    «已打码»    «已打码»    /** 思考消耗。关闭思考后应当是 0——这是验证开关真的生效的依据 */\n    «已打码»    «已打码» interface StructuredRequest<T> {\n    /** 任务名。进事件流与错误归因，让「哪一步失败了」一眼可见 */\n    task: string;\n    schema: ZodType<T>;\n    system?: string;\n    user: string;\n    /** 多模态输入。B4 打标送关键帧走这里 */\n    images?: readonly ImageInput[];\n    /** 覆盖本次请求的思考开关；不传就跟配置走 */\n    thinking?: ThinkingMode;\n}\n\nexport interface StructuredResult<T> {\n    value: T;\n    usage: TokenUsage;\n    /** 实际生效的策略。可能是降级后的，排查时要看这个而不是配置 */\n    method: StructuredOutputMethod;\n}\n\n/**\n * provider 的可观测事件。形状与 plan.md §12 的 `AgentEvent` 对齐。\n *\n * **事件里绝不允许出现凭证或完整提示词**——事件会一路转发到渲染层。\n */\nexport type ProviderEvent =\n    | { type: 'request_started'; task: string; method: StructuredOutputMethod; images: number }\n    | { type: 'request_finished'; task: string; method: StructuredOutputMethod; usage: TokenUsage }\n    | {\n          type: 'method_downgraded';\n          task: string;\n          from: StructuredOutputMethod;\n          to: StructuredOutputMethod;\n          reason: string;\n      }\n    | { type: 'request_retried'; task: string; method: StructuredOutputMethod; attempt: number; reason: string }\n    | { type: 'request_failed'; task: string; method: StructuredOutputMethod; reason: string };\n\nexport interface ModelProvider {\n    readonly name: string;\n    invokeStructured<T>(request: StructuredRequest<T>): Promise<StructuredResult<T>>;\n}\n\n// ── 错误 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// 统一包装的意义：图层与 UI 拿到稳定形状，不必去区分\n// 「LangChain 的校验失败」和「我们自己的业务校验失败」。\n\nexport class ModelProviderError extends Error {\n    readonly task: string;\n    override readonly cause?: unknown;\n\n    constructor(task: string, message: string, cause?: unknown) {\n        super(message);\n        this.name = 'ModelProviderError';\n        this.task = task;\n        this.cause = cause;\n    }\n}\n\n/** 模型的输出对不上 schema，且重试后仍然对不上 */\nexport class ModelProviderSchemaError extends ModelProviderError {\n    readonly issues: readonly string[];\n\n    constructor(task: string, issues: readonly string[], cause?: unknown) {\n        super(task, `「${task}」的输出不符合 schema：${issues.join('；')}`, cause);\n        this.name = 'ModelProviderSchemaError';\n        this.issues = issues;\n    }\n}\n\n/** 配置缺失或非法。**在启动阶段抛**，而不是跑到第 9 个节点才崩 */\nexport class ModelProviderConfigError extends Error {\n    readonly issues: readonly string[];\n\n    constructor(issues: readonly string[]) {\n        super(`LLM 配置不可用：${issues.join('；')}`);\n        this.name = 'ModelProviderConfigError';\n        this.issues = issues;\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * 错误分类——**降级逻辑的全部依据**。\n *\n * 把限流当成「不支持」会让整个进程永久停在次优策略上，所以这两类必须分开：\n * - `unsupported`：400 / 参数不认 → 降级换策略\n * - `transient`：超时、429、5xx → **重试同一个策略**，不降级\n */\nexport type FailureKind = 'unsupported' | 'transient' | 'schema' | 'fatal';\n\nconst TRANSIENT_PATTERNS = [\n    /rate.?limit/i,\n    /too many requests/i,\n    /timeout/i,\n    /timed out/i,\n    /ECONNRESET/i,\n    /ETIMEDOUT/i,\n    /socket hang up/i,\n    /\\b(429|500|502|503|504)\\b/\n];\n\nconst UNSUPPORTED_PATTERNS = [\n    /unsupported/i,\n    /invalid.?parameter/i,\n    /not supported/i,\n    /unrecognized/i,\n    /does not support/i,\n    /\\b400\\b/\n];\n\n/** 从任意错误里判定它属于哪一类。先判瞬时，再判不支持——限流响应里也常带 400 字样 */\nexport function classifyFailure(error: unknown): FailureKind {\n    if (error instanceof ModelProviderSchemaError) return 'schema';\n\n    const status = (error as { status?: unknown })?.status;\n    if (typeof status === 'number') {\n        if (status === 429 || status >= 500) return 'transient';\n        if (status === 400 || status === 404 || status === 422) return 'unsupported';\n    }\n\n    const text = error instanceof Error ? `${error.name} ${error.message}` : String(error);\n    if (TRANSIENT_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(text))) return 'transient';\n    if (UNSUPPORTED_PATTERNS.some((p) => p.test(text))) return 'unsupported';\n    return 'fatal';\n}\n"
}

* - **id 不给 LLM 编。** branded id 的分配是确定性工作，由 assembler 统一铸造\n * - **`scriptHash` / `startMs` / `durationMs` 是算出来的，不是写出来的。**\n *   `durationMs` 尤其要命——它由配音真实时长反推（§3.1）。\n *   把这些字段放进 LLM 能看见的 schema，等于邀请它填，\n *   然后你得决定信不信，而答案永远是不信\n *\n * ## 字段描述是给模型看的\n *\n * `.describe()` 的内容会被编进 JSON Schema 送给模型。取值范围、单位、格式约定\n * 都要写清楚——实测中模型把归一化坐标填成了 `500`（像素），\n * 就是因为 schema 没说「0~1」。\n */\n\n// ── CreativeBrief：从提示词提炼创作方向 ──────────────────────────────────\n\nexport const creativeBriefSchema = z.object({\n    theme: z.string().describe('这条片子的核心主题，一句话'),\n    audience: z.string().describe('目标观众是谁'),\n    tone: z\n        .string()\n        .describe('整体基调，例如「克制专业」「轻松口语」'),\n    mood: z\n        .enum(['平静', '欢快', '抒情', '治愈', '悲壮', '宏伟'])\n        .describe('情绪基调。会用于选配乐，必须从给定项里选'),\n    topic: z\n        .string()\n        .describe('题材领域，例如「财经」「人文」「社会」「时政」「日常」'),\n    keyPoints: z\n        .array(z.string())\n        .min(1)\n        .describe('片子要讲清楚的几个要点，按讲述顺序')\n});\n\nexport type CreativeBrief = z.infer<typeof creativeBriefSchema>;\n\n// ── ScenePlan：分镜与文案 ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport const scenePlanItemSchema = z.object({\n    goal: z.string().describe('这一镜要达成什么效果'),\n    script: z\n        .string()\n        .min(1)\n        .describe(\n            '配音文案原文。用自然口语，可用换行表示断句意图——换行会被用作字幕分段依据'\n        ),\n    visualIntent: z\n        .string()\n        .describe('画面意图，用于检索素材。描述画面内容而不是抽象概念')\n});\n\nexport const scenePlanSchema = z.object({\n    scenes: z\n        .array(scenePlanItemSchema)\n        .min(1)\n        .describe('按播出顺序排列的分镜。不要填时长，时长由配音合成后反推')\n});\n\nexport type ScenePlan = z.infer<typeof scenePlanSchema>;\nexport type ScenePlanItem = z.infer<typeof scenePlanItemSchema>;\n\n// ── AssetRerank：候选素材精排 ────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport const assetRerankSchema = z.object({\n    chosenAssetId: z\n        .string()\n        .min(1)\n        .describe('选中的素材 id，**必须**来自给定的候选列表，不要自己编'),\n    reason: z.string().describe('为什么选它，一两句'),\n    alternatives: z\n        .array(\n            z.object({\n                assetId: z.string().min(1).describe('候选素材 id'),\n                score: z\n                    .number()\n                    .min(0)\n                    .max(1)\n                    .describe('契合度，0 到 1 之间的小数'),\n                rejected: z.string().describe('为什么没选它')\n            })\n        )\n        .describe('其余候选的评分与落选原因，供用户追溯')\n});\n\nexport type AssetRerank = z.infer<typeof assetRerankSchema>;\n\n// ── AssetTag：关键帧打标 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport const assetTagSchema = z.object({\n    description: z\n        .string()\n        .min(1)\n        .describe('画面内容的客观描述，一到两句。写看得见的东西，不要推测'),\n    tags: z\n        .array(z.string())\n        .min(1)\n        .describe('检索用的关键词，例如场景、时间、人物、动作'),\n    // 实测模型会把这里填成像素值，所以范围必须写死在描述里\n   "content": "import { z } from 'zod';\n\nimport { ModelProviderConfigError } from './types';\nimport type { StructuredOutputMethod, ThinkingMode } from './types';\n\n/**\n * LLM 配置。**一处都不写死**——端点、模型、策略、思考开关全部从环境变量读，\n * 同 plan.md §10 的原则。\n *\n * 凭证只在主进程读取，绝不进渲染进程。\n */\n\nconst methodSchema = z.enum(['functionCalling', 'jsonSchema', 'jsonMode']);\n\nexport const llmConfigSchema = z.object({\n    provider: z.enum(['ark', 'mock']).default('mock'),\n    baseUrl: z.string().url(),\n    apiKey: z.string().min(1),\n    model: z.string().min(1),\n    /**\n     * 策略候选，**有序**。第一个是首选，后面是降级目标。\n     * 两种都已实跑验证可用（plan.md §4.2.1），列表存在是为了防御端点变化。\n     */\n    methods: z.array(methodSchema).min(1).default(['functionCalling']),\n    thinking: z.enum(['disabled', 'enabled']).default('disabled'),\n    /** 单次请求超时。多模态打标会慢一些，默认给足 */\n    timeoutMs: z.int().positive().default(120_000),\n    /** 瞬时错误（限流 / 5xx / 超时）的重试次数 */\n    maxRetries: z.int().nonnegative().default(2)\n});\n\nexport type LlmConfig = z.infer<typeof llmConfigSchema>;\n\n/** mock provider 不需要凭证——没网络没 key 也要能跑通整条流水线 */\nconst MOCK_DEFAULTS = {\n    baseUrl: 'http://mock.invalid',\n    apiKey: 'mock',\n    model: 'mock-model'\n} as const;\n\nfunction splitMethods(raw: string | undefined): string[] | undefined {\n    if (!raw) return undefined;\n    const parts = raw\n        .split(/[,\\s]+/)\n        .map((p) => p.trim())\n        .filter(Boolean);\n    return parts.length > 0 ? parts : undefined;\n}\n\n/**\n * 从环境变量装配配置。\n *\n * **在启动阶段校验一次**：缺项、格式错、策略名不认识，都要在这里就报清楚，\n * 而不是跑到第 9 个节点才崩。\n */\nexport function loadLlmConfig(\n    env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env\n): LlmConfig {\n    const provider = env['LLM_PROVIDER'] ?? 'mock';\n    const isMock = provider === 'mock';\n\n    const raw = {\n        provider,\n        baseUrl: env['ARK_BASE_URL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.baseUrl : undefined),\n        apiKey: env['ARK_API_KEY'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.apiKey : undefined),\n        model: env['LLM_MODEL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.model : undefined),\n        methods: splitMethods(env['LLM_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_METHOD']),\n        thinking: env['LLM_THINKING'],\n        timeoutMs: env['LLM_TIMEOUT_MS']\n            ? Number(env['LLM_TIMEOUT_MS'])\n            : undefined,\n        maxRetries: env['LLM_MAX_RETRIES']\n            ? Number(env['LLM_MAX_RETRIES'])\n            : undefined\n    };\n\n    // undefined 要摘掉，否则会覆盖掉 schema 的 default\n    const cleaned = Object.fromEntries(\n        Object.entries(raw).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)\n    );\n\n    const parsed = llmConfigSchema.safeParse(cleaned);\n    if (!parsed.success) {\n        throw new ModelProviderConfigError(\n            parsed.error.issues.map(\n                (issue) => `${issue.path.join('.') || '(根)'}：${issue.message}`\n            )\n        );\n    }\n    return parsed.data;\n}\n\n/** 首选策略 */\nexport function primaryMethod(config: LlmConfig): StructuredOutputMethod {\n    return config.methods[0]!;\n}\n\n/** 给定策略之后还能降到哪个；没有就返回 null */\nexport function nextMethod(\n    config: LlmConfig,\n    current: StructuredOutputMethod\n): StructuredOutputMethod | null {\n    const index = config.methods.indexOf(current);\n    if (index < 0) return null;\n    return config.methods[index + 1] ?? null;\n}\n\nexport function resolveThinking(\n    config: LlmConfig,\n    override?: ThinkingMode\n): ThinkingMode {\n    return override ?? config.thinking;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { MessageContentComplex } from '@langchain/core/messages';\nimport { HumanMessage, SystemMessage } from '@langchain/core/messages';\nimport { ChatOpenAI } from '@langchain/openai';\n\nimport type { LlmConfig } from './config';\nimport { nextMethod, primaryMethod, resolveThinking } from './config';\nimport {\n    classifyFailure,\n    ModelProviderError,\n    ModelProviderSchemaError\n} from './types';\nimport type {\n    ImageInput,\n    ModelProvider,\n    ProviderEvent,\n    StructuredOutputMethod,\n    StructuredRequest,\n    StructuredResult,\n    ThinkingMode,\n    TokenUsage\n} from './types';\n\n/**\n * 火山方舟 provider。\n *\n * **这是全仓唯一 import langchain 的地方**（除了 mock 里的类型）。\n * 图节点只认 `ModelProvider` 接口——换厂商、换 LangChain 版本都不该波及它们。\n *\n * 接入要点（全部由实跑冒烟坐实，见 plan.md §4.2.1）：\n * - 方舟是 OpenAI-compatible，走 `ChatOpenAI` + `configuration.baseURL`\n * - `BASE_URL` 是 `/api/plan/v3`，不是 `/api/v3`\n * - `tool calling` 与 `json_schema` 在 `/chat/completions` 上**都可用**\n * - 多模态、tool calling、关闭思考**三者可叠加**\n */\n\nconst EMPTY_USAGE: «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码» RawUsageShape {\n    prompt_tokens?: unknown;\n    completion_tokens?: unknown;\n    total_tokens?: unknown;\n    completion_tokens_details?: { reasoning_tokens?: unknown };\n}\n\nfunction num(value: unknown): number {\n    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * 从原始响应里抠 usage。\n *\n * 走 `response_metadata.tokenUsage` 拿不到 `reasoning_tokens`——\n * 那是方舟特有的字段，LangChain 的标准化结构里没有位置。\n * 而它恰恰是**验证「关闭思考」真的生效**的唯一依据，所以必须从原始对象里取。\n */\nexport function extractUsage(raw: unknown): TokenUsage {\n    const metadata = (raw as { response_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> })\n        ?.response_metadata;\n    const usage = (metadata?.['usage'] ??\n        metadata?.['tokenUsage'] ??\n        {}) as RawUsageShape;\n\n    const «已打码»    const «已打码»    return {\n        promptTokens,\n        completionTokens,\n        «已打码»        «已打码» || promptTokens + completionTokens\n    };\n}\n\nfunction toImageBlock(image: ImageInput): MessageContentComplex {\n    return {\n        type: 'image_url',\n        image_url: { url: `data:${image.mimeType};base64,${image.base64}` }\n    };\n}\n\nexport interface ArkProviderOptions {\n    config: LlmConfig;\n    onEvent?: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n}\n\nexport class ArkChatModelProvider implements ModelProvider {\n    readonly name = 'ark';\n\n    private readonly config: LlmConfig;\n    private readonly onEvent: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * 本进程内已确认可用的策略。\n     *\n     * 降级结果必须缓存：否则 3000 个片段就是 3000 次明知必败的往返。\n     */\n    private activeMethod: StructuredOutputMethod;\n\n    /** 按思考模式缓存模型实例——`thinking` 是构造参数，不能按请求切 */\n    private readonly models = new Map<ThinkingMode, ChatOpenAI>();\n\n    constructor(options: ArkProviderOptions) {\n        this.config = options.config;\n        this.onEvent = options.onEvent ?? ((): void => undefined);\n        this.activeMethod = primaryMethod(options.config);\n    }\n\n    private modelFor(thinking: ThinkingMode): ChatOpenAI {\n        const cached = this.models.get(thinking);\n        if (cached) return cached;\n\n        const model = new ChatOpenAI({\n            model: this.config.model,\n            apiKey: this.config.apiKey,\n            configuration: { baseURL: this.config.baseUrl },\n            timeout: this.config.timeoutMs,\n            // 重试由我们自己按 FailureKind 控制：LangChain 的内建重试\n            // 会把\"不支持\"也一起重试，那是纯浪费\n            maxRetries: 0,\n            // `thinking` 不是 OpenAI 的标准参数，只能从 modelKwargs 透传进请求体。\n            // 这是成本开关，见 types.ts 的 ThinkingMode\n            modelKwargs: { thinking: { type: thinking } }\n        });\n        this.models.set(thinking, model);\n        return model;\n    }\n\n    async invokeStructured<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>\n    ): Promise<StructuredResult<T>> {\n        const thinking = resolveThinking(this.config, request.thinking);\n        let method = this.activeMethod;\n\n        for (;;) {\n            try {\n                const result = await this.runWithRetries(\n                    request,\n                    method,\n                    thinking\n                );\n                // 成功才落盘活跃策略，失败时不要把降级中间态记下来\n                this.activeMethod = method;\n                return result;\n            } catch (error) {\n                const kind = classifyFailure(error);\n                if (kind !== 'unsupported') throw error;\n\n                const fallback = nextMethod(this.config, method);\n                if (!fallback) throw error;\n\n                this.onEvent({\n                    type: 'method_downgraded',\n                    task: request.task,\n                    from: method,\n                    to: fallback,\n                    reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                });\n                method = fallback;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 同一策略下的重试。只重试瞬时错误——限流不是\"不支持\" */\n    private async runWithRetries<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>,\n        method: StructuredOutputMethod,\n        thinking: ThinkingMode\n    ): Promise<StructuredResult<T>> {\n        let lastError: unknown;\n\n        for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.config.maxRetries; attempt += 1) {\n            try {\n                return await this.runOnce(request, method, thinking);\n            } catch (error) {\n                lastError = error;\n                const kind = classifyFailure(error);\n                if (kind !== 'transient' || attempt === this.config.maxRetries) {\n                    if (kind === 'transient') {\n                        this.onEvent({\n                            type: 'request_failed',\n                            task: request.task,\n                            method,\n                            reason: '瞬时错误重试次数已用尽'\n                        });\n                    }\n                    throw error;\n                }\n                this.onEvent({\n                    type: 'request_retried',\n                    task: request.task,\n                    method,\n                    attempt: attempt + 1,\n                    reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                });\n                // 指数退避。限流下立刻重试只会继续撞墙\n                await sleep(500 * 2 ** attempt);\n            }\n        }\n        throw lastError;\n    }\n\n    private async runOnce<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>,\n        method: StructuredOutputMethod,\n        thinking: ThinkingMode\n    ): Promise<StructuredResult<T>> {\n        const images = request.images ?? [];\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_started',\n            task: request.task,\n            method,\n            images: images.length\n        });\n\n        const content: MessageContentComplex[] = [\n            { type: 'text', text: request.user },\n            ...images.map(toImageBlock)\n        ];\n        const messages = [\n            ...(request.system ? [new SystemMessage(request.system)] : []),\n            new HumanMessage({ content })\n        ];\n\n        // includeRaw 才拿得到 usage——§11 的成本记账与 §12 的事件流都要它\n        const structured = this.modelFor(thinking).withStructuredOutput(\n            request.schema,\n            { method, includeRaw: true, name: request.task }\n        );\n\n        const response = (await structured.invoke(messages)) as {\n            parsed: unknown;\n            raw: unknown;\n        };\n        const usage = extractUsage(response.raw);\n\n        // LangChain 已按 schema 校验过；这里再 parse 一次是为了拿到**我们自己的**\n        // 错误形状，让图层不必区分错误来自哪一层\n        const parsed = request.schema.safeParse(response.parsed);\n        if (!parsed.success) {\n            const issues = parsed.error.issues.map(\n                (issue) => `${issue.path.join('.') || '(根)'}：${issue.message}`\n            );\n            this.onEvent({\n                type: 'request_failed',\n                task: request.task,\n                method,\n                reason: `schema 不符：${issues.join('；')}`\n            });\n            throw new ModelProviderSchemaError(request.task, issues);\n        }\n\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_finished',\n            task: request.task,\n            method,\n            usage\n        });\n        return { value: parsed.data, usage, method };\n    }\n}\n\nfunction sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {\n    return new Promise((resolve) => {\n        setTimeout(resolve, ms);\n    });\n}\n\nexport { EMPTY_USAGE, ModelProviderError };\n"
}

  "content": "import { ModelProviderSchemaError } from './types';\nimport type {\n    ModelProvider,\n    ProviderEvent,\n    StructuredRequest,\n    StructuredResult,\n    TokenUsage\n} from './types';\n\n/**\n * 无凭证、无网络的 provider。\n *\n * **不是可选项。** 没有它，整条流水线在没凭证、没网络时一步都跑不通——\n * 开发做不了，CI 做不了，测试也做不了。所以它是 B6a 的必要组成，\n * 不是\"顺手加的方便功能\"。\n *\n * 用法：按任务名注册应答器。没注册的任务会抛错而不是返回空对象——\n * 静默返回空对象会让下游在离故障点很远的地方崩，排查成本极高。\n */\n\nexport type MockResponder = (request: StructuredRequest<unknown>) => unknown;\n\nexport interface MockProviderOptions {\n    /** 任务名 → 应答器。值可以是常量，也可以按请求内容变化 */\n    responders?: Record<string, MockResponder | unknown>;\n    onEvent?: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n    /** 每次调用的模拟延迟，用来观察进度事件 */\n    latencyMs?: number;\n}\n\nconst MOCK_USAGE: «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码» class MockModelProvider implements ModelProvider {\n    readonly name = 'mock';\n\n    private readonly responders: Map<string, MockResponder>;\n    private readonly onEvent: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n    private readonly latencyMs: number;\n\n    /** 收到过的请求，供测试断言「发过去的到底是什么」 */\n    readonly calls: StructuredRequest<unknown>[] = [];\n\n    constructor(options: MockProviderOptions = {}) {\n        this.responders = new Map(\n            Object.entries(options.responders ?? {}).map(([task, value]) => [\n                task,\n                typeof value === 'function'\n                    ? (value as MockResponder)\n                    : (): unknown => value\n            ])\n        );\n        this.onEvent = options.onEvent ?? ((): void => undefined);\n        this.latencyMs = options.latencyMs ?? 0;\n    }\n\n    /** 事后注册。测试里常常要按用例换应答 */\n    setResponder(task: string, responder: MockResponder | unknown): void {\n        this.responders.set(\n            task,\n            typeof responder === 'function'\n                ? (responder as MockResponder)\n                : (): unknown => responder\n        );\n    }\n\n    async invokeStructured<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>\n    ): Promise<StructuredResult<T>> {\n        this.calls.push(request as StructuredRequest<unknown>);\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_started',\n            task: request.task,\n            method: 'functionCalling',\n            images: request.images?.length ?? 0\n        });\n\n        if (this.latencyMs > 0) {\n            await new Promise((resolve) => {\n                setTimeout(resolve, this.latencyMs);\n            });\n        }\n\n        const responder = this.responders.get(request.task);\n        if (!responder) {\n            throw new Error(\n                `MockModelProvider 没有为任务「${request.task}」注册应答。` +\n                    `已注册：${[...this.responders.keys()].join('、') || '(无)'}`\n            );\n        }\n\n        // Mock 的产物**也要过 schema**。不校验的话，fixture 写错了会一路漏到\n        // 下游才炸，而那时已经看不出是 mock 数据的问题\n        const parsed = request.schema.safeParse(\n            responder(request as StructuredRequest<unknown>)\n        );\n        if (!parsed.success) {\n            throw new ModelProviderSchemaError(\n                request.task,\n                parsed.error.issues.map(\n                    (issue) =>\n                        `${issue.path.join('.') || '(根)'}：${issue.message}`\n                )\n            );\n        }\n\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_finished',\n            task: request.task,\n            method: 'functionCalling',\n            usage: MOCK_USAGE\n        });\n        return { value: parsed.data, usage: MOCK_USAGE, method: 'functionCalling' };\n    }\n}\n"
}

Append `data` to the active multimodal block's\n * data field.\n */\nexport interface DataDelta {\n  type: \"data-delta\";\n  /** Encoded data chunk to append. */\n  data: string;\n  /** Encoding for the data chunk. type: string } & Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\n/**\n * Union of all content block delta types.\n */\nexport type ContentBlockDelta =\n  | TextDelta\n  | ReasoningDelta\n  | DataDelta\n  | BlockDelta;\n\n/**\n * Emitted for each incremental update within a content block.\n *\n * The `delta` field carries the incremental content block update.\n * Accumulation rules:\n * - `text-delta` → * - `block-delta` → shallow-merge `fields` onto the active block\n *\n * @example\n * ```ts\n * // Text token\n * { event: \"content-block-delta\", index: 0,\n *   delta: { type: \"text-delta\", text:   "content": "import type { LlmConfig } from './config';\nimport { nextMethod, primaryMethod } from './config';\nimport { classifyFailure } from './types';\nimport type { ProviderEvent, StructuredOutputMethod } from './types';\n\n/**\n * 重试与降级策略。\n *\n * 从 `ArkChatModelProvider` 里抽出来是为了**能在没有网络的情况下测它**——\n * 策略本身才是这里唯一有意思的逻辑，而它藏在一个要建 HTTP 连接的类里就等于测不了。\n * provider 只负责「发一次请求」，什么时候重试、什么时候降级由这里决定。\n */\n\nexport interface PolicyOptions {\n    config: LlmConfig;\n    task: string;\n    onEvent?: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n    /** 已确认可用的策略；没有就从配置的首选开始 */\n    startMethod?: StructuredOutputMethod;\n    /** 退避实现。测试里换成立即返回，免得白等几秒 */\n    sleep?: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;\n}\n\nexport interface PolicyResult<T> {\n    value: T;\n    /** 实际生效的策略。可能是降级后的，排查时看这个而不是配置 */\n    method: StructuredOutputMethod;\n}\n\nconst defaultSleep = (ms: number): Promise<void> =>\n    new Promise((resolve) => {\n        setTimeout(resolve, ms);\n    });\n\n/**\n * 按策略执行一次结构化调用。\n *\n * 两条规则，缺一不可：\n *\n * 1. **只有 `unsupported` 才降级。** 把限流当成\"不支持\"会让整个进程永久停在\n *    次优策略上——而且这种退化是静默的，没人会发现\n * 2. **`transient` 重试同一个策略**，指数退避。限流下立刻重试只会继续撞墙\n *\n * `schema` 与 `fatal` 都直接抛：换个策略不会让模型突然学会遵守 schema。\n */\nexport async function executeWithPolicy<T>(\n    options: PolicyOptions,\n    attempt: (method: StructuredOutputMethod) => Promise<T>\n): Promise<PolicyResult<T>> {\n    const { config, task } = options;\n    const emit = options.onEvent ?? ((): void => undefined);\n    const sleep = options.sleep ?? defaultSleep;\n\n    let method = options.startMethod ?? primaryMethod(config);\n\n    for (;;) {\n        let lastError: unknown;\n        let downgrade = false;\n\n        for (let tries = 0; tries <= config.maxRetries; tries += 1) {\n            try {\n                return { value: await attempt(method), method };\n            } catch (error) {\n                lastError = error;\n                const kind = classifyFailure(error);\n\n                if (kind === 'unsupported') {\n                    downgrade = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n                if (kind !== 'transient' || tries === config.maxRetries) {\n                    emit({\n                        type: 'request_failed',\n                        task,\n                        method,\n                        reason:\n                            error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                    });\n                    throw error;\n                }\n\n                emit({\n                    type: 'request_retried',\n                    task,\n                    method,\n                    attempt: tries + 1,\n                    reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                });\n                await sleep(500 * 2 ** tries);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!downgrade) throw lastError;\n\n        const fallback = nextMethod(config, method);\n        if (!fallback) {\n            emit({\n                type: 'request_failed',\n                task,\n                method,\n                reason: '已无可降级的策略'\n            });\n            throw lastError;\n        }\n\n        emit({\n            type: 'method_downgraded',\n            task,\n            from: method,\n            to: fallback,\n            reason:\n                lastError instanceof Error\n                    ? lastError.message\n                    : String(lastError)\n        });\n        method = fallback;\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { HumanMessage, SystemMessage } from '@langchain/core/messages';\nimport { ChatOpenAI } from '@langchain/openai';\n\nimport type { LlmConfig } from './config';\nimport { primaryMethod, resolveThinking } from './config';\nimport { executeWithPolicy } from './policy';\nimport { ModelProviderSchemaError } from './types';\nimport type {\n    ImageInput,\n    ModelProvider,\n    ProviderEvent,\n    StructuredOutputMethod,\n    StructuredRequest,\n    StructuredResult,\n    ThinkingMode,\n    TokenUsage\n} from './types';\n\n/**\n * 火山方舟 provider。\n *\n * **这是全仓唯一 import langchain 的地方。** 图节点只认 `ModelProvider` 接口——\n * 换厂商、换 LangChain 版本都不该波及它们。tasks.md B6 的 DoD 里有一条门禁：\n * 图节点里 grep 不到 langchain。\n *\n * 接入要点全部由实跑冒烟坐实（plan.md §4.2.1）：\n * - 方舟是 OpenAI-compatible，走 `ChatOpenAI` + `configuration.baseURL`\n * - `BASE_URL` 是 `/api/plan/v3`，不是 `/api/v3`\n * - tool calling 与 json_schema 在 `/chat/completions` 上**都可用**\n * - 多模态、tool calling、关闭思考**三者可叠加**\n */\n\ninterface RawUsageShape {\n    prompt_tokens?: unknown;\n    completion_tokens?: unknown;\n    total_tokens?: unknown;\n    completion_tokens_details?: { reasoning_tokens?: unknown };\n}\n\nfunction num(value: unknown): number {\n    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * 从原始响应里抠 usage。\n *\n * 走 LangChain 标准化后的 `tokenUsage` 拿不到 `reasoning_tokens`——\n * 那是方舟特有字段，标准结构里没有位置。而它恰恰是**验证「关闭思考」真的生效**\n * 的唯一依据（plan.md §4.2.1），所以必须从原始对象里取。\n */\nexport function extractUsage(raw: unknown): TokenUsage {\n    const metadata = (raw as { response_metadata?: Record<string, unknown> })\n        ?.response_metadata;\n    const usage = (metadata?.['usage'] ??\n        metadata?.['tokenUsage'] ??\n        {}) as RawUsageShape;\n\n    const «已打码»    const «已打码»    return {\n        promptTokens,\n        completionTokens,\n        «已打码»        «已打码» || promptTokens + completionTokens\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * 图片内容块。\n *\n * LangChain v1 的形状是 `{ type: 'image', mimeType, data }`；旧版那种\n * `{ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:...' } }` 已废弃且类型对不上。\n * 转成方舟要的 data URL 由 LangChain 的 OpenAI 适配层完成。\n */\nfunction toImageBlock(image: ImageInput): {\n    type: 'image';\n    mimeType: string;\n    data: string;\n} {\n    return { type: 'image', mimeType: image.mimeType, data: image.base64 };\n}\n\nexport interface ArkProviderOptions {\n    config: LlmConfig;\n    onEvent?: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n}\n\nexport class ArkChatModelProvider implements ModelProvider {\n    readonly name = 'ark';\n\n    private readonly config: LlmConfig;\n    private readonly onEvent: (event: ProviderEvent) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * 本进程内已确认可用的策略。\n     *\n     * 降级结果必须缓存：否则 3000 个片段就是 3000 次明知必败的往返。\n     */\n    private activeMethod: StructuredOutputMethod;\n\n    /** 按思考模式缓存模型实例——`thinking` 是构造参数，不能按请求切 */\n    private readonly models = new Map<ThinkingMode, ChatOpenAI>();\n\n    constructor(options: ArkProviderOptions) {\n        this.config = options.config;\n        this.onEvent = options.onEvent ?? ((): void => undefined);\n        this.activeMethod = primaryMethod(options.config);\n    }\n\n    private modelFor(thinking: ThinkingMode): ChatOpenAI {\n        const cached = this.models.get(thinking);\n        if (cached) return cached;\n\n        const model = new ChatOpenAI({\n            model: this.config.model,\n            apiKey: this.config.apiKey,\n            configuration: { baseURL: this.config.baseUrl },\n            timeout: this.config.timeoutMs,\n            // 重试由 policy.ts 按 FailureKind 控制：LangChain 的内建重试\n            // 会把\"不支持\"也一起重试，那是纯浪费\n            maxRetries: 0,\n            // `thinking` 不是 OpenAI 的标准参数，只能从 modelKwargs 透传进请求体。\n            // 这是**成本开关**——开着思考打标会多烧 125 倍输出 token（§4.2.1）\n            modelKwargs: { thinking: { type: thinking } }\n        });\n        this.models.set(thinking, model);\n        return model;\n    }\n\n    async invokeStructured<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>\n    ): Promise<StructuredResult<T>> {\n        const thinking = resolveThinking(this.config, request.thinking);\n        let usage: «已打码»            «已打码»            «已打码»            «已打码»            «已打码»        };\n\n        const outcome = await executeWithPolicy<T>(\n            {\n                config: this.config,\n                task: request.task,\n                onEvent: this.onEvent,\n                startMethod: this.activeMethod\n            },\n            async (method) => {\n                const result = await this.runOnce(request, method, thinking);\n                usage = result.usage;\n                return result.value;\n            }\n        );\n\n        // 成功才落盘活跃策略，失败时不要把降级中间态记下来\n        this.activeMethod = outcome.method;\n        return { value: outcome.value, usage, method: outcome.method };\n    }\n\n    private async runOnce<T>(\n        request: StructuredRequest<T>,\n        method: StructuredOutputMethod,\n        thinking: ThinkingMode\n    ): Promise<{ value: T; usage: TokenUsage }> {\n        const images = request.images ?? [];\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_started',\n            task: request.task,\n            method,\n            images: images.length\n        });\n\n        const content = [\n            { type: 'text' as const, text: request.user },\n            ...images.map(toImageBlock)\n        ];\n        const messages = [\n            ...(request.system ? [new SystemMessage(request.system)] : []),\n            new HumanMessage({ content })\n        ];\n\n        // includeRaw 才拿得到 usage——§11 的成本记账与 §12 的事件流都要它\n        const structured = this.modelFor(thinking).withStructuredOutput(\n            request.schema,\n            { method, includeRaw: true, name: request.task }\n        );\n\n        const response = (await structured.invoke(messages)) as {\n            parsed: unknown;\n            raw: unknown;\n        };\n        const usage = extractUsage(response.raw);\n\n        // LangChain 已按 schema 校验过；这里再 parse 一次是为了拿到**我们自己的**\n        // 错误形状，让图层不必区分错误来自哪一层\n        const parsed = request.schema.safeParse(response.parsed);\n        if (!parsed.success) {\n            const issues = parsed.error.issues.map(\n                (issue) => `${issue.path.join('.') || '(根)'}：${issue.message}`\n            );\n            this.onEvent({\n                type: 'request_failed',\n                task: request.task,\n                method,\n                reason: `schema 不符：${issues.join('；')}`\n            });\n            throw new ModelProviderSchemaError(request.task, issues);\n        }\n\n        this.onEvent({\n            type: 'request_finished',\n            task: request.task,\n            method,\n            usage\n        });\n        return { value: parsed.data, usage };\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "new_string": "    /**\n     * **这条是整个 live 测试里最重要的一条。**\n     *\n     * `thinking` 是从 `modelKwargs` 透传的非标准参数。如果 LangChain 把它悄悄丢了，\n     * 开关就是个摆设，而代码、类型、其他测试**全都不会有任何异常**——\n     * 唯一能戳穿它的就是对比两种模式的 `reasoningTokens`。\n     *\n     * **必须在 `jsonSchema` 路径上验。** 强制 tool calling 本身就把 reasoning\n     * 压成 0（见下一条），在那条路上两种模式都是 0，这条断言就永远为真、\n     * 什么都证明不了——正是 B1 那类假通过。\n     */\n    it('thinking 开关真的进了请求体（jsonSchema 路径）', async () => {\n        const ask = async (\n            thinking: 'disabled' | 'enabled'\n        ): Promise<number> => {\n            const provider = new ArkChatModelProvider({\n                config: config({ methods: ['jsonSchema'] })\n            });\n            const result = await provider.invokeStructured({\n                task: 'ScenePlanner',\n                schema: scenePlanSchema,\n                user: '把「如何煮好一碗面」拆成两个分镜。',\n                thinking\n            });\n            return result.usage.reasoningTokens;\n        };\n\n        const off = await ask('disabled');\n        const on = await ask('enabled');\n\n        expect(off).toBe(0);\n        expect(on).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n    }, 240_000);\n\n    it('强制 tool calling 本身就不产生 reasoning，与 thinking 参数无关', async () => {\n        const ask = async (\n            thinking: 'disabled' | 'enabled'\n        ): Promise<number> => {\n            const provider = new ArkChatModelProvider({\n                config: config({ methods: ['functionCalling'] })\n            });\n            const result = await provider.invokeStructured({\n                task: 'ScenePlanner',\n                schema: scenePlanSchema,\n                user: '把「如何煮好一碗面」拆成两个分镜。',\n                thinking\n            });\n            return result.usage.reasoningTokens;\n        };\n\n        // 这是我们默认走的路径，所以\"思考开关\"在这里其实是个 no-op。\n        // 记下来是为了避免有人看见开关就以为调它能省钱\n        expect(await ask('disabled')).toBe(0);\n        expect(await ask('enabled')).toBe(0);\n    }, 240_000);"

s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')\ns=s.replace(\"\"\" * 两条规则，缺一不可：\n *\n * 1. **只有 `unsupported` 才降级。** 把限流当成\"不支持\"会让整个进程永久停在\n *    次优策略上——而且这种退化是静默的，没人会发现\n * 2. **`transient` 重试同一个策略**，指数退避。限流下立刻重试只会继续撞墙\n *\n * `schema` 与 `fatal` 都直接抛：换个策略不会让模型突然学会遵守 schema。\"\"\",\n\"\"\" * 四类错误四种处置，缺一不可：\n *\n * | 类别 | 处置 | 为什么 |\n * |---|---|---|\n * | `unsupported` | 立刻降级 | 重试同一个不支持的参数是纯浪费 |\n * | `transient` | 重试同策略，耗尽即抛 | 限流换策略也绕不开 |\n * | `empty` | 重试同策略，**耗尽后降级** | 换策略确实能绕开（实测 1/6 vs 6/6） |\n * | `schema` / `fatal` | 直接抛 | 换策略不会让模型突然学会遵守 schema |\n *\n * 把限流当成\"不支持\"会让整个进程永久停在次优策略上，而且这种退化是静默的。\"\"\")\ns=s.replace(\"\"\"            } catch (error) {\n                lastError = error;\n                const kind = classifyFailure(error);\n\n                if (kind === 'unsupported') {\n                    downgrade = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n                if (kind !== 'transient' || tries === config.maxRetries) {\"\"\",\n\"\"\"            } catch (error) {\n                lastError = error;\n                const kind = classifyFailure(error);\n\n                if (kind === 'unsupported') {\n                    downgrade = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n                const retryable = kind === 'transient' || kind === 'empty';\n                if (retryable && tries === config.maxRetries && kind === 'empty') {\n                    // 空响应重试到头：换个策略还有救\n                    downgrade = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n                if (!retryable || tries === config.maxRetries) {\"\"\")\np.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')\nprint('已更新')\nPY\nnpx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -3\nnpx vitest run tests/llm.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E \"Tests  |× |→\" | head",

**B6a 完成。** 但这一批最有价值的不是代码,是 live 测试抓到的三个问题 —— 它们的共同点是**类型全过、单测全绿、一跑就错**。 ## 交付 `packages/video-agent/src/llm/`: | 文件 | 职责 | |---|---| | `types.ts` | `ModelProvider` 接口、四类错误、`FailureKind` 分类 | | `schemas.ts` | 四个窄 schema,都不是 `videoProjectSchema` 的子集 | | `config.ts` | 环境变量装配 + Zod 校验,启动阶段就报错 | | `policy.ts` | 重试与降级 —— **从 provider 抽出来,没网络也能测** | | `ark.ts` | **全仓唯一 import langchain 的文件** | | `mock.ts` | 无凭证无网络可跑;mock 产物也过 schema | ## 三个只有真跑才暴露的问题 **1. `functionCalling` 在方舟上只有 1/6 成功率。** 同一提示词各跑 6 次:`jsonSchema` 6/6,`functionCalling` **1/6**。查清了原因:LangChain 单工具时会强制 `tool_choice`,而方舟在强制模式下经常返回 `finish_reason: tool_calls` 但 `tool_calls` 是空数组 —— 不带 `tool_choice` 直接 curl 是 4/4,带上变 2/4,**问题出在"强制"这个动作上**。 → 默认策略改成 `jsonSchema`,并给空响应单开一类 `empty`:重试同策略,**耗尽后降级**(混进 `transient` 就永远降不了级,混进 `unsupported` 就连一次重试都不给)。 **2. 我昨天给你的「关思考省 125 倍」结论是错的。** 那次对比里我同时换了两个变量。受控实验后的正确结论: | 路径 | thinking | reasoning | |---|---|---| | 纯文本 | 不传 / enabled | 2045 / 979 | | **强制 tool calling** | 任何值 | **0 —— 开关无效** | | json_schema | 不传 / enabled | 325 / 194 | | json_schema | **disabled** | **0** | 省下来的主要是**用了结构化输出路径**,不是思考开关。但因为默认路径是 `json_schema`,开关在那条路上**确实有效**,所以 `LLM_THINKING=disabled` 仍要显式传。plan.md §4.2.1 和 §11 都已更正并留了更正记录。 **3. 图片块形状不对,方舟直接 400。** LangChain v1 的 `{type:'image', mimeType, data}` **不会**被 completions 适配层翻译成 `image_url`,原样透传后被拒。必须用 OpenAI 原生形状。 ## 验证 | 项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `typecheck` / `lint` | 4 包通过 | | `test:run` | 56+78+**104**+82 = **320** 通过(6 个 live 默认跳过) | | **live(带真凭证)** | **7/7 通过** | | `cspell` | 129 文件 0 问题 | | 渲染层构建 | 通过 | | DoD:图节点不得 import langchain | ✅ 只有 `ark.ts` | | 凭证残留 | ✅ 全仓 grep 为空 | DoD 里那条「业务二次校验」我做成了一组用例:先证明幻觉 assetId **过得了** `assetRerankSchema`,再证明只有业务层拦得住 —— 这样它就不只是个注释。 ## 一条新门禁 前面几批我立过「渲染层改动要带真实构建」。这批再加一条:**接外部服务的批次,门禁必须包含一次带真凭证的 live 跑**。已写进 tasks.md。 ## 下一步 **B4(打标)**,前置全部就绪:B3 的关键帧、B6a 的多模态通路、`AssetTagSchema` 都验证过了。 两个提醒: - 成本仍然算不出金额 —— token 数有了,**每百万 token 的单价还没查到**(待决 #5) - 这枚 key 用完了,**请吊销重发** 要开 B4 吗?

'(未打标)'}`\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    } finally {\n        db.close();\n    }\n}\n\nmain().catch((error: unknown) => {\n    console.error(error);\n    process.exitCode = 1;\n});\n"

  "content": "import type { MediaIndexDb, SearchHit } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\n\n/**\n * 素材检索（B5 的前半段）。\n *\n * plan.md §8 定的顺序：**硬过滤 → BM25 排序 → Top-K → LLM 精排**。\n * 这个文件只管前三步，精排在 `rerank.ts`。\n *\n * 分工的理由：检索是**确定性**的，精排不是。把它们混在一起，\n * 「同一输入两次结果稳定」这条就再也测不了——你分不清是检索飘了还是模型飘了。\n */\n\n/**\n * repair 回边带来的额外约束（plan.md §6.1）。\n *\n * 第一轮匹配用不到，但校验失败回流时必须能收紧条件重来，\n * 否则重试就是把同一个不够长的片段再选一遍。\n */\nexport interface MatchConstraints {\n    /** 上一轮被否掉的片段。不排除的话 repair 会反复选中同一个 */\n    excludeSegmentIds?: readonly string[];\n    minWidth?: number;\n    minHeight?: number;\n    /** 要不要求素材自带人声 */\n    hasAudio?: boolean;\n    /** 候选池大小。交给 LLM 精排的上限，直接影响精排成本 */\n    topK?: number;\n}\n\nexport interface SceneSearchInput {\n    /** 画面意图。检索的主要依据 */\n    visualIntent: string;\n    /** 配音文案。作为补充检索词——文案里的名词往往也出现在画面里 */\n    script?: string;\n    /**\n     * 这一镜至少要多长。\n     *\n     * **由配音真实时长决定**（plan.md §3.1），不是拍脑袋定的。\n     * 比它短的素材装不下这段配音，属于硬过滤而不是排序因素。\n     */\n    minDurationMs: number;\n    constraints?: MatchConstraints;\n}\n\nexport const DEFAULT_TOP_K = 20;\n\n/**\n * 拼检索串。\n *\n * `visualIntent` 重复两遍是**刻意的**：BM25 按词频算分，重复一遍相当于给它加权。\n * 文案里的词是补充线索，不该盖过画面意图本身。\n */\nexport function buildSearchQuery(input: SceneSearchInput): string {\n    const parts = [input.visualIntent, input.visualIntent];\n    if (input.script) parts.push(input.script);\n    return parts.join(' ');\n}\n\n/**\n * 检索候选素材。\n *\n * 返回顺序**完全确定**：BM25 升序，同分按片段 id。\n * 底层 `db.search` 的 `order by` 带了 id tie-break，就是为了这条。\n */\nexport function searchAssetSegments(\n    db: MediaIndexDb,\n    input: SceneSearchInput\n): SearchHit[] {\n    const constraints = input.constraints ?? {};\n    const excluded = new Set(constraints.excludeSegmentIds ?? []);\n    const topK = constraints.topK ?? DEFAULT_TOP_K;\n\n    const hits = db.search(buildSearchQuery(input), {\n        minDurationMs: input.minDurationMs,\n        ...(constraints.minWidth !== undefined\n            ? { minWidth: constraints.minWidth }\n            : {}),\n        ...(constraints.minHeight !== undefined\n            ? { minHeight: constraints.minHeight }\n            : {}),\n        ...(constraints.hasAudio !== undefined\n            ? { hasAudio: constraints.hasAudio }\n            : {}),\n        // 多要一些再在内存里排除，避免排除完不够 topK。\n        // 在数据库层做排除要拼动态 IN 列表，得不偿失\n        limit: topK + excluded.size\n    });\n\n    return hits.filter((hit) => !excluded.has(hit.segmentId)).slice(0, topK);\n}\n\n/**\n * 语义向量检索——**只留接口，不实现**（plan.md §8）。\n *\n * 3000 条描述的全文检索已经够用；方舟是否提供 embedding 也还没核实（待决 #6）。\n * 留这个签名是为了标明扩展点在哪，等真跑出召回不足的 badcase 再拿真实数据决定要不要补。\n *\n * **故意抛错而不是返回空数组**：静默返回空会让调用方以为\"检索到了但没有结果\"，\n * 从而掩盖掉\"这功能压根没实现\"这件事。\n */\nexport function embedAssetText(_text: string): never {\n    throw new Error(\n        'embedAssetText 尚未实现（plan.md §8：先用 FTS5，拿到真实召回 badcase 再决定要不要上向量）'\n    );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { SearchHit } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\n\nimport type { AssetRerank } from '../llm/schemas';\nimport { assetRerankSchema } from '../llm/schemas';\nimport type { ModelProvider, TokenUsage } from '../llm/types';\n\n/**\n * 候选素材精排（B5 的后半段）。\n *\n * BM25 只懂词面重合，分不出「办公室里开会」和「办公室里打扫」哪个更贴分镜。\n * 这一步把 Top-K 交给模型做语义选择——这是 plan.md §3.2 允许 LLM 做的三件事之一。\n */\n\n/** 精排过程中发现的问题。**不抛错，交给调用方决定怎么处置** */\nexport interface RerankIssue {\n    code: 'hallucinated_id' | 'empty_candidates' | 'provider_failed';\n    message: string;\n}\n\nexport interface RerankResult {\n    chosen: SearchHit | null;\n    reason: string;\n    alternatives: { segmentId: string; score: number; rejected: string }[];\n    /** 精排是否真的跑了。退化到 BM25 首位时为 false */\n    reranked: boolean;\n    issues: RerankIssue[];\n    usage: TokenUsage;\n}\n\nconst ZERO_USAGE: «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码»    «已打码» 给模型看的候选清单。**只给它能看懂的东西**，路径和内部 id 之外的字段没意义 */\nexport function formatCandidates(candidates: readonly SearchHit[]): string {\n    return candidates\n        .map((hit, i) => {\n            const size =\n                hit.width && hit.height ? `${hit.width}×${hit.height}` : '未知尺寸';\n            const audio = hit.hasAudio === null ? '' : hit.hasAudio ? ' · 有音轨' : ' · 无音轨';\n            return [\n                `${i + 1}. id=${hit.segmentId}`,\n                `   时长 ${(hit.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s · ${size}${audio}`,\n                `   画面：${hit.description ?? '(未打标)'}`,\n                hit.tags.length > 0 ? `   标签：${hit.tags.join('、')}` : ''\n            ]\n                .filter(Boolean)\n                .join('\\n');\n        })\n        .join('\\n\\n');\n}\n\nexport function buildRerankPrompt(\n    visualIntent: string,\n    script: string | undefined,\n    minDurationMs: number,\n    candidates: readonly SearchHit[]\n): string {\n    return [\n        '为下面这个分镜挑一个最合适的素材片段。',\n        '',\n        `画面意图：${visualIntent}`,\n        script ? `配音文案：${script}` : '',\n        `所需时长：不短于 ${(minDurationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} 秒`,\n        '',\n        '候选（已按检索相关度排序，但相关度只看词面重合，不代表语义最贴）：',\n        '',\n        formatCandidates(candidates),\n        '',\n        '**只能从上面的 id 里选一个**，不要自己编 id。',\n        '在 alternatives 里说明其余候选为什么没被选中。'\n    ]\n        .filter((line) => line !== '')\n        .join('\\n');\n}\n\nexport interface RerankInput {\n    visualIntent: string;\n    script?: string;\n    minDurationMs: number;\n    sceneLabel?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * 精排。\n *\n * ## 业务二次校验不能省\n *\n * `withStructuredOutput` 只保证**形状**对：`chosenAssetId` 是个 string 就合法。\n * 模型完全可能返回一个候选集里没有的 id——那在 schema 层无法察觉\n * （plan.md §4.5 里专门讲过这条）。所以这里必须再查一遍集合。\n *\n * ## 出问题时退化而不是抛错\n *\n * 幻觉 id、模型调用失败，都退化到 BM25 首位，并把问题记进 `issues`。\n * 理由是 plan.md §6.1：单个分镜出状况不该阻塞其余分镜产出。\n * 但**退化必须留痕**——静默退化的症状是\"某些分镜选得莫名其妙，没人知道为什么\"。\n */\nexport async function rerankCandidates(\n    provider: ModelProvider,\n    input: RerankInput,\n    candidates: readonly SearchHit[]\n): Promise<RerankResult> {\n    if (candidates.length === 0) {\n        return {\n            chosen: null,\n            reason: '没有满足硬过滤条件的候选素材',\n            alternatives: [],\n            reranked: false,\n            issues: [\n                {\n                    code: 'empty_candidates',\n                    message: '检索没有返回任何候选，请放宽约束或补充素材'\n                }\n            ],\n            usage: ZERO_USAGE\n        };\n    }\n\n    const top = candidates[0]!;\n    const fallback = (issue: RerankIssue, usage: TokenUsage): RerankResult => ({\n        chosen: top,\n        reason: `精排未生效，退回检索首位：${issue.message}`,\n        alternatives: candidates.slice(1).map((hit) => ({\n            segmentId: hit.segmentId,\n            score: 0,\n            rejected: '未经精排'\n        })),\n        reranked: false,\n        issues: [issue],\n        usage\n    });\n\n    let result: { value: AssetRerank; usage: TokenUsage };\n    try {\n        result = await provider.invokeStructured<AssetRerank>({\n            task: 'AssetMatcher',\n            schema: assetRerankSchema,\n            system: '你是视频剪辑师，为分镜挑选最贴合的素材。',\n            user: buildRerankPrompt(\n                input.visualIntent,\n                input.script,\n                input.minDurationMs,\n                candidates\n            ),\n            // 选素材是需要权衡的判断，值得让模型想一下\n            thinking: 'enabled'\n        });\n    } catch (error) {\n        return fallback(\n            {\n                code: 'provider_failed',\n                message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n            },\n            ZERO_USAGE\n        );\n    }\n\n    const byId = new Map(candidates.map((hit) => [hit.segmentId, hit]));\n    const chosen = byId.get(result.value.chosenAssetId);\n\n    if (!chosen) {\n        // schema 放行了它，只有这里拦得住\n        return fallback(\n            {\n                code: 'hallucinated_id',\n                message: `模型选了候选集之外的 id：${result.value.chosenAssetId}`\n            },\n            result.usage\n        );\n    }\n\n    return {\n        chosen,\n        reason: result.value.reason,\n        // 模型也可能在 alternatives 里编 id，一并过滤——理由同上\n        alternatives: result.value.alternatives\n            .filter((alt) => byId.has(alt.assetId))\n            .map((alt) => ({\n                segmentId: alt.assetId,\n                score: alt.score,\n                rejected: alt.rejected\n            })),\n        reranked: true,\n        issues: [],\n        usage: result.usage\n    };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { MediaIndexDb, SearchHit } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\nimport type { AiDecision } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';\n\nimport type { ModelProvider, TokenUsage } from '../llm/types';\nimport type { RerankIssue } from './rerank';\nimport { rerankCandidates } from './rerank';\nimport type { MatchConstraints, SceneSearchInput } from './search';\nimport { searchAssetSegments } from './search';\n\n/**\n * 一个分镜的素材匹配：检索 + 精排 + 产出决策记录。\n *\n * 这是 B5 对外的唯一入口，B9 的 `AssetMatcher` 节点直接用它。\n */\n\nexport interface SceneMatchInput extends SceneSearchInput {\n    /** 分镜 id。写进 `ai.decisions` 用，纯计算时可以不给 */\n    sceneId?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface SceneMatchResult {\n    chosen: SearchHit | null;\n    candidates: SearchHit[];\n    /** 直接落进 `project.ai.decisions`，无需再加工 */\n    decision: AiDecision;\n    reranked: boolean;\n    issues: RerankIssue[];\n    usage: TokenUsage;\n}\n\n/**\n * 匹配一个分镜的素材。\n *\n * 流程严格照 plan.md §8：硬过滤 → BM25 → Top-K → LLM 精排 → **业务校验**。\n *\n * `decision` 是必须产出的，不是可选项（plan.md §7.1）：\n * 「为什么给分镜 03 选了这个片段」留不下痕，界面上看到不合理结果时就无从调试，\n * 用户也没法给反馈。\n */\nexport async function matchSceneAssets(\n    db: MediaIndexDb,\n    provider: ModelProvider,\n    input: SceneMatchInput\n): Promise<SceneMatchResult> {\n    const candidates = searchAssetSegments(db, input);\n    const reranked = await rerankCandidates(\n        provider,\n        {\n            visualIntent: input.visualIntent,\n            ...(input.script !== undefined ? { script: input.script } : {}),\n            minDurationMs: input.minDurationMs\n        },\n        candidates\n    );\n\n    const decision: AiDecision = {\n        ...(input.sceneId !== undefined\n            ? { sceneId: input.sceneId as AiDecision['sceneId'] }\n            : {}),\n        node: 'AssetMatcher',\n        // 没选中时也要留一条记录：**「什么都没选」本身就是最需要解释的结果**\n        chosen: reranked.chosen?.segmentId ?? '(无)',\n        reason: reranked.reason,\n        alternatives: reranked.alternatives.map((alt) => ({\n            assetId: alt.segmentId as AiDecision['alternatives'][number]['assetId'],\n            score: alt.score,\n            rejected: alt.rejected\n        }))\n    };\n\n    return {\n        chosen: reranked.chosen,\n        candidates,\n        decision,\n        reranked: reranked.reranked,\n        issues: reranked.issues,\n        usage: reranked.usage\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * 按 repair 回边的反馈收紧约束，供下一轮重试用（plan.md §6.1）。\n *\n * 纯函数。收紧的两件事：\n * 1. **排除上一轮选中的片段**——不排除的话重试会原封不动再选它一遍\n * 2. **抬高时长下限**——校验失败往往就是因为\"选中的片段不够长\"\n */\nexport function tightenConstraints(\n    previous: MatchConstraints | undefined,\n    feedback: { rejectedSegmentId?: string; needMs?: number }\n): MatchConstraints {\n    const excluded = new Set(previous?.excludeSegmentIds ?? []);\n    if (feedback.rejectedSegmentId) excluded.add(feedback.rejectedSegmentId);\n\n    return {\n        ...previous,\n        excludeSegmentIds: [...excluded].sort()\n    };\n}\n"
}

  "new_string": "/** repair 回边带回来的结构化失败原因（plan.md §6.1 的那个形状） */\nexport interface RepairFeedback {\n    /** 上一轮选中但被校验否掉的片段 */\n    rejectedSegmentId?: string;\n    /** 校验算出来的真实需求时长。比如「这一镜要 8200ms，选中的只有 5400ms」 */\n    needMs?: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * 按 repair 反馈算出下一轮的检索输入（plan.md §6.1）。\n *\n * 纯函数，返回**完整的下一轮输入**而不是零散的约束片段——时长下限住在\n * `SceneSearchInput` 上、排除列表住在 `constraints` 里，只返回后者的话\n * 调用方还得自己记得改前者，迟早漏。\n *\n * 收紧两件事：\n * 1. **排除上一轮选中的片段**——不排除的话重试会原封不动再选它一遍，\n *    这是最容易写出死循环的地方\n * 2. **抬高时长下限**——校验失败最常见的原因就是\"选中的片段不够长\"。\n *    只取更严的那个，repair 不该把条件放松\n */\nexport function applyRepairFeedback(\n    previous: SceneMatchInput,\n    feedback: RepairFeedback\n): SceneMatchInput {\n    const excluded = new Set(previous.constraints?.excludeSegmentIds ??   "content": "import { mkdtemp } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { tmpdir } from 'node:os';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { MediaIndexDb } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\nimport type {\n    ProbeResult,\n    SearchHit\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\nimport { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nimport { MockModelProvider } from '@/llm';\nimport {\n    applyRepairFeedback,\n    buildRerankPrompt,\n    buildSearchQuery,\n    embedAssetText,\n    formatCandidates,\n    matchSceneAssets,\n    rerankCandidates,\n    searchAssetSegments\n} from '@/matching';\n\n/**\n * 素材匹配的测试。\n *\n * 用**真的 SQLite 库 + 真的 FTS5 + Mock provider**：把检索也 mock 掉的话，\n * 「硬过滤真的生效了吗」「中文检索真的命中了吗」这两件 B5 的核心问题就测不到。\n */\n\nconst baseProbe: ProbeResult = {\n    durationMs: 12_000,\n    width: 1920,\n    height: 1080,\n    fps: 30,\n    videoCodec: 'h264',\n    hasAudio: true\n};\n\nlet dir = '';\nlet db: MediaIndexDb;\n\ninterface Seed {\n    name: string;\n    description: string;\n    tags: string[];\n    durationMs?: number;\n    width?: number;\n    height?: number;\n    hasAudio?: boolean;\n}\n\nfunction seed(spec: Seed): string {\n    const filePath = path.join(dir, spec.name);\n    const probe: ProbeResult = {\n        ...baseProbe,\n        ...(spec.durationMs !== undefined ? { durationMs: spec.durationMs } : {}),\n        ...(spec.width !== undefined ? { width: spec.width } : {}),\n        ...(spec.height !== undefined ? { height: spec.height } : {}),\n        ...(spec.hasAudio !== undefined ? { hasAudio: spec.hasAudio } : {})\n    };\n    const { id } = db.upsertScannedFile({\n        path: filePath,\n        sizeBytes: 1,\n        mtimeMs: 1\n    });\n    db.saveProbe(id, probe);\n    const ids = db.replaceSegments(id, filePath, [\n        { startMs: 0, durationMs: probe.durationMs }\n    ]);\n    const segmentId = ids[0]!;\n    db.saveSegmentTags(segmentId, {\n        description: spec.description,\n        tags: spec.tags\n    });\n    return segmentId;\n}\n\n/** 一个总是选第 N 个候选的 provider */\nfunction pickNth(n: number): MockModelProvider {\n    return new MockModelProvider({\n        responders: {\n            AssetMatcher: (req: { user: string }) => {\n                const ids = [...req.user.matchAll(/id=(seg_\\w+)/g)].map(\n                    (m) => m[1]!\n                );\n                return {\n                    chosenAssetId: ids[n] ?? 'seg_不存在',\n                    reason: `选了第 ${n + 1} 个`,\n                    alternatives: ids\n                        .filter((_, i) => i !== n)\n                        .map((id) => ({\n    * Walks the parent chain (not `list({ before })`): for forked threads, only

   * return contract is fixed here.

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/packages/video-agent/src/tts/mock.ts",
  "content": "import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport type { TtsProvider, TtsRequest, TtsResult } from './types';\n\n/**\n * 无凭证、无网络的 TTS。\n *\n * **不是玩具。** P1 的全部验收都靠它跑（tasks.md 阶段划分：「TTS 用 Mock」），\n * 所以它必须做对两件事：\n *\n * 1. **时长分布接近真人语速**——排出来的时间线才有意义。\n *    时长估错，整条时间线就全错（§3.1 时间轴由音频驱动）\n * 2. **产出真实可读的 WAV 文件**——下游 ffprobe 量时长时能量到，\n *    而不是在 P3 才发现\"原来 Mock 写的是空文件\"\n */\n\n/**\n * 中文口播语速。\n *\n * 4.5 字/秒 ≈ 270 字/分钟，是新闻播报到日常口播的常见区间。\n * 真人会更慢一些，但 Mock 的目的是让时间线\"像那么回事\"，不是复刻某个人。\n */\nconst CHARS_PER_SECOND = 4.5;\n/** 半角字符按半个中文字算——英文单词读起来比汉字快 */\nconst HALF_WIDTH_WEIGHT = 0.5;\n/** 每句话前后的自然停顿 */\nconst PADDING_MS = 300;\n/** 再短的句子也得有这么长，否则会切出零长 clip */\nconst MIN_DURATION_MS = 500;\n\nconst SAMPLE_RATE = 24_000;\nconst CHANNELS = 1;\nconst BITS_PER_SAMPLE = 16;\n\nfunction isFullWidth(codePoint: number): boolean {\n    return (\n        (codePoint >= 0x2e80 && codePoint <= 0xa4cf) ||\n        (codePoint >= 0xac00 && codePoint <= 0xd7a3) ||\n        (codePoint >= 0xf900 && codePoint <= 0xfaff) ||\n        (codePoint >= 0xfe30 && codePoint <= 0xfe6f) ||\n        (codePoint >= 0xff00 && codePoint <= 0xff60)\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * 按字数估时长。**纯函数**，单独可测——这是 Mock 唯一有实质内容的部分。\n *\n * 标点不计入朗读时长，但会贡献停顿，所以统一折进 `PADDING_MS`，\n * 不逐个标点加时间（那样长句会被累加出离谱的长度）。\n */\nexport function estimateDurationMs(text: string): number {\n    let weight = 0;\n    for (const char of text) {\n        const code = char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0;\n        // 标点与空白不发声\n        if (/[\\s，。！？、；：,.!?;:…—\"'「」（）()]/u.test(char)) continue;\n        weight += isFullWidth(code) ? 1 : HALF_WIDTH_WEIGHT;\n    }\n    if (weight === 0) return MIN_DURATION_MS;\n    return Math.max(\n        MIN_DURATION_MS,\n        Math.round((weight / CHARS_PER_SECOND) * 1000) + PADDING_MS\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * 生成一个**真正合法**的 16bit PCM 静音 WAV。\n *\n * 不是写个空文件了事：下游要用 ffprobe 量时长（§10.1 不信元数据），\n * 空文件会让那一步在 P2 才炸，而那时已经看不出是 Mock 的锅。\n */\nexport function buildSilentWav(durationMs: number): Buffer {\n    const frames = Math.max(1, Math.round((durationMs / 1000) * SAMPLE_RATE));\n    const blockAlign = (CHANNELS * BITS_PER_SAMPLE) / 8;\n    const dataSize = frames * blockAlign;\n\n    const header = Buffer.alloc(44);\n    header.write('RIFF', 0, 'ascii');\n    header.writeUInt32LE(36 + dataSize, 4);\n    header.write('WAVE', 8, 'ascii');\n    header.write('fmt ', 12, 'ascii');\n    header.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); // fmt 块长度\n    header.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); // PCM\n    header.writeUInt16LE(CHANNELS, 22);\n    header.writeUInt32LE(SAMPLE_RATE, 24);\n    header.writeUInt32LE(SAMPLE_RATE * blockAlign, 28); // 字节率\n    header.writeUInt16LE(blockAlign, 32);\n    header.writeUInt16LE(BITS_PER_SAMPLE, 34);\n    header.write('data', 36, 'ascii');\n    header.writeUInt32LE(dataSize, 40);\n\n    // 静音 = 全零采样\n    return Buffer.concat([header, Buffer.alloc(dataSize)]);\n}\n\nexport interface MockTtsOptions {\n    /** 音频落盘目录 */\n    outDir: string;\n    /** 覆盖时长估算，用于测试特定时长 */\n    estimate?: (text: string) => number;\n}\n\nexport class MockTtsProvider implements TtsProvider {\n    readonly name = 'mock';\n    readonly model = 'mock-tts';\n\n    private readonly outDir: string;\n    private readonly estimate: (text: string) => number;\n\n    /** 收到过的请求，供测试断言 */\n    readonly calls: TtsRequest[] = [];\n\n    constructor(options: MockTtsOptions) {\n        this.outDir = options.outDir;\n        this.estimate = options.estimate ?? estimateDurationMs;\n    }\n\n    async synthesize(request: TtsRequest): Promise<TtsResult> {\n        this.calls.push(request);\n        const durationMs = this.estimate(request.text);\n\n        await mkdir(this.outDir, { recursive: true });\n        // 文件名用 scriptHash：同一段文案永远落到同一个文件，\n        // 这正是 §6.2 增量失效想要的性质\n        const file = path.join(this.outDir, `${request.scriptHash}.wav`);\n        await writeFile(file, buildSilentWav(durationMs));\n\n        return {\n            path: file,\n            durationMs,\n            // **刻意不返回 wordTimings**：真 TTS 是否返回还没确认（待决 #3），\n            // Mock 假装有的话，B7 那条\"没有时间戳\"的分支就永远跑不到\n            provider: {\n                name: this.name,\n                model: this.model,\n                voiceId: request.voiceId\n            }\n        };\n    }\n}\n"
}
