'@langchain/core/runnables';\nimport sqlite3 from 'node-sqlite3-wasm';\n\n/**\n * 落在 SQLite 上的 LangGraph checkpointer（plan.md §9.4）。\n *\n * ## 为什么要自己写\n *\n * 官方的 `@langchain/langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite` 依赖 **better-sqlite3**，\n * 而 B3 已经明确避开原生模块（plan.md §8.2）：原生模块要为 Electron 重编译，\n * 编译完 vitest 就加载不了，反之亦然。为了一个 checkpointer 把那个问题放回来不划算。\n *\n * 这里用与索引库同一个驱动 `node-sqlite3-wasm`，实现 `BaseCheckpointSaver` 的\n * 五个抽象方法。`getDeltaChannelHistory` 与 `getNextVersion` 走基类默认实现。\n *\n * ## 与 §9.1 铁律的关系\n *\n * **checkpoint 是派生的运行态，不是工程的真源。** 工程的唯一真源始终是\n * `project.json`。删掉 checkpoint 只应导致\"这次运行要重来\"，\n * 不应损失任何已保存的工程。\n */\n\nconst { Database } = sqlite3;\ntype SqliteDatabase = InstanceType<typeof Database>;\ntype Row = Record<string, unknown>;\n\nconst DDL = `\ncreate table if not exists checkpoints (\n    thread_id     text not null,\n    checkpoint_ns text not null default '',\n    checkpoint_id text not null,\n    parent_id     text,\n    type          text,\n    checkpoint    blob not null,\n    metadata      blob not null,\n    primary key (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id)\n);\n\ncreate table if not exists checkpoint_writes (\n    thread_id     text not null,\n    checkpoint_ns text not null default '',\n    checkpoint_id text not null,\n    task_id       text not null,\n    idx           integer not null,\n    channel       text not null,\n    type          text,\n    value         blob,\n    primary key (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, task_id, idx)\n);\n\ncreate index if not exists idx_checkpoints_thread\n    on checkpoints(thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id desc);\n`;\n\ninterface ConfigurableParts {\n    threadId: string;\n    checkpointNs: string;\n    checkpointId?: string;\n}\n\nfunction readConfig(config: RunnableConfig): ConfigurableParts {\n    const configurable = (config.configurable ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const threadId = configurable['thread_id'];\n    if (typeof threadId !== 'string' || threadId.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('checkpointer 需要 configurable.thread_id');\n    }\n    const ns = configurable['checkpoint_ns'];\n    const id = configurable['checkpoint_id'];\n    return {\n        threadId,\n        checkpointNs: typeof ns === 'string' ? ns : '',\n        ...(typeof id === 'string' && id.length > 0 ? { checkpointId: id } : {})\n    };\n}\n\nfunction toConfig(\n    threadId: string,\n    checkpointNs: string,\n    checkpointId: string\n): RunnableConfig {\n    return {\n        configurable: {\n            thread_id: threadId,\n            checkpoint_ns: checkpointNs,\n            checkpoint_id: checkpointId\n        }\n    };\n}\n\n/** node-sqlite3-wasm 的 blob 读出来是 Uint8Array；serde 要的也是它 */\nfunction asBytes(value: unknown): Uint8Array {\n    if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return value;\n    if (typeof value === 'string') return new TextEncoder().encode(value);\n    throw new Error('checkpoint 存储里读到了非二进制的值');\n}\n\nexport class SqliteWasmSaver extends BaseCheckpointSaver {\n    private readonly db: SqliteDatabase;\n\n    private constructor(db: SqliteDatabase, serde?: SerializerProtocol) {\n        super(serde);\n        this.db = db;\n    }\n\n    /** `:memory:` 用于测试；给路径则落盘 */\n    static open(file: string, serde?: SerializerProtocol): SqliteWasmSaver {\n        const db = new Database(file);\n        db.run('pragma foreign_keys = on');\n        db.exec(DDL);\n        return new SqliteWasmSaver(db, serde);\n    }\n\n    close(): void {\n        this.db.close();\n    }\n\n    async getTuple(config: RunnableConfig): Promise<CheckpointTuple | undefined> {\n        const { threadId, checkpointNs, checkpointId } = readConfig(config);\n\n        // 不给 checkpoint_id 就取最新的一个：LangGraph 恢复线程时走这条\n        const row = (\n            checkpointId\n                ? this.db.get(\n                      `select * from checkpoints\n                        where thread_id = ? and checkpoint_ns = ? and checkpoint_id = ?`,\n                      [threadId, checkpointNs, checkpointId]\n                  )\n                : this.db.get(\n                      `select * from checkpoints\n                        where thread_id = ? and checkpoint_ns = ?\n                        order by checkpoint_id desc limit 1`,\n                      [threadId, checkpointNs]\n                  )\n        ) as Row | null;\n\n        if (!row) return undefined;\n\n        const id = String(row['checkpoint_id']);\n        const type = row['type'] === null ? undefined : String(row['type']);\n\n        const checkpoint = (await this.serde.loadsTyped(\n            type ?? 'json',\n            asBytes(row['checkpoint'])\n        )) as Checkpoint;\n        const metadata = (await this.serde.loadsTyped(\n            type ?? 'json',\n            asBytes(row['metadata'])\n        )) as CheckpointMetadata;\n\n        const writeRows = this.db.all(\n            `select task_id, channel, type, value from checkpoint_writes\n              where thread_id = ? and checkpoint_ns = ? and checkpoint_id = ?\n              order by task_id, idx`,\n            [threadId, checkpointNs, id]\n        ) as Row[];\n\n        const pendingWrites: CheckpointTuple['pendingWrites'] = [];\n        for (const write of writeRows) {\n            pendingWrites.push([\n                String(write['task_id']),\n                String(write['channel']),\n                await this.serde.loadsTyped(\n                    write['type'] === null ? 'json' : String(write['type']),\n                    asBytes(write['value'])\n                )\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        const parentId = row['parent_id'];\n        return {\n            config: toConfig(threadId, checkpointNs, id),\n            checkpoint,\n            metadata,\n            ...(typeof parentId === 'string' && parentId.length > 0\n                ? { parentConfig: toConfig(threadId, checkpointNs, parentId) }\n                : {}),\n            pendingWrites\n        };\n    }\n\n    async *list(\n        config: RunnableConfig,\n        options?: CheckpointListOptions\n    ): AsyncGenerator<CheckpointTuple> {\n        const { threadId, checkpointNs } = readConfig(config);\n        const params: (string | number)[] = [threadId, checkpointNs];\n        let sql = `select checkpoint_id from checkpoints\n                    where thread_id = ? and checkpoint_ns = ?`;\n\n        if (options?.before?.configurable?.['checkpoint_id']) {\n            sql += ' and checkpoint_id < ?';\n            params.push(String(options.before.configurable['checkpoint_id']));\n        }\n        // 新的在前：LangGraph 拿列表是为了找最近的状态\n        sql += ' order by checkpoint_id desc';\n        if (options?.limit !== undefined) {\n            sql += ' limit ?';\n            params.push(options.limit);\n        }\n\n        const rows = this.db.all(sql, params) as Row[];\n        for (const row of rows) {\n            const tuple = await this.getTuple(\n                toConfig(threadId, checkpointNs, String(row['checkpoint_id']))\n            );\n            if (tuple) yield tuple;\n        }\n    }\n\n    async put(\n        config: RunnableConfig,\n        checkpoint: Checkpoint,\n        metadata: CheckpointMetadata,\n        _newVersions: ChannelVersions\n    ): Promise<RunnableConfig> {\n        const { threadId, checkpointNs, checkpointId } = readConfig(config);\n\n        const [type, checkpointBytes] = await this.serde.dumpsTyped(checkpoint);\n        const [metadataType, metadataBytes] =\n            await this.serde.dumpsTyped(metadata);\n        if (type !== metadataType) {\n            // 两边用同一个 type 列存，序列化器给出不同类型就存不下来\n            throw new Error(\n                `checkpoint 与 metadata 的序列化类型不一致：${type} / ${metadataType}`\n            );\n        }\n\n        this.db.run(\n            `insert or replace into checkpoints\n                (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, parent_id, type, checkpoint, metadata)\n             values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n            [\n                threadId,\n                checkpointNs,\n                checkpoint.id,\n                checkpointId ?? null,\n                type,\n                checkpointBytes,\n                metadataBytes\n            ]\n        );\n\n        return toConfig(threadId, checkpointNs, checkpoint.id);\n    }\n\n    async putWrites(\n        config: RunnableConfig,\n        writes: PendingWrite[],\n        taskId: string\n    ): Promise<void> {\n        const { threadId, checkpointNs, checkpointId } = readConfig(config);\n        if (!checkpointId) {\n            throw new Error('putWrites 需要 configurable.checkpoint_id');\n        }\n\n        for (const [index, write] of writes.entries()) {\n            const [channel, value] = write;\n            const [type, bytes] = await this.serde.dumpsTyped(value);\n            // 特殊写（如错误）映射到负索引，避免与普通写撞主键——\n            // 这是 WRITES_IDX_MAP 存在的全部理由\n            const idx = WRITES_IDX_MAP[channel] ?? index;\n            this.db.run(\n                `insert or replace into checkpoint_writes\n                    (thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, task_id, idx, channel, type, value)\n                 values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n                [\n                    threadId,\n                    checkpointNs,\n                    checkpointId,\n                    taskId,\n                    idx,\n                    channel,\n                    type,\n                    bytes\n                ]\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    async deleteThread(threadId: string): Promise<void> {\n        this.db.run('delete from checkpoint_writes where thread_id = ?', [\n            threadId\n        ]);\n        this.db.run('delete from checkpoints where thread_id = ?', [threadId]);\n    }\n}\n"
}

*/\n    audioPath?: string;\n    durationMs?: number;\n\n    /** DurationAlign 产出 */\n    startMs?: number;\n\n    /** 这一镜是否已被判定为无法处理，跳过但不阻塞其余（§6.1 第 4 级降级） */\n    abandoned?: boolean;\n prompt: Annotation<string>({\n        reducer: (_, b) => b,\n        default: () => ''\n    }),\n    brief: Annotation<CreativeBrief | null>({\n        reducer: (_, b) => b,\n        default: () =>   "content": "import type { MediaIndexDb } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\n\nimport type { ModelProvider } from '../llm/types';\nimport type { MusicTrackSpec } from '../music';\nimport type { SubtitleLayoutOptions } from '../subtitle';\nimport type { TtsProvider } from '../tts/types';\n\n/**\n * 图运行时需要的全部外部依赖。\n *\n * **全部通过参数注入，不在节点里 new。** 这样整张图在没有凭证、没有网络的\n * 情况下也能跑（Mock provider + 内存库），而这正是 P1 全部验收的前提。\n */\nexport interface GraphDeps {\n    db: MediaIndexDb;\n    model: ModelProvider;\n    tts: TtsProvider;\n    /** 音色。从配置读，不写死（plan.md §10） */\n    voiceId: string;\n    /** 工程落盘目录 */\n    projectDir: string;\n    /** 画布。P1 锁定横屏 1920×1080 30fps（plan.md §2） */\n    canvas?: { width: number; height: number; fps: number };\n    subtitle?: Partial<SubtitleLayoutOptions>;\n    musicLibrary?: readonly MusicTrackSpec[];\n    /** repair 最多试几轮。超限走第 4 级降级而不是死循环 */\n    maxRepairAttempts?: number;\n    /** 交给 LLM 精排的候选数上限 */\n    topK?: number;\n    onEvent?: (event: GraphEvent) => void;\n}\n\n/**\n * 图的可观测事件（plan.md §12）。\n *\n * **不含凭证、不含完整提示词**——事件会一路转发到渲染层。\n */\nexport type GraphEvent =\n    | { type: 'node_start'; node: string }\n    | { type: 'node_finish'; node: string }\n    | { type: 'progress'; node: string; done: number; total: number; label?: string }\n    | { type: 'decision'; node: string; summary: string }\n    | { type: 'awaiting_input'; node: string; payload: unknown }\n    | { type: 'warning'; node: string; message: string }\n    | { type: 'error'; node: string; message: string }\n    | { type: 'finished'; savedPath: string };\n\nexport const DEFAULT_CANVAS = { width: 1920, height: 1080, fps: 30 } as const;\nexport const DEFAULT_MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS = 3;\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/packages/video-agent/src/graph/nodes.ts",
  "content": "import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { interrupt } from '@langchain/langgraph';\nimport type {\n    AiDecision,\n    VideoProject\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';\nimport {\n    saveProject,\n    validateProject,\n    videoProjectSchema\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project/node';\n\nimport { creativeBriefSchema, scenePlanSchema } from '../llm/schemas';\nimport { applyRepairFeedback, matchSceneAssets } from '../matching';\nimport { buildMusicClipSpec, selectMusicTrack } from '../music';\nimport { layoutSubtitles } from '../subtitle';\nimport type { GraphDeps } from './deps';\nimport { DEFAULT_CANVAS, DEFAULT_MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS } from './deps';\nimport type {\n    AgentStateType,\n    AgentStateUpdate,\n    RepairRequest,\n    WorkingScene\n} from './state';\n\n/**\n * 图的节点实现（plan.md §6 的 13 个节点）。\n *\n * 绝大多数节点是 B1–B8 的**薄包装**——这正是把那些能力先独立建好的收益：\n * 每一块都已单独测过、单独变异过，这里只负责串起来和处理状态流转。\n *\n * 严守 plan.md §3.2：时长计算、时间线排布、轨道对齐、JSON 校验全部是普通代码，\n * LLM 只做拆分镜、写文案、在候选里做语义选择这三件事。\n */\n\nconst pad2 = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(2, '0');\n\nexport function hashScript(script: string): string {\n    return `sha256:${createHash('sha256').update(script).digest('hex').slice(0, 32)}`;\n}\n\nfunction emit(deps: GraphDeps, event: Parameters<NonNullable<GraphDeps['onEvent']>>[0]): void {\n    deps.onEvent?.(event);\n}\n\n/** 包一层：每个节点自动发 start/finish 事件，不用在 13 个地方各写一遍 */\nfunction node<T>(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    name: string,\n    body: () => Promise<T>\n): Promise<T> {\n    emit(deps, { type: 'node_start', node: name });\n    return body().then((result) => {\n        emit(deps, { type: 'node_finish', node: name });\n        return result;\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 1. CollectInput ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function collectInput(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    input: { runId: string; prompt: string }\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'CollectInput', async () => {\n        if (!input.prompt.trim()) {\n            throw new Error('提示词为空，无从创作');\n        }\n        return { runId: input.runId, prompt: input.prompt };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 2/3. AssetScan / AssetUnderstand ─────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 素材就绪检查。\n *\n * **刻意不在图里重扫 3000 个文件。** 索引由 `media-index` 的命令离线建好\n * （B3/B4），图只确认\"库里有可用的东西\"。每次创作都重扫一遍既慢又没必要，\n * 而且会把一个 IO 密集的长任务塞进一个本该几秒跑完的图里。\n *\n * 检查**失败要立刻报清楚**：库是空的就早说，别等跑到 AssetMatcher\n * 才以\"一个候选都没有\"的形式冒出来。\n */\nexport function assetReadiness(deps: GraphDeps): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'AssetScan', async () => {\n        const stats = deps.db.stats();\n        if (stats.segments === 0) {\n            throw new Error(\n                '素材库是空的。请先跑 media-index 的 index 命令建立索引。'\n            );\n        }\n        if (stats.tagged === 0) {\n            emit(deps, {\n                type: 'warning',\n                node: 'AssetUnderstand',\n                message: `${stats.segments} 个片段都还没打标，只能按文件名检索，匹配质量会很差`\n            });\n        } else if (stats.tagged < stats.segments) {\n            emit(deps, {\n                type: 'warning',\n                node: 'AssetUnderstand',\n                message: `${stats.segments - stats.tagged} 个片段尚未打标`\n            });\n        }\n        return {};\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 4. CreativeBrief ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function creativeBrief(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'CreativeBrief', async () => {\n        const result = await deps.model.invokeStructured({\n            task: 'CreativeBrief',\n            schema: creativeBriefSchema,\n            system: '你是短视频策划，从一句需求里提炼创作方向。',\n            user: state.prompt,\n            // 提炼方向需要权衡，值得让模型想一下\n            thinking: 'enabled'\n        });\n        emit(deps, {\n            type: 'decision',\n            node: 'CreativeBrief',\n            summary: `主题「${result.value.theme}」，情绪「${result.value.mood}」`\n        });\n        return { brief: result.value };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 5. ScenePlanner ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function scenePlanner(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'ScenePlanner', async () => {\n        const brief = state.brief;\n        const result = await deps.model.invokeStructured({\n            task: 'ScenePlanner',\n            schema: scenePlanSchema,\n            system: '你是短视频分镜策划。',\n            user: [\n                `原始需求：${state.prompt}`,\n                brief ? `主题：${brief.theme}` : '',\n                brief ? `受众：${brief.audience}` : '',\n                brief ? `基调：${brief.tone}` : '',\n                brief ? `要点：${brief.keyPoints.join('；')}` : '',\n                '',\n                '拆成若干分镜，每一镜给出目标、配音文案、画面意图。'\n            ]\n                .filter(Boolean)\n                .join('\\n'),\n            thinking: 'enabled'\n        });\n\n        // scriptHash 在这里就算好：后面所有增量失效判断都靠它（§6.2）\n        const scenes: WorkingScene[] = result.value.scenes.map((scene) => ({\n            goal: scene.goal,\n            script: scene.script,\n            visualIntent: scene.visualIntent,\n            scriptHash: hashScript(scene.script)\n        }));\n\n        emit(deps, {\n            type: 'decision',\n            node: 'ScenePlanner',\n            summary: `拆出 ${scenes.length} 个分镜`\n        });\n        return { scenes };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 6. SceneApproval（中断）──────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface SceneApprovalPayload {\n    scenes: { goal: string; script: string; visualIntent: string }[];\n}\n\n/** 用户的答复。`scripts` 给了就按它覆盖文案 */\nexport interface SceneApprovalAnswer {\n    action: 'approve' | 'modify';\n    scripts?: string[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 分镜确认（中断点）。\n *\n * 用户改了文案之后**只重算 hash 变了的那几镜**（§6.2）——\n * 没有这套，人工介入就是一次等好几分钟又花一次钱，会很快被弃用。\n */\nexport function sceneApproval(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): AgentStateUpdate {\n    const payload: SceneApprovalPayload = {\n        scenes: state.scenes.map((s) => ({\n            goal: s.goal,\n            script: s.script,\n            visualIntent: s.visualIntent\n        }))\n    };\n    emit(deps, { type: 'awaiting_input', node: 'SceneApproval', payload });\n\n    const answer = interrupt<SceneApprovalPayload, SceneApprovalAnswer>(payload);\n    if (answer.action === 'approve' || !answer.scripts) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    const scenes = state.scenes.map((scene, i) => {\n        const next = answer.scripts?.[i];\n        if (next === undefined || next === scene.script) return scene;\n        return {\n            ...scene,\n            script: next,\n            scriptHash: hashScript(next),\n            // 文案变了，这一镜的配音与时长作废；素材选择保留，\n            // 由 DurationAlign 之后的校验决定还够不够长\n            audioPath: undefined,\n            durationMs: undefined\n        };\n    });\n    return { scenes };\n}\n\n// ── 7. AssetMatcher ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 素材匹配。\n *\n * 第一轮给所有分镜匹配；repair 回流时**只重匹配出问题的那几镜**，\n * 其余保持不动——全量重匹配会把已经确认过的选择也推翻。\n */\nexport function assetMatcher(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'AssetMatcher', async () => {\n        const repairsByIndex = new Map(\n            state.repairs.map((r) => [r.sceneIndex, r])\n        );\n        const isRepair = repairsByIndex.size > 0;\n        const scenes = [...state.scenes];\n        const decisions: AiDecision[] = [];\n\n        for (const [index, scene] of scenes.entries()) {\n            if (scene.abandoned) continue;\n            if (isRepair && !repairsByIndex.has(index)) continue;\n            if (!isRepair && scene.segmentId) continue;\n\n            emit(deps, {\n                type: 'progress',\n                node: 'AssetMatcher',\n                done: index + 1,\n                total: scenes.length,\n                label: scene.goal\n            });\n\n            const repair = repairsByIndex.get(index);\n            // 配音还没合成时，用文案字数粗估一个下限；\n            // 真正的时长要求由 repair 回边带回来（§6.1）\n            const baseMs = scene.durationMs ?? estimateFloorMs(scene.script);\n\n            let input = {\n                sceneId: `scene_${pad2(index + 1)}`,\n                visualIntent: scene.visualIntent,\n                script: scene.script,\n                minDurationMs: baseMs,\n                ...(deps.topK !== undefined\n                    ? { constraints: { topK: deps.topK } }\n                    : {})\n            };\n            if (repair) {\n                input = applyRepairFeedback(input, {\n                    ...(repair.rejectedSegmentId !== undefined\n                        ? { rejectedSegmentId: repair.rejectedSegmentId }\n                        : {}),\n                    ...(repair.needMs !== undefined\n                        ? { needMs: repair.needMs }\n                        : {})\n                });\n            }\n\n            const match = await matchSceneAssets(deps.db, deps.model, input);\n            decisions.push(match.decision);\n\n            for (const issue of match.issues) {\n                emit(deps, {\n                    type: 'warning',\n                    node: 'AssetMatcher',\n                    message: `${input.sceneId}：${issue.message}`\n                });\n            }\n\n            if (!match.chosen) {\n                // 第 4 级降级：标记待人工处理，**不阻塞其余分镜产出**（§6.1）\n                scenes[index] = {\n                    ...scene,\n                    abandoned: true,\n                    abandonReason: '没有满足条件的素材'\n                };\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            scenes[index] = {\n                ...scene,\n                segmentId: match.chosen.segmentId,\n                assetPath: match.chosen.path,\n                assetDurationMs: match.chosen.durationMs,\n                ...(match.chosen.width !== null\n                    ? { assetWidth: match.chosen.width }\n                    : {}),\n                ...(match.chosen.height !== null\n                    ? { assetHeight: match.chosen.height }\n                    : {})\n            };\n        }\n\n        return { scenes, decisions, repairs: [] };\n    });\n}\n\n/** 配音还没合成时的时长粗估，只用来做检索的硬下限 */\nfunction estimateFloorMs(script: string): number {\n    // 按 5 字/秒粗算，再打八折——宁可放进来多一点候选，也不要过早排除\n    return Math.max(1000, Math.round((script.length / 5) * 1000 * 0.8));\n}\n\n// ── 8. MatchApproval（中断）─────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface MatchApprovalPayload {\n    matches: {\n        goal: string;\n        segmentId: string | null;\n        assetPath: string | null;\n        abandoned: boolean;\n    }[];\n}\n\nexport interface MatchApprovalAnswer {\n    action: 'approve' | 'reject';\n    /** 要求换素材的分镜序号 */\n    rejectedIndexes?: number[];\n}\n\nexport function matchApproval(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): AgentStateUpdate {\n    const payload: MatchApprovalPayload = {\n        matches: state.scenes.map((s) => ({\n            goal: s.goal,\n            segmentId: s.segmentId ?? null,\n            assetPath: s.assetPath ?? null,\n            abandoned: s.abandoned ?? false\n        }))\n    };\n    emit(deps, { type: 'awaiting_input', node: 'MatchApproval', payload });\n\n    const answer = interrupt<MatchApprovalPayload, MatchApprovalAnswer>(payload);\n    if (answer.action === 'approve' || !answer.rejectedIndexes?.length) {\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    // 用户否掉的那几镜走 repair 回边重新匹配，并把被否的片段排除掉\n    const repairs: RepairRequest[] = answer.rejectedIndexes.map((index) => ({\n        sceneIndex: index,\n        reason: '用户否掉了这个素材',\n        ...(state.scenes[index]?.segmentId !== undefined\n            ? { rejectedSegmentId: state.scenes[index]!.segmentId! }\n            : {})\n    }));\n    return { repairs };\n}\n\n// ── 9. Tts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 配音合成。\n *\n * **增量失效的核心**（§6.2）：`scriptHash` 没变且已有音频的分镜直接跳过。\n * TTS 按量计费，人工改一段文案就重跑全部配音，会让人再也不敢点\"修改\"。\n */\nexport function ttsNode(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'Tts', async () => {\n        const scenes = [...state.scenes];\n        let synthesized = 0;\n        let cached = 0;\n\n        for (const [index, scene] of scenes.entries()) {\n            if (scene.abandoned) continue;\n            if (scene.audioPath && scene.durationMs) {\n                cached += 1;\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            emit(deps, {\n                type: 'progress',\n                node: 'Tts',\n                done: index + 1,\n                total: scenes.length,\n                label: scene.script.slice(0, 20)\n            });\n\n            const result = await deps.tts.synthesize({\n                text: scene.script,\n                voiceId: deps.voiceId,\n                scriptHash: scene.scriptHash\n            });\n            scenes[index] = {\n                ...scene,\n                audioPath: result.path,\n                durationMs: result.durationMs\n            };\n            synthesized += 1;\n        }\n\n        if (cached > 0) {\n            emit(deps, {\n                type: 'decision',\n                node: 'Tts',\n                summary: `新合成 ${synthesized} 段，命中缓存 ${cached} 段`\n            });\n        }\n        return { scenes };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 10. DurationAlign ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 按配音真实时长反推每一镜的起点（§3.1）。\n *\n * **纯计算**。分镜首尾相接，累加得到每镜的 `startMs`——\n * 这就是不变量 3 与 4 的来源。\n */\nexport function durationAlign(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'DurationAlign', async () => {\n        let cursor = 0;\n        const scenes = state.scenes.map((scene) => {\n            if (scene.abandoned) return scene;\n            const next = { ...scene, startMs: cursor };\n            cursor += scene.durationMs ?? 0;\n            return next;\n        });\n        return { scenes };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 11. TimelineAssemble ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function timelineAssemble(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'TimelineAssemble', async () => {\n        const canvas = deps.canvas ?? DEFAULT_CANVAS;\n        const usable = state.scenes.filter(\n            (s) => !s.abandoned && s.durationMs && s.assetPath\n        );\n        if (usable.length === 0) {\n            throw new Error('没有任何可用分镜，无法装配时间线');\n        }\n\n        const assets: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n        const scenes: unknown[] = [];\n        const videoClips: unknown[] = [];\n        const voiceClips: unknown[] = [];\n        const subtitleClips: unknown[] = [];\n        let cursor = 0;\n\n        usable.forEach((scene, index) => {\n            const no = pad2(index + 1);\n            const sceneId = `scene_${no}`;\n            const durationMs = scene.durationMs!;\n\n            assets[`asset_v${no}`] = {\n                kind: 'video',\n                path: path.relative(deps.projectDir, scene.assetPath!),\n                absolutePath: scene.assetPath!,\n                hash: `sha256:${scene.segmentId ?? no}`,\n                durationMs: scene.assetDurationMs ?? durationMs,\n                ...(scene.assetWidth !== undefined\n                    ? { width: scene.assetWidth }\n                    : {}),\n                ...(scene.assetHeight !== undefined\n                    ? { height: scene.assetHeight }\n                    : {})\n            };\n            assets[`asset_a${no}`] = {\n                kind: 'audio',\n                path: path.relative(deps.projectDir, scene.audioPath!),\n                absolutePath: scene.audioPath!,\n                hash: scene.scriptHash,\n                durationMs\n            };\n\n            // B7\n            const segments = layoutSubtitles({\n                script: scene.script,\n                startMs: cursor,\n                durationMs,\n      });\n            });\n\n            scenes.push({\n                id: sceneId,\n                index,\n                goal: scene.goal,\n                script: scene.script,\n                scriptHash: scene.scriptHash,\n                visualIntent: scene.visualIntent,\n                startMs: cursor,\n                durationMs,\n                refs: {\n                    video: `clip_v${no}`,\n                    voice: `clip_a${no}`,\n                    subtitle: subtitleIds\n                }\n            });\n\n            videoClips.push({\n                kind: 'video',\n                id: `clip_v${no}`,\n                sceneId,\n                assetId: `asset_v${no}`,\n                inMs: 0,\n                // 不做变速，所以 outMs - inMs 必须恰好等于 durationMs\n                outMs: durationMs,\n                startMs: cursor,\n                durationMs,\n                crop: { anchorX: 0.5, anchorY: 0.5 },\n                transform: { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0 },\n                transitions: { in: 'none', out: 'cut' }\n            });\n            voiceClips.push({\n                kind: 'voice',\n                id: `clip_a${no}`,\n                sceneId,\n                assetId: `asset_a${no}`,\n                startMs: cursor,\n                durationMs,\n                gainDb: 0,\n                provider: {\n                    name: deps.tts.name,\n                    model: deps.tts.model,\n                    voiceId: deps.voiceId\n                }\n            });\n\n            cursor += durationMs;\n        });\n\n        const totalMs = cursor;\n\n        // B8\n        const selection = selectMusicTrack({\n            ...(state.brief?.mood !== undefined ? { mood: state.brief.mood } : {}),\n            ...(state.brief?.topic !== undefined\n                ? { topic: state.brief.topic }\n                : {}),\n            totalMs,\n            ...(deps.musicLibrary ? { library: deps.musicLibrary } : {})\n        });\n        const musicClip = buildMusicClipSpec(selection.track, totalMs);\n        assets['asset_m01'] = {\n            kind: 'music',\n            path: selection.track.path,\n            absolutePath: null,\n            hash: `sha256:${selection.track.id}`,\n            durationMs: selection.track.durationMs\n        };\n\n        const now = new Date().toISOString();\n        const project = videoProjectSchema.parse({\n            schemaVersion: 1,\n            project: {\n                id: `prj_${state.runId}`,\n                title: state.brief?.theme ?? '未命名工程',\n                sourcePrompt: state.prompt,\n                createdAt: now,\n                updatedAt: now\n            },\n            canvas: { ...canvas, durationMs: totalMs, safeArea: { bottom: 120 } },\n            assets,\n            scenes,\n            tracks: [\n                { id: 'track_video', kind: 'video', clips: videoClips },\n                { id: 'track_voice', 'asset_m01',\n                            startMs: musicClip.startMs,\n                            durationMs: musicClip.durationMs,\n                            gainDb: musicClip.gainDb,\n                            fade: musicClip.fade,\n                            ducking: musicClip.ducking\n                        }\n                    ]\n                }\n            ],\n            styles: {\n                subtitle_default: {\n                    fontFamily: 'Noto Sans SC',\n                    fontSize: 42,\n                    fontWeight: 700,\n                    color: '#FFFFFF',\n                    stroke: { color: '#000000', width: 4 },\n                    align: 'center'\n                }\n            },\n            render: {\n                container: 'mp4',\n                videoCodec: 'h264',\n                audioCodec: 'aac',\n                bitrateKbps: 8000,\n                preset: 'medium'\n            },\n            ai: {\n                runId: state.runId,\n                graphVersion: '1.0.0',\n                approvals: [],\n                decisions: state.decisions,\n                failures: state.scenes\n                    .filter((s) => s.abandoned)\n                    .map((s, i) => ({\n                        node: 'AssetMatcher',\n                        reason: s.abandonReason ?? '未知',\n                        attempts: state.repairAttempts,\n                        resolution: '已跳过该分镜，待人工处理',\n                        sceneId: `scene_${pad2(i + 1)}`\n                    }))\n            }\n        }) as VideoProject;\n\n        return { project };\n    });\n}\n\n// ── 12. Validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * 校验并把失败翻译成 repair 请求（§6.1）。\n *\n * **不让 LLM 自由重试**：带结构化的失败原因回到 AssetMatcher，\n * 下一轮检索直接带上 `minDurationMs` 的硬过滤。\n */\nexport function validationNode(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'Validation', async () => {\n        const project = state.project;\n        if (!project) return { issues: [], repairs: [] };\n\n        const issues = validateProject(project);\n        if (issues.length === 0) return { issues: [], repairs: [] };\n\n        const indexById = new Map(\n            project.scenes.map((scene) => [scene.id as string, scene.index])\n        );\n        const repairs: RepairRequest[] = [];\n        for (const issue of issues) {\n            const index =\n                issue.sceneId !== undefined\n                    ? indexById.get(issue.sceneId as string)\n                    : undefined;\n            if (index === undefined) continue;\n            repairs.push({\n                sceneIndex: index,\n                reason: issue.code,\n                ...(issue.expectedMs !== undefined\n                    ? { needMs: issue.expectedMs }\n                    : {}),\n                ...(state.scenes[index]?.segmentId !== undefined\n                    ? { rejectedSegmentId: state.scenes[index]!.segmentId! }\n                    : {})\n            });\n        }\n\n        emit(deps, {\n            type: 'warning',\n            node: 'Validation',\n            message: `${issues.length} 条校验问题，${repairs.length} 条可回流重试`\n        });\n        return { issues, repairs, repairAttempts: state.repairAttempts + 1 };\n    });\n}\n\n/**\n * repair 超限时的第 4 级降级（§6.1）。\n *\n * 把还在报错的分镜标记为待人工处理，**不阻塞其余分镜产出**。\n * 没有这一步，「素材全都太短」的库会让图无限循环。\n */\nexport function abandonUnfixable(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): AgentStateUpdate {\n    const failing = new Set(state.repairs.map((r) => r.sceneIndex));\n    const scenes = state.scenes.map((scene, index) =>\n        failing.has(index)\n            ? ProjectSave ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport function projectSave(\n    deps: GraphDeps,\n    state: AgentStateType\n): Promise<AgentStateUpdate> {\n    return node(deps, 'ProjectSave', async () => {\n        const project = state.project;\n        if (!project) throw new Error('没有可保存的工程');\n\n        const file = path.join(deps.projectDir, 'project.json');\n        // B1 的原子写：临时文件 + fsync + rename\n        await saveProject(file, project);\n        emit(deps, { type: 'finished', savedPath: file });\n        return { savedPath: file };\n    });\n}\n\nexport const MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS = DEFAULT_MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS;\n"
}

  "content": "import type { BaseCheckpointSaver } from '@langchain/langgraph';\nimport { END, START, StateGraph } from '@langchain/langgraph';\n\nimport type { GraphDeps } from './deps';\nimport { DEFAULT_MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS } from './deps';\nimport {\n    abandonUnfixable,\n    assetMatcher,\n    assetReadiness,\n    collectInput,\n    creativeBrief,\n    durationAlign,\n    matchApproval,\n    projectSave,\n    sceneApproval,\n    scenePlanner,\n    timelineAssemble,\n    ttsNode,\n    validationNode\n} from './nodes';\nimport type { AgentStateType } from './state';\nimport { AgentState } from './state';\n\n/**\n * 主管图（plan.md §6）。\n *\n * ```\n *  CollectInput → AssetScan → CreativeBrief → ScenePlanner\n *    → ⏸SceneApproval → AssetMatcher → ⏸MatchApproval\n *    → Tts → DurationAlign → TimelineAssemble → Validation\n *         ↘ repair 回边 ↗                          ↓\n *                                              ProjectSave\n * ```\n *\n * **图里唯一的环是 `Validation → AssetMatcher`**（§3.1：时长回流会推翻已做的\n * 素材匹配）。环必须有出口，出口是 `abandonUnfixable`——重试超限就标记待人工处理，\n * 而不是继续转（§6.1）。\n */\n\nexport interface BuildGraphOptions {\n    deps: GraphDeps;\n    checkpointer?: BaseCheckpointSaver;\n}\n\nexport function buildAgentGraph(options: BuildGraphOptions) {\n    const { deps } = options;\n    const maxAttempts = deps.maxRepairAttempts ?? DEFAULT_MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS;\n\n    const builder = new StateGraph(AgentState)\n        .addNode('CollectInput', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            collectInput(deps, { runId: state.runId, prompt: state.prompt })\n        )\n        .addNode('AssetScan', () => assetReadiness(deps))\n        .addNode('CreativeBrief', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            creativeBrief(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('ScenePlanner', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            scenePlanner(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('SceneApproval', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            sceneApproval(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('AssetMatcher', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            assetMatcher(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('MatchApproval', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            matchApproval(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('Tts', (state: AgentStateType) => ttsNode(deps, state))\n        .addNode('DurationAlign', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            durationAlign(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('TimelineAssemble', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            timelineAssemble(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('Validation', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            validationNode(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('AbandonUnfixable', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            abandonUnfixable(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addNode('ProjectSave', (state: AgentStateType) =>\n            projectSave(deps, state)\n        )\n        .addEdge(START, 'CollectInput')\n        .addEdge('CollectInput', 'AssetScan')\n        .addEdge('AssetScan', 'CreativeBrief')\n        .addEdge('CreativeBrief', 'ScenePlanner')\n        .addEdge('ScenePlanner', 'SceneApproval')\n        .addEdge('SceneApproval', 'AssetMatcher')\n        .addEdge('AssetMatcher', 'MatchApproval')\n        // 用户在 MatchApproval 否掉素材 → 回 AssetMatcher 重挑\n        .addConditionalEdges(\n            'MatchApproval',\n            (state: AgentStateType) =>\n                state.repairs.length > 0 ? 'AssetMatcher' : 'Tts',\n            { AssetMatcher: 'AssetMatcher', Tts: 'Tts' }\n        )\n        .addEdge('Tts', 'DurationAlign')\n        .addEdge('DurationAlign', 'TimelineAssemble')\n        .addEdge('TimelineAssemble', 'Validation')\n        /**\n         * 环的出口判定。三条分支，顺序不能乱：\n         * 1. 校验通过 → 存盘\n         * 2. 还有问题但重试没到上限 → 回 AssetMatcher（带着结构化原因）\n         * 3. 到上限了 → 放弃这几镜，**不要继续转**\n         */\n        .addConditionalEdges(\n            'Validation',\n            (state: AgentStateType) => {\n                if (state.repairs.length === 0) return 'ProjectSave';\n                return state.repairAttempts >= maxAttempts\n                    ? 'AbandonUnfixable'\n                    : 'AssetMatcher';\n            },\n            {\n                ProjectSave: 'ProjectSave',\n                AssetMatcher: 'AssetMatcher',\n                AbandonUnfixable: 'AbandonUnfixable'\n            }\n        )\n        // 放弃之后重走一遍装配：被放弃的分镜不进时间线，剩下的仍要产出合法工程\n        .addEdge('AbandonUnfixable', 'DurationAlign')\n        .addEdge('ProjectSave', END);\n\n    return options.checkpointer\n        ? builder.compile({ checkpointer: options.checkpointer })\n        : builder.compile();\n}\n\nexport type AgentGraph = ReturnType<typeof buildAgentGraph>;\n"
}

  "content": "import { z } from 'zod';\n\nimport { isKnownVoice, VOICE_CATALOG } from './voices';\n\n/**\n * TTS 配置（plan.md §10）。\n *\n * 端点、模型、音色、输出格式**一处都不写死**，全部从环境变量读。\n * 凭证只在主进程读取，绝不进渲染进程。\n */\n\nexport class TtsConfigError extends Error {\n    readonly issues: readonly string[];\n\n    constructor(issues: readonly string[]) {\n        super(`TTS 配置不可用：${issues.join('；')}`);\n        this.name = 'TtsConfigError';\n        this.issues = issues;\n    }\n}\n\nexport const ttsConfigSchema = z.object({\n    provider: z.enum(['volcano', 'mock']).default('mock'),\n    wsUrl: z.string().url(),\n    apiKey: z.string().min(1),\n    /** `X-Api-Resource-Id` 传的就是模型名——不是另一个独立的资源 ID（§4.1） */\n    model: z.string().min(1),\n    voiceId: z.string().min(1),\n    audioFormat: z.enum(['mp3', 'pcm', 'wav']).default('mp3'),\n    sampleRate: z.int().positive().default(24_000),\n    /** 音频落盘目录 */\n    outDir: z.string().min(1)\n});\n\nexport type TtsConfig = z.infer<typeof ttsConfigSchema>;\n\nconst MOCK_DEFAULTS = {\n    wsUrl: 'wss://mock.invalid/tts',\n    apiKey: 'mock',\n    model: 'mock-tts'\n} as const;\n\nexport function loadTtsConfig(\n    env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,\n    defaults: { outDir: string; voiceId: string }\n): TtsConfig {\n    const provider = env['TTS_PROVIDER'] ?? 'mock';\n    const isMock = provider === 'mock';\n\n    const raw = {\n        provider,\n        wsUrl: env['TTS_WS_URL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.wsUrl : undefined),\n        apiKey: env['TTS_API_KEY'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.apiKey : undefined),\n        model: env['TTS_MODEL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.model : undefined),\n        voiceId: env['TTS_VOICE'] ?? defaults.voiceId,\n        audioFormat: env['TTS_AUDIO_FORMAT'],\n        sampleRate: env['TTS_SAMPLE_RATE']\n            ? Number(env['TTS_SAMPLE_RATE'])\n            : undefined,\n        outDir: env['TTS_OUT_DIR'] ?? defaults.outDir\n    };\n    const cleaned = Object.fromEntries(\n        Object.entries(raw).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)\n    );\n\n    const parsed = ttsConfigSchema.safeParse(cleaned);\n    if (!parsed.success) {\n        throw new TtsConfigError(\n            parsed.error.issues.map(\n                (issue) => `${issue.path.join('.') || '(根)'}：${issue.message}`\n            )\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 音色白名单校验。\n     *\n     * **只对真 provider 生效**——Mock 不发请求，随便填什么都不会炸，\n     * 拦着它反而挡住\"没凭证也能跑通\"这条底线（tasks.md 的 P1 前提）。\n     *\n     * 对真 provider 则必须拦：配了一个不存在的音色，不校验的话要等到\n     * 第一次合成配音才收到一个看不懂的服务端错误，而那时用户已经等了半分钟。\n     */\n    if (parsed.data.provider !== 'mock' && !isKnownVoice(parsed.data.voiceId)) {\n        throw new TtsConfigError([\n            `音色 ${parsed.data.voiceId} 不在目录里。` +\n                `可用的有 ${VOICE_CATALOG.length} 个，例如 ${VOICE_CATALOG.slice(0, 3)\n                    .map((v) => `${v.id}（${v.name}）`)\n                    .join('、')}`\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    return parsed.data;\n}\n"
}

音色列表已落地,**待决 #10 关闭**。 ## 做成了两层,而不是写死 按你在消息 28 定的原则: - **`tts/voices.ts`** —— 19 个音色的目录,是**参考数据**(给界面做选择器、给校验做白名单) - **`tts/config.ts`** —— 选哪个仍然由 `TTS_VOICE` 决定 分开的实际好处:配置里填了不存在的音色 id,能在**启动阶段**就报出来,而不是等第一次合成配音才收到一个看不懂的服务端错误。这条有专门的用例,变异验证过(去掉白名单校验 → 对应用例变红)。 白名单校验**只对真 provider 生效**。Mock 不发请求,拦着它反而会挡住「没凭证也能跑通整条流水线」这条 P1 底线。 ## 分类 | 分类 | 数量 | |---|---| | 通用场景 | 14 | | 角色扮演 | 3 | | 有声阅读 | 2 | 19 个全部支持情感变化、指令遵循、ASMR —— 所以我**没**为这三项单开字段,全表取值相同的列没有区分度。哪天出现不支持的音色再加。 ## 一条容易踩的约束 所有 id 都是 `_uranus_bigtts` 后缀,对应 **2.0 代模型**(`seed-tts-2.0`)。换模型代次时音色 id 要**整批换**,混用会被服务端直接拒。有一条用例用正则钉住了这个后缀。 ## 默认音色改了 原先文档里写的是 `zh_female_gaolengyujie`(高冷御姐),我改成了 **`zh_male_cixingjieshuonan`(磁性解说男声/Morgan)** —— 它是官方标注里唯一带"解说"定位又在通用场景的音色,最贴近口播短片。这只是默认值,`TTS_VOICE` 随时覆盖。你要是偏好高冷御姐,改一行配置就行。 ## 验证 `typecheck` / `lint` / `format` 4 包通过;`test:run` **409** 通过(video-agent 191);`cspell` 152 文件 0 问题(19 个音色 id 加进了词典)。 ## 待决表现状 | # | 状态 | |---|---| | #2 `protocols.py` 二进制分帧协议 | ⛔ **仍是唯一硬阻塞**,卡 B6b 的真 TTS | | #3 是否返回词级时间戳 | 待核实(通路已按"可能没有"设计好) | | #5 每百万 token 单价 | 待查(token 数已实测) | | #10 音色列表 | ✅ **本轮关闭** | 要我继续 **B10(IPC 桥接)** 吗?或者你先把 `protocols.py` 找出来,我把真 TTS 一并做完。

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/client/agent-ipc.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * 智能体的 IPC 契约（B10）。\n *\n * ## 为什么这里重新定义一套事件类型，而不是直接复用 `GraphEvent`\n *\n * 两个理由，都不是洁癖：\n *\n * 1. **这是一道净化边界。** plan.md §12 的硬约束是「事件里不允许出现凭证或\n *    完整提示词」。有一个显式的映射函数，这条约束才有地方落实、有地方测；\n *    直接把内部事件原样 `webContents.send` 出去，将来谁往 `GraphEvent` 上加个\n *    字段都可能顺手把敏感内容送进渲染层。\n * 2. **渲染层不该知道 video-agent 的存在。** 渲染层是浏览器环境，\n *    而 video-agent 拖着 langchain、sqlite、node:fs。哪怕只是类型引用，\n *    也会把那棵依赖树拉进渲染层的类型解析里。\n *\n * 所以这个文件**不 import 任何重依赖**，只有纯类型与常量。\n */\n\nexport const AGENT_CHANNELS = {\n    /** 渲染层 → 主进程：开一次创作 */\n    start: 'magicut:agent.start',\n    /** 渲染层 → 主进程：在中断点给出答复 */\n    approve: 'magicut:agent.approve',\n    /** 渲染层 → 主进程：取消 */\n    cancel: 'magicut:agent.cancel',\n    /** 渲染层 → 主进程：拉当前状态（重连或刷新后用） */\n    state: 'magicut:agent.state',\n    /** 主进程 → 渲染层：进度事件 */\n    event: 'magicut:agent.event'\n} as const;\n\n// ── 事件 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** 需要用户确认的两个中断点 */\nexport type ApprovalNode = 'SceneApproval' | 'MatchApproval';\n\nexport interface ScenePreview {\n    goal: string;\n    script: string;\n    visualIntent: string;\n}\n\nexport interface MatchPreview {\n    goal: string;\n    segmentId: string | null;\n    /** **只给文件名，不给完整路径**——路径会暴露用户的目录结构 */\n    assetName: string | null;\n    abandoned: boolean;\n}\n\nexport type AgentRunEvent =\n    | { type: 'node_start'; runId: string; node: string }\n    | { type: 'node_finish'; runId: string; node: string }\n    | {\n          type: 'progress';\n          runId: string;\n          node: string;\n          done: number;\n          total: number;\n          label?: string;\n      }\n    | { type: 'decision'; runId: string; node: string; summary: string }\n    | {\n          type: 'awaiting_scenes';\n          runId: string;\n          scenes: ScenePreview[];\n      }\n    | {\n          type: 'awaiting_matches';\n          runId: string;\n          matches: MatchPreview[];\n      }\n    | { type: 'warning'; runId: string; node: string; message: string }\n    | { type: 'error'; runId: string; message: string }\n    | { type: 'finished'; runId: string; savedPath: string }\n    | { type: 'cancelled'; runId: string };\n\n// ── 请求与响应 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface StartRunInput {\n    prompt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface StartRunResult {\n    runId: string;\n}\n\nexport type ApprovalAnswer =\n    | { node: 'SceneApproval'; action: 'approve' }\n    | { node: 'SceneApproval'; action: 'modify'; scripts: string[] }\n    | { node: 'MatchApproval'; action: 'approve' }\n    | { node: 'MatchApproval'; action: 'reject'; rejectedIndexes: number[] };\n\nexport type RunStatus =\n    | 'running'\n    | 'awaiting_scenes'\n    | 'awaiting_matches'\n    | 'finished'\n    | 'failed'\n    | 'cancelled';\n\nexport interface RunSnapshot {\n    runId: string;\n    status: RunStatus;\n    /** 当前所在节点，供界面显示\"正在做什么\" */\n    node: string | null;\n    savedPath: string | null;\n    error: string | null;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { opendir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { loadProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project/node';\nimport type { VideoProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';\n\nimport type { ProjectSummary } from './agent-ipc';\n\n/**\n * 工程仓库：扫目录、读 `project.json`、给列表页出摘要。\n *\n * ## 为什么直接扫目录而不是查 SQLite\n *\n * plan.md §9.1 的铁律：**`project.json` 是工程的唯一真源，SQLite 里关于工程的\n * 一切都是可随时重建的缓存。** 直接扫是最不容易出错的实现——不会有双写不一致，\n * 也不会出现\"库里有但盘上没有\"的幽灵工程。\n *\n * 十几个工程的量级，扫一遍是毫秒级。等真的慢了再加缓存，\n * 到时候**不一致时仍以 JSON 为准**。\n */\n\n/** 工程目录的布局：`<root>/<dirName>/project.json` */\nexport const PROJECT_FILE = 'project.json';\n\nfunction toSummary(\n    dirName: string,\n    project: VideoProject\n): ProjectSummary {\n    return {\n        id: project.project.id,\n        title: project.project.title,\n        createdAt: project.project.createdAt,\n        updatedAt: project.project.updatedAt,\n        durationMs: project.canvas.durationMs,\n        sceneCount: project.scenes.length,\n        dirName\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * 列出所有工程，最近更新的在前。\n *\n * **单个工程读失败不影响其余**：一个手改坏了的 JSON 不该让整个项目页空掉。\n * 坏的那个直接跳过——列表页不是排错的地方，用户看到的应该是\"少了一个\"，\n * 而不是\"全没了\"。\n */\nexport async function listProjects(root: string): Promise<ProjectSummary[]> {\n    let entries;\n    try {\n        entries = await opendir(root);\n    } catch {\n        // 目录还不存在 = 一个工程都没创建过，不是错误\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    const summaries: ProjectSummary[] = [];\n    for await (const entry of entries) {\n        if (!entry.isDirectory() || entry.name.startsWith('.')) continue;\n        try {\n            const { project } = await loadProject(\n                path.join(root, entry.name, PROJECT_FILE)\n            );\n            summaries.push(toSummary(entry.name, project));\n        } catch {\n            continue;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 最近更新的在前；时间相同按目录名，保证顺序稳定可断言\n    summaries.sort((a, b) =>\n        a.updatedAt === b.updatedAt\n            ? a.dirName.localeCompare(b.dirName)\n            : b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt)\n    );\n    return summaries;\n}\n\n/** 目录名里不许出现路径分隔符或 `..`——否则读写会跑到工程根之外 */\nfunction assertSafeDirName(dirName: string): void {\n    if (\n        dirName.length === 0 ||\n        dirName.includes('/') ||\n        dirName.includes('\\\\') ||\n        dirName === '.' ||\n        dirName === '..'\n    ) {\n        throw new Error(`非法的工程目录名：${dirName}`);\n    }\n}\n\nexport async function readProject(\n    root: string,\n    dirName: string\n): Promise<VideoProject> {\n    assertSafeDirName(dirName);\n    const { project } = await loadProject(\n        path.join(root, dirName, PROJECT_FILE)\n    );\n    return project;\n}\n\n/**\n * 删除一个工程目录。\n *\n * 目录名先过一遍校验：渲染层传过来的东西**一律当不可信输入**，\n * 一个 `../../..` 就能把删除操作带到工程根之外。\n */\nexport async function removeProject(\n    root: string,\n    dirName: string\n): Promise<void> {\n    assertSafeDirName(dirName);\n    const target = path.join(root, dirName);\n    // 再兜一层：解析后的路径必须仍在工程根里面\n    const resolved = path.resolve(target);\n    if (\n        resolved !== path.resolve(root) &&\n        !resolved.startsWith(path.resolve(root) + path.sep)\n    ) {\n        throw new Error(`工程目录越界：${dirName}`);\n    }\n    await rm(target, { recursive: true, force: true });\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { Command } from '@langchain/langgraph';\nimport { MediaIndexDb } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\nimport type { GraphDeps, GraphEvent } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent';\nimport {\n    ArkChatModelProvider,\n    buildAgentGraph,\n    DEFAULT_VOICE_ID,\n    loadLlmConfig,\n    MockModelProvider,\n    MockTtsProvider,\n    SqliteWasmSaver\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent';\n\nimport type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    ApprovalAnswer,\n    MatchPreview,\n    RunSnapshot,\n    RunStatus,\n    ScenePreview\n} from './agent-ipc';\n\n/**\n * 主进程里的智能体运行器（B10）。\n *\n * ## 两条不能破的线\n *\n * 1. **凭证只在这里读，绝不进渲染层。** 渲染层能拿到的东西等同于公开（§4.3）。\n * 2. **发给渲染层的事件必须过 `toRunEvent` 这道净化**（§12）——\n *    那是\"不许出现凭证或完整提示词\"这条约束唯一落实的地方。\n */\n\n/** 中断点的原始载荷（来自 video-agent 的节点） */\ninterface ScenePayload {\n    scenes: { goal: string; script: string; visualIntent: string }[];\n}\ninterface MatchPayload {\n    matches: {\n        goal: string;\n        segmentId: string | null;\n        assetPath: string | null;\n        abandoned: boolean;\n    }[];\n}\n\n/**\n * 内部事件 → 发往渲染层的事件。\n *\n * **这是安全边界，不是格式转换。** 三件事在这里发生：\n * - `awaiting_input` 的载荷按节点拆成两种明确的事件，渲染层不用再猜 payload 形状\n * - 素材**只给文件名不给完整路径**——路径会暴露用户的目录结构\n * - 其余事件逐字段挑着抄，而不是 `{...event}` 展开。\n *   展开的话，哪天有人往 `GraphEvent` 上加个带敏感内容的字段就直接漏出去了\n */\nexport function toRunEvent(\n    runId: string,\n    event: GraphEvent\n): AgentRunEvent | null {\n    switch (event.type) {\n        case 'node_start':\n            return { type: 'node_start', runId, node: event.node };\n        case 'node_finish':\n            return { type: 'node_finish', runId, node: event.node };\n        case 'progress':\n            return {\n                type: 'progress',\n                runId,\n                node: event.node,\n                done: event.done,\n                total: event.total,\n                ...(event.label !== undefined ? { label: event.label } : {})\n            };\n        case 'decision':\n            return {\n                type: 'decision',\n                runId,\n                node: event.node,\n                summary: event.summary\n            };\n        case 'warning':\n            return {\n                type: 'warning',\n                runId,\n                node: event.node,\n                message: event.message\n            };\n        case 'error':\n            return { type: 'error', runId, message: event.message };\n        case 'finished':\n            return { type: 'finished', runId, savedPath: event.savedPath };\n        case 'awaiting_input': {\n            if (event.node === 'SceneApproval') {\n                const payload = event.payload as ScenePayload;\n                const scenes: ScenePreview[] = payload.scenes.map((scene) => ({\n                    goal: scene.goal,\n                    script: scene.script,\n                    visualIntent: scene.visualIntent\n                }));\n                return { type: 'awaiting_scenes', runId, scenes };\n            }\n            const payload = event.payload as MatchPayload;\n            const matches: MatchPreview[] = payload.matches.map((match) => ({\n                goal: match.goal,\n                segmentId: match.segmentId,\n                // 只给文件名：完整路径会暴露用户的目录结构\n                assetName: match.assetPath\n                    ? path.basename(match.assetPath)\n                    : null,\n                abandoned: match.abandoned\n            }));\n            return { type: 'awaiting_matches', runId, matches };\n        }\n        default:\n            return null;\n    }\n}\n\nexport interface AgentRunnerOptions {\n    /** 素材索引库路径 */\n    indexDbPath: string;\n    /** checkpoint 库路径 */\n    checkpointDbPath: string;\n    /** 工程根目录，每次创作在下面建一个子目录 */\n    projectsRoot: string;\n    /** 配音落盘目录 */\n    audioDir: string;\n    /** 事件出口。主进程接到 `webContents.send` */\n    emit: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void;\n    env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;\n}\n\ninterface RunRecord {\n    runId: string;\n    status: RunStatus;\n    node: string | null;\n    savedPath: string | null;\n    error: string | null;\n    projectDir: string;\n    graph: ReturnType<typeof buildAgentGraph>;\n    db: MediaIndexDb;\n    saver: SqliteWasmSaver;\n}\n\nexport class AgentRunner {\n    private readonly options: AgentRunnerOptions;\n    private readonly runs = new Map<string, RunRecord>();\n\n    constructor(options: AgentRunnerOptions) {\n        this.options = options;\n    }\n\n    /** 当前有哪些运行。主窗口重开后靠它恢复界面 */\n    snapshot(runId: string): RunSnapshot | null {\n        const run = this.runs.get(runId);\n        if (!run) return null;\n        return {\n            runId: run.runId,\n            status: run.status,\n            node: run.node,\n            savedPath: run.savedPath,\n            error: run.error\n        };\n    }\n\n    async start(prompt: string): Promise<{ runId: string }> {\n        const runId = `run_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 12)}`;\n        const projectDir = path.join(this.options.projectsRoot, runId);\n\n        const env = this.options.env ?? process.env;\n        // 凭证只在这里读。配置非法要在**开跑之前**报出来，\n        // 而不是等跑到第 4 个节点才崩\n        const llmConfig = loadLlmConfig(env);\n\n        const db = MediaIndexDb.open(this.options.indexDbPath);\n        const saver = SqliteWasmSaver.open(this.options.checkpointDbPath);\n\n        const deps: GraphDeps = {\n            db,\n            model:\n                llmConfig.provider === 'ark'\n                    ? new ArkChatModelProvider({ config: llmConfig })\n                    : new MockModelProvider(),\n            // 真 TTS 仍卡在待决 #2 的二进制分帧协议，P1 用 Mock（tasks.md 阶段划分）\n            tts: new MockTtsProvider({ outDir: this.options.audioDir }),\n            voiceId: env['TTS_VOICE'] ?? DEFAULT_VOICE_ID,\n            projectDir,\n            onEvent: (event) => this.handle(runId, event)\n        };\n\n        const run: RunRecord = {\n            runId,\n            status: 'running',\n            node: null,\n            savedPath: null,\n            error: null,\n            projectDir,\n            graph: buildAgentGraph({ deps, checkpointer: saver }),\n            db,\n            saver\n        };\n        this.runs.set(runId, run);\n\n        // **不 await**：图会停在第一个中断点，而界面要立刻拿到 runId 开始显示进度\n        void this.drive(run, { runId, prompt });\n        return { runId };\n    }\n\n    async approve(runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer): Promise<void> {\n        const run = this.runs.get(runId);\n        if (!run) throw new Error(`没有这个运行：${runId}`);\n        if (run.status !== 'awaiting_scenes' && run.status !== 'awaiting_matches') {\n            throw new Error(`运行 ${runId} 当前不在等待确认（${run.status}）`);\n        }\n\n        run.status = 'running';\n        const resume =\n            answer.node === 'SceneApproval'\n                ? answer.action === 'modify'\n                    ? { action: 'modify', scripts: answer.scripts }\n                    : { action: 'approve' }\n                : answer.action === 'reject'\n                  ? {\n                        action: 'reject',\n                        rejectedIndexes: answer.rejectedIndexes\n                    }\n                  : { action: 'approve' };\n\n        void this.drive(run, new Command({ resume }));\n    }\n\n    async cancel(runId: string): Promise<void> {\n        const run = this.runs.get(runId);\n        if (!run) return;\n        run.status = 'cancelled';\n        this.options.emit({ type: 'cancelled', runId });\n        this.dispose(run);\n    }\n\n    /** 关窗或退出时释放所有运行持有的数据库句柄 */\n    disposeAll(): void {\n        for (const run of this.runs.values()) this.dispose(run);\n        this.runs.clear();\n    }\n\n    private dispose(run: RunRecord): void {\n        try {\n            run.db.close();\n        } catch {\n            /* 已经关过了 */\n        }\n        try {\n            run.saver.close();\n        } catch {\n            /* 已经关过了 */\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 推一次图，直到它停下来（中断或跑完）。\n     *\n     * 图抛错时**必须转成 error 事件**，否则就是一个没人接的 rejection，\n     * 界面上表现为\"进度条卡住，永远不动\"。\n     */\n    private async drive(run: RunRecord, input: unknown): Promise<void> {\n        const config = {\n            configurable: { thread_id: run.runId },\n            // 图里有 repair 环，默认 25 步不够\n            recursionLimit: 80\n        };\n        try {\n            await run.graph.invoke(input as never, config);\n\n            const state = await run.graph.getState(config);\n            if (state.next.length === 0 && run.status === 'running') {\n                run.status = 'finished';\n                this.dispose(run);\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            const message =\n                error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            run.status = 'failed';\n            run.error = message;\n            this.options.emit({ type: 'error', runId: run.runId, message });\n            this.dispose(run);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private handle(runId: string, event: GraphEvent): void {\n        const run = this.runs.get(runId);\n        if (!run) return;\n\n        if (event.type === 'node_start') run.node = event.node;\n        if (event.type === 'awaiting_input') {\n            run.status =\n                event.node === 'SceneApproval'\n                    ? 'awaiting_scenes'\n                    : 'awaiting_matches';\n        }\n        if (event.type === 'finished') {\n            run.savedPath = event.savedPath;\n        }\n\n        const wire = toRunEvent(runId, event);\n        if (wire) this.options.emit(wire);\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/client/ipc.ts",
  "content": "import path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { app, ipcMain } from 'electron';\nimport type { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';\n\nimport { AGENT_CHANNELS, PROJECT_CHANNELS } from './agent-ipc';\nimport type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    ApprovalAnswer,\n    ProjectSummary,\n    StartRunInput,\n    StartRunResult\n} from './agent-ipc';\nimport { AgentRunner } from './agent-runner';\nimport { listProjects, removeProject } from './project-store';\n\n/**\n * IPC 注册（B10）。\n *\n * 链路按 `magicut-electron-bridge` 的约定走，**四处同步**：\n * `ipcMain.handle`（这里）→ preload `invoke` → `magicut.env.d.ts` 全局类型\n * → eslint globals。漏一处就是\"渲染层调了个不存在的方法\"。\n *\n * ⚠️ **凭证只在主进程读**（`.env` 经 dotenv 载入 `process.env`），\n * 一个字节都不往渲染层送。\n */\n\nexport interface AppPaths {\n    /** 所有工程的根目录 */\n    projectsRoot: string;\n    /** 素材索引库 */\n    indexDbPath: string;\n    /** checkpoint 库 */\n    checkpointDbPath: string;\n    /** 配音落盘目录 */\n    audioDir: string;\n}\n\nexport function resolveAppPaths(\n    env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env\n): AppPaths {\n    // userData 是 Electron 给每个应用的可写目录，跨平台都对\n    const base = app.getPath('userData');\n    return {\n        projectsRoot: env['MAGICUT_PROJECTS_DIR'] ?? path.join(base, 'projects'),\n        indexDbPath:\n            env['MEDIA_INDEX_DB'] ?? path.join(base, 'media-index', 'index.db'),\n        checkpointDbPath: path.join(base, 'agent', 'checkpoints.db'),\n        audioDir: path.join(base, 'audio')\n    };\n}\n\n/** 从任意错误里取一条能给用户看的消息 */\nfunction messageOf(error: unknown): string {\n    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n}\n\nexport function registerIpc(\n    getWindow: () => BrowserWindow | null,\n    paths: AppPaths\n): AgentRunner {\n    const send = (event: AgentRunEvent): void => {\n        const win = getWindow();\n        // 窗口已经关了就别发——往销毁的 webContents 上 send 会抛\n        if (win && !win.isDestroyed()) {\n            win.webContents.send(AGENT_CHANNELS.event, event);\n        }\n    };\n\n    const runner = new AgentRunner({\n        indexDbPath: paths.indexDbPath,\n        checkpointDbPath: paths.checkpointDbPath,\n        projectsRoot: paths.projectsRoot,\n        audioDir: paths.audioDir,\n        emit: send\n    });\n\n    ipcMain.handle(\n        AGENT_CHANNELS.start,\n        async (_event, input: StartRunInput): Promise<StartRunResult> =>\n            runner.start(input.prompt)\n    );\n\n    ipcMain.handle(\n        AGENT_CHANNELS.approve,\n        async (_event, runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer) => {\n            await runner.approve(runId, answer);\n        }\n    );\n\n    ipcMain.handle(AGENT_CHANNELS.cancel, async (_event, runId: string) => {\n        await runner.cancel(runId);\n    });\n\n    ipcMain.handle(AGENT_CHANNELS.state, async (_event, runId: string) =>\n        runner.snapshot(runId)\n    );\n\n    ipcMain.handle(\n        PROJECT_CHANNELS.list,\n        async (): Promise<ProjectSummary[]> => listProjects(paths.projectsRoot)\n    );\n\n    ipcMain.handle(\n        PROJECT_CHANNELS.remove,\n        async (_event, dirName: string) => {\n            // 目录名来自渲染层，**一律当不可信输入**——\n            // 越界校验在 project-store 里\n            await removeProject(paths.projectsRoot, dirName);\n        }\n    );\n\n    return runner;\n}\n\nexport { messageOf };\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/client/preload.ts",
  "content": "import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from 'electron';\n\nimport { AGENT_CHANNELS, PROJECT_CHANNELS } from './agent-ipc';\nimport type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    ApprovalAnswer,\n    ProjectSummary,\n    RunSnapshot,\n    StartRunResult\n} from './agent-ipc';\n\n// 新增能力时按 magicut-electron-bridge skill 的链路走，**四处同步**：\n// ipcMain.handle → 此处 invoke → magicut.env.d.ts 全局类型 → eslint globals。\nconst magicutAPI = {\n    ping: async () => ({ pong: true }),\n\n    videoAgent: {\n        start: (prompt: string): Promise<StartRunResult> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.start, { prompt }),\n\n        approve: (runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer): Promise<void> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.approve, runId, answer),\n\n        cancel: (runId: string): Promise<void> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.cancel, runId),\n\n        state: (runId: string): Promise<RunSnapshot | null> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.state, runId),\n\n        /**\n         * 订阅进度事件。\n         *\n         * **必须返回退订函数。** 不返回的话，每次切页面都会再挂一个监听，\n         * 监听器只增不减——表现为进度条越跳越快、事件重复处理\n         * （plan.md §12.3 专门写过这条）。\n         */\n        onEvent: (listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void): (() => void) => {\n            const handler = (\n                _event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent,\n                payload: AgentRunEvent\n            ): void => listener(payload);\n            ipcRenderer.on(AGENT_CHANNELS.event, handler);\n            return () => {\n                ipcRenderer.off(AGENT_CHANNELS.event, handler);\n            };\n        }\n    },\n\n    projects: {\n        list: (): Promise<ProjectSummary[]> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(PROJECT_CHANNELS.list),\n\n        remove: (dirName: string): Promise<void> =>\n            ipcRenderer.invoke(PROJECT_CHANNELS.remove, dirName)\n    }\n};\n\nexport type MagicutApi = typeof magicutAPI;\n\ncontextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('magicutAPI', magicutAPI);\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/client/main.ts",
  "content": "import path from 'node:path';\n\nimport { config as loadDotenv } from 'dotenv';\nimport { app, BrowserWindow } from 'electron';\nimport started from 'electron-squirrel-startup';\n\nimport { registerIpc, resolveAppPaths } from './ipc';\nimport type { AgentRunner } from './agent-runner';\n\nif (started) {\n    app.quit();\n}\n\n// 凭证从 .env 进 process.env，**只在主进程**。\n// 渲染层拿得到的东西等同于公开（plan.md §4.3），一个字节都不往那边送。\nloadDotenv({ path: path.resolve(app.getAppPath(), '../../.env'), quiet: true });\nloadDotenv({ quiet: true });\n\nlet mainWindow: BrowserWindow | null = null;\nlet runner: AgentRunner | null = null;\n\nconst createWindow = () => {\n    mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({\n        width: 1440,\n        height: 900,\n        backgroundColor: '#09090b',\n        webPreferences: {\n            preload: path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js')\n        }\n    });\n\n    mainWindow.on('closed', () => {\n        mainWindow = null;\n    });\n\n    if (MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL) {\n        mainWindow.loadURL(MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    mainWindow.loadFile(\n        path.join(__dirname, `../renderer/${MAIN_WINDOW_VITE_NAME}/index.html`)\n    );\n};\n\napp.whenReady().then(() => {\n    runner = registerIpc(() => mainWindow, resolveAppPaths());\n    createWindow();\n\n    app.on('activate', () => {\n        if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) {\n            createWindow();\n        }\n    });\n});\n\n// 退出前释放数据库句柄。不释放的话 wasm 那边的文件锁会留到进程被杀\napp.on('will-quit', () => {\n    runner?.disposeAll();\n});\n\napp.on('window-all-closed', () => {\n    if (process.platform !== 'darwin') {\n        app.quit();\n    }\n});\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/renderer/data/bridge.ts",
  "content": "import type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    ApprovalAnswer,\n    ProjectSummary,\n    StartRunResult\n} from '@/client/agent-ipc';\n\n/**\n * 主进程桥接的访问层。\n *\n * ## 为什么不直接用 `window.magicutAPI`\n *\n * 渲染层有三种运行环境，只有第一种有桥：\n *\n * | 环境 | 有 `magicutAPI` 吗 |\n * |---|---|\n * | Electron 里真跑 | 有 |\n * | vitest + jsdom（组件测试） | **没有** |\n * | `pnpm ui:shot` 的离屏浏览器 | **没有** |\n *\n * 组件里散着写 `window.magicutAPI?.xxx` 的话，后两种环境下的行为就成了\n * 一堆隐式的 undefined 分支，测起来全是噪声。收在这里，\n * **\"没有桥\"变成一个明确的状态**，页面可以据此显示\"请在桌面端打开\"。\n */\n\nexport interface AgentBridge {\n    start(prompt: string): Promise<StartRunResult>;\n    approve(runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer): Promise<void>;\n    cancel(runId: string): Promise<void>;\n    /** 返回退订函数。不退订的话监听器会随页面切换越积越多（§12.3） */\n    onEvent(listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void): () => void;\n}\n\nexport interface ProjectBridge {\n    list(): Promise<ProjectSummary[]>;\n    remove(dirName: string): Promise<void>;\n}\n\nfunction api(): Window['magicutAPI'] | null {\n    return typeof window === 'undefined' ? null : (window.magicutAPI ?? null);\n}\n\n/** 有没有桥。页面用它区分\"还没加载完\"与\"根本不在桌面端\" */\nexport function hasBridge(): boolean {\n    return api() !== null;\n}\n\nexport function agentBridge(): AgentBridge | null {\n    return api()?.videoAgent ?? null;\n}\n\nexport function projectBridge(): ProjectBridge | null {\n    return api()?.projects ?? null;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type { ProjectSummary } from '@/client/agent-ipc';\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';\n\nimport { projectBridge } from '@/renderer/data/bridge';\n\n/**\n * 真实工程列表。\n *\n * 数据来自主进程扫 `project.json`（plan.md §9.1：JSON 是唯一真源）。\n * 桌面端之外（组件测试、`ui:shot` 的离屏浏览器）没有桥，此时返回\n * `unavailable`——**而不是空列表**：两者对用户的含义完全不同，\n * 一个是\"你还没有项目\"，一个是\"这里看不到项目\"。\n */\n\nexport type ProjectsState =\n    | { status: 'loading' }\n    | { status: 'unavailable' }\n    | { status: 'ready'; projects: ProjectSummary[] }\n    | { status: 'failed'; message: string };\n\nexport interface UseProjects {\n    state: ProjectsState;\n    reload: () => void;\n    remove: (dirName: string) => Promise<void>;\n}\n\nexport function useProjects(): UseProjects {\n    const [state, setState] = useState<ProjectsState>({ status: 'loading' });\n\n    const load = useCallback(() => {\n        const bridge = projectBridge();\n        if (!bridge) {\n            setState({ status: 'unavailable' });\n            return;\n        }\n        setState({ status: 'loading' });\n        bridge\n            .list()\n            .then((projects) => setState({ status: 'ready', projects }))\n            .catch((error: unknown) =>\n                setState({\n                    status: 'failed',\n                    message:\n                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                })\n            );\n    }, []);\n\n    useEffect(load, [load]);\n\n    const remove = useCallback(\n        async (dirName: string) => {\n            const bridge = projectBridge();\n            if (!bridge) return;\n            await bridge.remove(dirName);\n            // 删完重新拉一次，而不是本地过滤：\n            // 盘上到底删没删成，只有再扫一遍才知道\n            load();\n        },\n        [load]\n    );\n\n    return { state, reload: load, remove };\n}\n\n/** `2026-09-23T10:00:00+08:00` → `创建时间 2026-09-23` */\nexport function formatCreatedAt(iso: string): string {\n    const date = new Date(iso);\n    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '创建时间 未知';\n    const y = date.getFullYear();\n    const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n    const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n    return `创建时间 ${y}-${m}-${d}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * 封面兜底渐变。\n *\n * 真实工程没有封面图（P1 不做抽帧封面）。按 id 取一组确定性配色，\n * 同一个工程在任何时候都是同一张\"封面\"——用 `Math.random` 的话\n * 每次渲染都换色，看着像 bug。\n */\nconst COVERS: readonly (readonly [string, string])[] = [\n    ['#1B1033', '#0B1F3A'],\n    ['#3A2A18', '#1A2230'],\n    ['#10262B', '#0E1A2E'],\n    ['#2E1630', '#161B33'],\n    ['#132A1C', '#101C2A'],\n    ['#2B1414', '#1C1526']\n];\n\nexport function coverFor(id: string): readonly [string, string] {\n    let hash = 2166136261;\n    for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i += 1) {\n        hash ^= id.charCodeAt(i);\n        hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);\n    }\n    return COVERS[(hash >>> 0) % COVERS.length]!;\n}\n"
}

import {
    createHashRouter,
    Navigate,
    type RouteObject,
    useNavigate,
    useParams
} from 'react-router-dom';

import { projects } from '../data/project-fixtures';
import EditorPage from '../pages/EditorPage';
import RouteError from '../pages/RouteError';
import WorkspaceLayout from '../pages/WorkspaceLayout';

/**
 * 编辑器的路由入口，`/`、`/editor`、`/editor/:projectId` 三条都走它。
 *
 * 这里做两件路由层的事，再把结果作为普通 props 交给 EditorPage：
 * - 把 :projectId 解析成工程名（id 对不上就退回默认标题，不报错也不白屏）
 * - 注入「回首页」的导航
 *
 * 解析与导航都不放进页面里，EditorPage 才能脱离 Router 直接渲染，
 * 组件测试不用为了这两样去套 RouterProvider。
 */
function EditorRoute() {
    const { projectId } = useParams();
