  "content": "import type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    MatchPreview,\n    ScenePreview\n} from '@/client/agent-ipc';\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\n\nimport { agentBridge } from '@/renderer/data/bridge';\n\n/**\n * 一次创作的进度状态（B10）。\n *\n * 事件从主进程推过来，这里只做累积与归类。**不在这里做任何业务判断**——\n * 图的状态机在主进程，渲染层重复一份只会两边不一致。\n */\n\nexport type RunPhase =\n    | 'idle'\n    | 'unavailable'\n    | 'running'\n    | 'awaiting_scenes'\n    | 'awaiting_matches'\n    | 'finished'\n    | 'failed';\n\nexport interface RunLogItem {\n    /** 用 `${type}:${节点}:${序号}` 做 key，节点会重复出现（repair 环） */\n    key: string;\n    text: string;\n    kind: 'step' | 'decision' | 'warning';\n}\n\nexport interface AgentRunState {\n    phase: RunPhase;\n    runId: string | null;\n    /** 当前节点，界面上显示\"正在做什么\" */\n    node: string | null;\n    log: RunLogItem[];\n    scenes: ScenePreview[];\n    matches: MatchPreview[];\n    savedPath: string | null;\n    error: string | null;\n}\n\nconst INITIAL: AgentRunState = {\n    phase: 'idle',\n    runId: null,\n    node: null,\n    log: [],\n    scenes: [],\n    matches: [],\n    savedPath: null,\n    error: null\n};\n\n/** 节点名 → 界面上说人话的进度描述 */\nconst NODE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {\n    CollectInput: '读取输入',\n    AssetScan: '检查素材库',\n    CreativeBrief: '提炼创作方向',\n    ScenePlanner: '拆分镜、写文案',\n    SceneApproval: '等你确认分镜',\n    AssetMatcher: '匹配素材',\n    MatchApproval: '等你确认素材',\n    Tts: '合成配音',\n    DurationAlign: '对齐时间轴',\n    TimelineAssemble: '装配时间线',\n    Validation: '校验工程',\n    AbandonUnfixable: '跳过配不上的分镜',\n    ProjectSave: '保存工程'\n};\n\nexport function labelOfNode(node: string): string {\n    return NODE_LABELS[node] ?? node;\n}\n\nexport interface UseAgentRun extends AgentRunState {\n    available: boolean;\n    start: (prompt: string) => Promise<void>;\n    approveScenes: (scripts?: string[]) => Promise<void>;\n    approveMatches: (rejectedIndexes?: number[]) => Promise<void>;\n    cancel: () => Promise<void>;\n    reset: () => void;\n}\n\nexport function useAgentRun(): UseAgentRun {\n    const [state, setState] = useState<AgentRunState>(INITIAL);\n    // 事件序号只用来生成稳定 key，不进渲染逻辑，所以放 ref 不放 state\n    const seq = useRef(0);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        const bridge = agentBridge();\n        if (!bridge) {\n            setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, phase: 'unavailable' }));\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // **必须退订。** 不退订的话每次挂载都会再加一个监听器，\n        // 切几次页面之后同一个事件会被处理多次（plan.md §12.3）\n        return bridge.onEvent((event) => {\n            seq.current += 1;\n            setState((prev) => reduce(prev, event, seq.current));\n        });\n    }, []);\n\n    const start = useCallback(async (prompt: string) => {\n        const bridge = agentBridge();\n        if (!bridge) return;\n        seq.current = 0;\n        setState({ ...INITIAL, phase: 'running' });\n        try {\n            const { runId } = await bridge.start(prompt);\n            setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, runId }));\n        } catch (error) {\n            setState((prev) => ({\n                ...prev,\n                phase: 'failed',\n                error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n            }));\n        }\n    }, []);\n\n    const answer = useCallback(\n        async (\n            payload: Parameters<NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof agentBridge>>['approve']>[1]\n        ) => {\n            const bridge = agentBridge();\n            if (!bridge || !state.runId) return;\n            // 先切回 running，按钮才不会在等待响应时还能再点一次\n            setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, phase: 'running' }));\n            try {\n                await bridge.approve(state.runId, payload);\n            } catch (error) {\n                setState((prev) => ({\n                    ...prev,\n                    phase: 'failed',\n                    error:\n                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                }));\n            }\n        },\n        [state.runId]\n    );\n\n    const approveScenes = useCallback(\n        async (scripts?: string[]) => {\n            await answer(\n                scripts\n                    ? { node: 'SceneApproval', action: 'modify', scripts }\n                    : { node: 'SceneApproval', action: 'approve' }\n            );\n        },\n        [answer]\n    );\n\n    const approveMatches = useCallback(\n        async (rejectedIndexes?: number[]) => {\n            await answer(\n                rejectedIndexes && rejectedIndexes.length > 0\n                    ? {\n                          node: 'MatchApproval',\n                          action: 'reject',\n                          rejectedIndexes\n                      }\n                    : { node: 'MatchApproval', action: 'approve' }\n            );\n        },\n        [answer]\n    );\n\n    const cancel = useCallback(async () => {\n        const bridge = agentBridge();\n        if (!bridge || !state.runId) return;\n        await bridge.cancel(state.runId);\n    }, [state.runId]);\n\n    const reset = useCallback(() => {\n        seq.current = 0;\n        setState({ ...INITIAL, phase: agentBridge() ? 'idle' : 'unavailable' });\n    }, []);\n\n    return {\n        ...state,\n        available: state.phase !== 'unavailable',\n        start,\n        approveScenes,\n        approveMatches,\n        cancel,\n        reset\n    };\n}\n\n/** 纯归约。导出是为了能脱离 React 直接测事件处理 */\nexport function reduce(\n    prev: AgentRunState,\n    event: AgentRunEvent,\n    seq: number\n): AgentRunState {\n    // 只认当前这次运行的事件。上一次运行的迟到事件不该改现在的界面\n    if (prev.runId !== null && event.runId !== prev.runId) return prev;\n\n    switch (event.type) {\n        case 'node_start':\n            return {\n                ...prev,\n                node: event.node,\n                log: [\n                    ...prev.log,\n                    {\n                        key: `s:${event.node}:${seq}`,\n                        text: labelOfNode(event.node),\n                        kind: 'step'\n                    }\n                ]\n            };\n        case 'decision':\n            return {\n                ...prev,\n                log: [\n                    ...prev.log,\n                    {\n                        key: `d:${event.node}:${seq}`,\n                        text: event.summary,\n                        kind: 'decision'\n                    }\n                ]\n            };\n        case 'warning':\n            return {\n                ...prev,\n                log: [\n                    ...prev.log,\n                    {\n                        key: `w:${event.node}:${seq}`,\n                        text: event.message,\n                        kind: 'warning'\n                    }\n                ]\n            };\n        case 'awaiting_scenes':\n            return { ...prev, phase: 'awaiting_scenes', scenes: event.scenes };\n        case 'awaiting_matches':\n            return {\n                ...prev,\n                phase: 'awaiting_matches',\n                matches: event.matches\n            };\n        case 'finished':\n            return { ...prev, phase: 'finished', savedPath: event.savedPath };\n        case 'error':\n            return { ...prev, phase: 'failed', error: event.message };\n        case 'cancelled':\n            return { ...prev, phase: 'idle' };\n        default:\n            return prev;\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { AlertTriangle, Check, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\n\nimport type { UseAgentRun } from '@/renderer/data/use-agent-run';\n\n/**\n * 创作进度与两个审批点（B10）。\n *\n * 三段：**进度日志** + **分镜确认** + **素材确认**。后两段是\n * plan.md §6 里的两个中断点，图会真的停在那里等这里的答复。\n */\n\nfunction StepIcon({ kind }: { kind: 'step' | 'decision' | 'warning' }) {\n    if (kind === 'warning') {\n        return (\n            <AlertTriangle\n                size={14}\n                className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#F0B860]\"\n            />\n        );\n    }\n    if (kind === 'decision') {\n        return (\n            <Sparkles size={14} className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#8A5CFF]\" />\n        );\n    }\n    return <Check size={14} className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-cr-placeholder\" />;\n}\n\nfunction RunLog({ run }: { run: UseAgentRun }) {\n    return (\n        <ol className=\"flex max-h-[220px] flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-ed\">\n            {run.log.map((item) => (\n                <li key={item.key} className=\"flex items-start gap-2\">\n                    <StepIcon kind={item.kind} />\n                    <span\n                        className={\n                            item.kind === 'warning'\n                                ? 'text-ed-md text-[#F0B860]'\n                                : 'text-ed-md text-pj-text-2'\n                        }\n                    >\n                        {item.text}\n                    </span>\n                </li>\n            ))}\n        </ol>\n    );\n}\n\nfunction SceneApproval({ run }: { run: UseAgentRun }) {\n    const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<string[]>([]);\n\n    // 分镜到了才初始化文案；用 key 重挂载更省事，但那样输入焦点会丢\n    useEffect(() => {\n        setScripts(run.scenes.map((scene) => scene.script));\n    }, [run.scenes]);\n\n    const changed = run.scenes.some(\n        (scene, i) => scripts[i] !== undefined && scripts[i] !== scene.script\n    );\n\n    return (\n        <section aria-label=\"确认分镜\" className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\">\n            <h3 className=\"text-[19px] font-bold text-white\">\n                确认分镜（{run.scenes.length} 段）\n            </h3>\n            <ul className=\"flex max-h-[320px] flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-ed\">\n                {run.scenes.map((scene, index) => (\n                    <li\n                        key={`${scene.goal}-${index}`}\n                        className=\"flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-cr-card-border p-3.5\"\n                    >\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                            <span className=\"text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                                分镜 {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ·{' '}\n                                {scene.goal}\n                            </span>\n                            <span className=\"text-ed-xs text-cr-placeholder\">\n                                {scene.visualIntent}\n                            </span>\n                        </div>\n                        <textarea\n                            aria-label={`分镜 ${index + 1} 文案`}\n                            value={scripts[index] ?? ''}\n                            onChange={(event) =>\n                                setScripts((prev) => {\n                                    const next = [...prev];\n                                    next[index] = event.target.value;\n                                    return next;\n                                })\n                            }\n                            className=\"min-h-[64px] w-full resize-none bg-transparent text-ed-md leading-ed text-white caret-white outline-none\"\n                        />\n                    </li>\n                ))}\n            </ul>\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => void run.approveScenes()}\n                    className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white\"\n                >\n                    就这样，继续\n                </button>\n                <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    disabled={!changed}\n                    onClick={() => void run.approveScenes(scripts)}\n                    className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                >\n                    用修改后的文案\n                </button>\n                {/* 改了文案却点了「就这样」，改动就白费了。\n                    与其禁用，不如明确提示哪个按钮才是他想要的 */}\n                {changed ? (\n                    <span className=\"text-ed-sm text-[#F0B860]\">\n                        文案有改动，记得点右边那个\n                    </span>\n                ) : null}\n            </div>\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n\nfunction MatchApproval({ run }: { run: UseAgentRun }) {\n    const [rejected, setRejected] = useState<number[]>([]);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        setRejected([]);\n    }, [run.matches]);\n\n    const toggle = (index: number): void => {\n        setRejected((prev) =>\n            prev.includes(index)\n                ? prev.filter((i) => i !== index)\n                : [...prev, index]\n        );\n    };\n\n    return (\n        <section aria-label=\"确认素材\" className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\">\n            <h3 className=\"text-[19px] font-bold text-white\">确认素材匹配</h3>\n            <ul className=\"flex max-h-[320px] flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-ed\">\n                {run.matches.map((match, index) => (\n                    <li\n                        key={`${match.goal}-${index}`}\n                        className=\"flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-cr-card-border px-3.5 py-3\"\n                    >\n                        <div className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1\">\n                            <span className=\"text-ed-md text-white\">\n                                分镜 {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ·{' '}\n                                {match.goal}\n                            </span>\n                            <span className=\"truncate text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                                {match.abandoned\n                                    ? '没有配上素材，已跳过'\n                                    : (match.assetName ?? '未选中')}\n                            </span>\n                        </div>\n                        {match.abandoned ? null : (\n                            <button\n                                type=\"button\"\n                                aria-pressed={rejected.includes(index)}\n                                onClick={() => toggle(index)}\n                                className={`h-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-lg border px-4 text-ed-sm ${\n                                    rejected.includes(index)\n                                        ? 'border-[#F06AB0] text-[#F06AB0]'\n                                        : 'border-cr-card-border text-pj-text-2'\n                                }`}\n                            >\n                                {rejected.includes(index)\n                                    ? '已标记换一个'\n                                    : '换一个'}\n                            </button>\n                        )}\n                    </li>\n                ))}\n            </ul>\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => void run.approveMatches()}\n                    className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white\"\n                >\n                    就这样，继续\n                </button>\n                <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    disabled={rejected.length === 0}\n                    onClick={() => void run.approveMatches(rejected)}\n                    className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                >\n                    重挑标记的 {rejected.length} 个\n                </button>\n            </div>\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n\nexport default function RunPanel({\n    run,\n    onOpenProject\n}: {\n    run: UseAgentRun;\n    onOpenProject: () => void;\n}) {\n    if (run.phase === 'idle' || run.phase === 'unavailable') return null;\n\n    return (\n        <section\n            aria-label=\"创作进度\"\n            className=\"flex w-full max-w-[1365px] flex-col gap-6 rounded-[28px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-card px-10 py-8\"\n        >\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                {run.phase === 'running' ? (\n                    <Loader2\n                        size={18}\n                        className=\"animate-spin text-[#8A5CFF] motion-reduce:animate-none\"\n                    />\n                ) : null}\n                <h2 className=\"text-[22px] font-bold text-white\">\n                    {run.phase === 'finished'\n                        ? '创作完成'\n                        : run.phase === 'failed'\n                          ? '创作失败'\n                          : (run.node ?? '准备中')}\n                </h2>\n            </div>\n\n            <RunLog run={run} />\n\n            {run.phase === 'awaiting_scenes' ? <SceneApproval run={run} /> : null}\n            {run.phase === 'awaiting_matches' ? <MatchApproval run={run} /> : null}\n\n            {run.phase === 'failed' ? (\n                <p className=\"text-ed-md text-[#FF6B7A]\">{run.error}</p>\n            ) : null}\n\n            {run.phase === 'finished' ? (\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={onOpenProject}\n                        className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white\"\n                    >\n                        去项目列表看看\n                    </button>\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={run.reset}\n                        className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white\"\n                    >\n                        再做一条\n                    </button>\n                </div>\n            ) : null}\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import type {\n    AgentRunEvent,\n    ApprovalAnswer,\n    ProjectSummary\n} from '@/client/agent-ipc';\n\n/**\n * 装一个假的 `window.magicutAPI`。\n *\n * jsdom 里没有 Electron，所以渲染层看到的是\"没有桥\"。要测真实链路上的行为，\n * 就得把桥装上——但**装的是 preload 暴露的那个契约**，\n * 不是随便捏一个形状：契约对不上的话，测试绿了而真机上照样炸。\n */\n\nexport interface FakeBridge {\n    /** 主进程推事件。测试里手动调它来驱动进度 */\n    emit: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void;\n    /** 收到过的审批答复，供断言\"界面到底提交了什么\" */\n    approvals: { runId: string; answer: ApprovalAnswer }[];\n    /** 发起过的创作 */\n    starts: string[];\n    /** 卸载，恢复成\"没有桥\" */\n    restore: () => void;\n    /** 当前挂着的监听器数量。用来验证退订真的生效了 */\n    listenerCount: () => number;\n}\n\nexport interface FakeBridgeOptions {\n    projects?: ProjectSummary[];\n    /** 让 list 失败，测错误态 */\n    listError?: string;\n    runId?: string;\n}\n\nexport function installFakeBridge(\n    options: FakeBridgeOptions = {}\n): FakeBridge {\n    const listeners = new Set<(event: AgentRunEvent) => void>();\n    const approvals: FakeBridge['approvals'] = [];\n    const starts: string[] = [];\n    let projects = options.projects ?? [];\n\n    const api = {\n        ping: async () => ({ pong: true }),\n        videoAgent: {\n            start: async (prompt: string) => {\n                starts.push(prompt);\n                return { runId: options.runId ?? 'run_test' };\n            },\n            approve: async (runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer) => {\n                approvals.push({ runId, answer });\n            },\n            cancel: async () => undefined,\n            state: async () => null,\n            onEvent: (listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void) => {\n                listeners.add(listener);\n                return () => {\n                    listeners.delete(listener);\n                };\n            }\n        },\n        projects: {\n            list: async () => {\n                if (options.listError) throw new Error(options.listError);\n                return projects;\n            },\n            remove: async (dirName: string) => {\n                projects = projects.filter(\n                    (project) => project.dirName !== dirName\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    (window as unknown as { magicutAPI: unknown }).magicutAPI = api;\n\n    return {\n        emit: (event) => {\n            for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener(event);\n        },\n        approvals,\n        starts,\n        listenerCount: () => listeners.size,\n        restore: () => {\n            delete (window as unknown as { magicutAPI?: unknown }).magicutAPI;\n        }\n    };\n}\n\nexport function makeProject(\n    over: Partial<ProjectSummary> = {}\n): ProjectSummary {\n    return {\n        id: 'prj_demo',\n        title: '前端进阶AI Agent全栈开发学习路线详解',\n        createdAt: '2026-09-23T10:00:00+08:00',\n        updatedAt: '2026-09-23T10:42:11+08:00',\n        durationMs: 37_500,\n        sceneCount: 9,\n        dirName: 'run_demo',\n        ...over\n    };\n}\n"
}

globals（四处同步）\n- [ ] 创作页「创建」按钮接上，展示阶段进度\n- [ ] 两个审批点的 UI\n\n**DoD**：点「创建」能真实触发并看到逐阶段进度；两处审批能操作并继续。\"\"\"\n\nnew = \"\"\"## B10 — IPC 桥接与进度 ✅ 已完成\n\n- [x] 主进程 handler：`magicut:agent.start / approve / cancel / state`\n- [x] 进度事件 `magicut:agent.event`（图的 `onEvent` → `webContents.send`）\n- [x] preload 暴露 + 全局类型 + eslint globals（**四处同步**）\n- [x] 创作页「创建」真的跑一次智能体，逐阶段显示进度\n- [x] 两个审批点的 UI：分镜可改文案、素材可标记重挑\n- [x] **项目页读真实列表**（本来在 B11，一并做了）\n\n**DoD ✅**：点「创建」触发主进程的图并逐阶段显示；两处审批能操作并继续；\n跑完落盘 `project.json`，项目页能列出来。\n\n### 事件净化是一道安全边界，不是格式转换\n\n渲染层收到的**不是** `GraphEvent`，而是经 `toRunEvent` 映射过的 `AgentRunEvent`：\n\n- **逐字段挑着抄，不用 `{...event}` 展开。** 展开的话，哪天有人往 `GraphEvent`\n  上加一个带敏感内容的字段就直接漏进渲染层了——有专门的用例钉住这条\n- **素材只给文件名，不给完整路径**——路径会暴露用户的目录结构\n- 两个中断点拆成 `awaiting_scenes` / {

  "content": "import type { VideoProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\n\nimport { projectBridge } from '@/renderer/data/bridge';\n\n/**\n * 按目录名加载一个真实工程（B11）。\n *\n * 状态分得比\"有/没有\"细，因为**这四种情况对用户要说的话完全不同**：\n * 正在读、这里读不了、这个工程不存在、读出来了。统一成\"空\"会让人\n * 在浏览器里以为自己的工程丢了。\n */\n\nexport type ProjectState =\n    | { status: 'none' }\n    | { status: 'loading' }\n    | { status: 'unavailable' }\n    | { status: 'failed'; message: string }\n    | { status: 'ready'; project: VideoProject };\n\nexport function useProject(dirName: string | undefined): ProjectState {\n    const [state, setState] = useState<ProjectState>(\n        dirName ? { status: 'loading' } : { status: 'none' }\n    );\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        if (!dirName) {\n            setState({ status: 'none' });\n            return;\n        }\n        const bridge = projectBridge();\n        if (!bridge) {\n            setState({ status: 'unavailable' });\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // 切走之后迟到的响应不该再改状态——否则会把上一个工程盖到当前界面上\n        let alive = true;\n        setState({ status: 'loading' });\n        bridge\n            .load(dirName)\n            .then((project) => {\n                if (alive) setState({ status: 'ready', project });\n            })\n            .catch((error: unknown) => {\n                if (!alive) return;\n                setState({\n                    status: 'failed',\n                    message:\n                        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n                });\n            });\n\n        return () => {\n            alive = false;\n        };\n    }, [dirName]);\n\n    return state;\n}\n"
}

import { useState } from 'react';

import ConfigPanel from '@/renderer/components/editor/ConfigPanel';
import EditorHeader from '@/renderer/components/editor/EditorHeader';
import type { EditorTab } from '@/renderer/components/editor/IconRail';
import IconRail from '@/renderer/components/editor/IconRail';
import PreviewPanel from '@/renderer/components/editor/PreviewPanel';
import ScriptSidebar from '@/renderer/components/editor/ScriptSidebar';
import Timeline from '@/renderer/components/editor/Timeline';

interface EditorPageProps {
    /** 从 /editor/:projectId 带进来的工程名，不传就用设计稿里的默认值 */
    projectTitle?: string | undefined;
    /** 点左上角品牌区回首页，由路由层注入 */
    onHome?: (() => void) | undefined;
}

/**
 * 编辑器页。
 *
 * 刻意不读路由参数：解析 :projectId 的活交给路由层，这样这个组件
 * 在测试里可以脱离 Router 直接渲染。
 */
export default function EditorPage({ projectTitle, onHome }: EditorPageProps) {
    // 选中的素材类型只活在这一页里：demo 仓库还没有 IPC 偏好存储，
    // 接上之后把这行换成读写偏好的 hook 即可，其余组件不用动。
    const [tab, setTab] = useState<EditorTab>('visual');

    return (
        <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-ed-bg font-ed">
            <EditorHeader title={projectTitle} onHome={onHome} />
            {/* 设计稿里 Body 是定高 692，代码里必须是 flex-1，否则窗口一缩就溢出 */}
            <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">
                <ScriptSidebar />
                <PreviewPanel />
                <ConfigPanel tab={tab} />
                <IconRail active={tab} onChange={setTab} />
            </div>
            <Timeline />
        </div>
    );
}

真 bug,而且原因明确:serde 产出的 `Uint8Array` **来自另一个 realm**(`instanceof` 为 false),驱动的类型判断认不出来。改成 base64 文本存储 —— 字符串是原语,不受 realm 影响:

    {
        path: '/',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        path: '/editor',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        path: '/editor/:projectId',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        // 项目与创作合在这一条路由里，靠左侧胶囊导航 tab 切换。
        // 不拆成两条路由：切路由会让侧栏连同两团 blur 光晕重新挂载，视觉上闪一下。
        path: '/workspace',
        element: <WorkspaceLayout />
    },
    {
        // 兜底：匹配不上的 hash 一律回首屏，而不是掉进 React Router 的错误屏。
        // 典型场景是路由改过名之后，窗口里还留着旧 hash（比如已删掉的 #/projects），
        // 桌面端没有地址栏，用户在那一屏是走不出去的。
        path: '*',
        element: <Navigate to="/" replace />
    }
].map(withErrorBoundary);

// Electron 打包后以 file:// 加载页面，使用 hash 路由避免刷新丢失路由
export const router = createHashRouter(routes);

**B11 完成 —— P1 十一个批次全部做完。** ## 验收测试真的跑了一遍完整链路 不是"编辑器能渲染一个 fixture",而是: ``` 建素材索引 → 跑智能体图(13 节点 + 2 中断) → 落盘 project.json → 工程仓库从**盘上**读回来 → 编辑器渲染四条轨道 ``` 中间一环都没放过。只测最后一步证明不了前面九个批次串得起来。 ### P1 的三条 DoD | DoD | 验证方式 | |---|---| | 完整时间线 | 视频轨指向真实 `.mp4`、`outMs-inMs == durationMs`(不变速)、配音轨时长等于分镜时长、字幕落在各自分镜内、音乐铺满全片 | | 时间线可缩放 | 断言的是**比值** —— 第一镜比第二镜宽多少,正好等于时长比 | | 能查到「为什么选这个片段」 | 分镜卡上显示 `ai.decisions` 的理由,三镜都有 | 第二条我刻意没写成"拉了滑杆宽度变大了" —— 那种断言在片段宽度写死时也是绿的。 ## 又抓到一个只在特定环境才现形的 bug checkpointer 把序列化字节当 blob 存。`serde.dumpsTyped` 返回的 `Uint8Array` **可能来自另一个 realm** —— vitest 的 jsdom 里,被转译的模块和外部化的 node 依赖处在不同 JS 上下文,`instanceof Uint8Array` 直接是 `false`,驱动报 `Unsupported type for binding: "object"`。 改成 **base64 文本**存储:字符串是原语,不属于任何 realm。 **这个 bug 在 B9 的 25 个测试里全绿**,因为那些跑在 node 环境;只有 B11 把它拉进 jsdom 才现形。 ## 一个流程失误 我改 `EditorRoute` 时用了没有 `assert` 的字符串替换,锚点没匹配上却**静默成功**了 —— 直到测试报"标题还是 fixture 的"才发现。后面几次替换都补了断言。 ## 验证 | 项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `typecheck` / `lint` / `format` | 4 包 | | `test:run` | 56+80+191+**118** = **445** 通过 | | 变异测试 | 4 个(时间线/侧栏读 fixture、不显示理由、失败静默退回)全部捕获 | | `cspell` | 164 文件 0 问题 | | **三个产物都能构建** | 渲染层 ✅ 主进程 ✅ preload ✅ | 顺带修了假桥:它缺 `load` 方法,导致项目页两条用例红。假桥必须照搬真契约 —— 缺一个方法,测出来的就是"调用不存在的方法"而不是真实行为。 ## P1 收尾状态 | 批次 | 状态 | |---|---| | B1–B5、B6a、B7–B11 | ✅ 全部完成 | | B6b 真 TTS | ⛔ 卡待决 #2(`protocols.py` 二进制分帧协议) | **P1 的定义本来就是"TTS 用 Mock"**,所以这不算缺口 —— 但真要出声音就必须有那份协议。 ## 你现在可以做的 ```bash # 1. 索引真实素材 pnpm --filter @magicut-react-demo/media-index index -- --root ~/Movies/你的素材 # 2. 打标（先小跑 20 个看效果） LLM_PROVIDER=ark «已打码» ARK_BASE_URL=... LLM_MODEL=... \ pnpm --filter @magicut-react-demo/video-agent tag -- --limit 20 # 3. 起桌面端，在创作页输文稿点「创建」 pnpm start ``` 还差的三件:`.env.example` 要你自己建(被权限规则挡着我写不了)、仓库根那个 `src/pipeline.ts.tmp` 要删、**那枚 key 请吊销**。 要我接着做 P2/P3,还是先跑一遍看看效果?

  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/packages/video-agent/scripts/create-project.ts",
  "content": "/**\n * 开发用的创作命令：脱离 Electron 跑一遍完整的图。\n *\n *   pnpm --filter @magicut-react-demo/video-agent create -- --prompt \"讲讲前端如何转型 AI\"\n *   pnpm --filter @magicut-react-demo/video-agent create -- --index <索引库> --out <工程目录>\n *\n * 不带 `ARK_API_KEY` 时自动走 Mock，只验证管线通不通，不产生任何费用。\n *\n * ## 为什么需要它\n *\n * B10 的 runner 绑在 Electron 的 IPC 上，**图本身没法单独跑**。\n * 排查\"是图的问题还是界面的问题\"时，没有这个命令就只能靠界面猜。\n *\n * 两个中断点在这里一律自动放行——要人工确认的流程走界面，这个命令只管跑通。\n *\n * ⚠️ 凭证只从环境变量读，**不许写进任何文件**。\n */\n\nimport path from 'node:path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';\n\nimport { Command } from '@langchain/langgraph';\nimport { MediaIndexDb } from '@magicut-react-demo/media-index';\nimport { validateProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';\n\nimport type { GraphDeps, GraphEvent } from '@/graph';\nimport { buildAgentGraph, SqliteWasmSaver } from '@/graph';\nimport type { ModelProvider } from '@/llm';\nimport { ArkChatModelProvider, loadLlmConfig, MockModelProvider } from '@/llm';\nimport { DEFAULT_VOICE_ID, MockTtsProvider } from '@/tts';\n\nconst HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nconst REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(HERE, '../../..');\n\nfunction argOf(name: string): string | undefined {\n    const index = process.argv.indexOf(`--${name}`);\n    return index === -1 ? undefined : process.argv[index + 1];\n}\n\n/* eslint-disable no-console */\nfunction render(event: GraphEvent): void {\n    switch (event.type) {\n        case 'node_start':\n            console.log(`▶ ${event.node}`);\n            break;\n        case 'progress':\n            console.log(\n                `    [${event.done}/${event.total}] ${event.label ?? ''}`\n            );\n            break;\n        case 'decision':\n            console.log(`  · ${event.summary}`);\n            break;\n        case 'warning':\n            console.log(`  ⚠ ${event.node}：${event.message}`);\n            break;\n        case 'awaiting_input':\n            console.log(`  ⏸ ${event.node}（命令行里自动放行）`);\n            break;\n        case 'finished':\n            console.log(`\\n✓ 已保存：${event.savedPath}`);\n            break;\n        default:\n            break;\n    }\n}\n\nasync function main(): Promise<void> {\n    const prompt = argOf('prompt') ?? '做一条讲前端如何转型做 AI 的口播短片';\n    const indexDb =\n        argOf('index') ?? path.join(REPO_ROOT, '.media-index', 'index.db');\n    const outRoot = argOf('out') ?? path.join(REPO_ROOT, '.projects');\n    const runId = `run_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;\n\n    const config = loadLlmConfig();\n    const model: ModelProvider =\n        config.provider === 'ark'\n            ? new ArkChatModelProvider({ config })\n            : new MockModelProvider();\n\n    console.log(\n        `provider = ${model.name}` +\n            (config.provider === 'ark'\n                ? `  model = ${config.model}  method = ${config.methods.join(' → ')}`\n                : '（没有 ARK_API_KEY，走 Mock，不产生费用）')\n    );\n    console.log(`索引库 = ${indexDb}`);\n    console.log(`提示词 = ${prompt}\\n`);\n\n    const db = MediaIndexDb.open(indexDb);\n    const saver = SqliteWasmSaver.open(path.join(outRoot, 'checkpoints.db'));\n    const projectDir = path.join(outRoot, runId);\n\n    const deps: GraphDeps = {\n        db,\n        model,\n        tts: new MockTtsProvider({ outDir: path.join(outRoot, 'audio') }),\n        voiceId: process.env['TTS_VOICE'] ?? DEFAULT_VOICE_ID,\n        projectDir,\n        onEvent: render\n    };\n\n    try {\n        const graph = buildAgentGraph({ deps, checkpointer: saver });\n        const cfg = {\n            configurable: { thread_id: runId },\n            // 图里有 repair 环，默认 25 步不够\n            recursionLimit: 80\n        };\n\n        await graph.invoke({ runId, prompt }, cfg);\n        // 中断点自动放行，直到图跑完为止\n        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i += 1) {\n            const state = await graph.getState(cfg);\n            if (state.next.length === 0) break;\n            await graph.invoke(\n                new Command({ resume: { action: 'approve' } }),\n                cfg\n            );\n        }\n\n        const final = await graph.getState(cfg);\n        const project = final.values.project;\n        if (!project) {\n            console.log('\\n✗ 没有产出工程');\n            process.exitCode = 1;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const issues = validateProject(project);\n        console.log(`\\n校验：${issues.length === 0 ? '全部通过' : issues.length + ' 条问题'}`);\n        for (const issue of issues) console.log(`  ✗ ${issue.message}`);\n\n        console.log(`分镜 ${project.scenes.length} 段，总长 ${(project.canvas.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);\n        for (const track of project.tracks) {\n            console.log(`  ${track.kind}：${track.clips.length} 个片段`);\n        }\n        console.log('\\n决策留痕：');\n        for (const decision of project.ai.decisions) {\n            console.log(`  ${decision.sceneId ?? '-'} → ${decision.chosen}`);\n            console.log(`    ${decision.reason}`);\n        }\n        if (project.ai.failures.length > 0) {\n            console.log('\\n放弃的分镜：');\n            for (const failure of project.ai.failures) {\n                console.log(`  ${failure.sceneId ?? '-'}：${failure.reason}`);\n            }\n        }\n    } finally {\n        saver.close();\n        db.close();\n    }\n}\n\nmain().catch((error: unknown) => {\n    console.error(error);\n    process.exitCode = 1;\n});\n"
}

**真模型端到端跑通了。** 在此之前 B9/B11 的验收**全是 Mock** —— 这是第一次用真模型跑完整条图。 ## 产出 ``` 提示词：做一条 30 秒的科普短片，讲电视彩条测试图是干什么用的 标题：30秒科普电视彩条测试图的实际用途 校验：全部通过 4 分镜 / 21.4s / 1920×1080 30fps 轨道：video 4 · voice 4 · subtitle 8 · music 1 [1] 0–5189 小时候看电视突然跳出这彩条⏎是不是以为电视坏了？ [2] 5189–10600 错啦！这可不是故障⏎是电视台专门播出的标准测试信号 [3] 10600–16456 它的核心作用是调试电视的⏎色彩、亮度、对比度这些显示参数 [4] 16456–21423 咱普通观众⏎也能靠它校准自家电视的显示效果哦 ``` 字幕按换行切分并落在各自分镜内,音乐铺满 21423ms,每一镜都有选材理由。 顺带说明:`sample/demo` 里只有我之前生成的**两个彩条测试片**,没有真实素材。你放进去后重跑一遍即可。 ## 实跑又修掉两个 bug **1. 数据库父目录不存在时打不开。** 驱动只给一句 `Could not open the database`,看不出是路径问题。而这**不是只有命令行才会碰到** —— 桌面端首次启动时 `userData/agent/` 和 `userData/media-index/` 本来就不存在,**首次启动必崩**。已在两个 `open` 里自动建父目录,各配一条用例。 **2. CLI 的相对路径解析错了。** `pnpm --filter` 会把 cwd 切到包目录,`--root sample` 于是指向 `packages/media-index/sample` —— 不存在,扫出 0 个文件**还不报错**。三个 CLI 统一改成按仓库根解析。 另外 `create` 这个命令名被 pnpm 内置命令抢了,改叫 `agent`。 ## 两个暴露出来的产品问题(不是 bug,要你决策) **① 四个分镜选了同一个素材。** 这次是因为库里只有 2 个片段、其中一个太短,模型自己都说「是当前唯一可选的候选素材」。但**即便库大了也没有任何机制阻止重复选用**。 要不要在精排时对已用过的素材降权?我倾向**软降权而不是硬排除** —— 重复镜头有时是合理的(呼应、回扣)。 **② 提示词里的「30 秒」完全没生效。** 成片 21.4s。全流程**没有任何一处以总时长为目标**:时长由配音真实长度累加而来(§3.1 的设计),而文案长度是模型自由发挥的。模型只是把「30秒」写进了标题。 要按时长出片,得把目标时长传给 ScenePlanner,并在时长回流后做一轮「太长就删减/太短就扩写」的回压。这是个**真功能**,不是小修。 ## 验证 `typecheck` / `lint` / `format` 4 包;`test:run` **447** 通过;`cspell` 165 文件 0 问题。 --- 这两个问题你想先解决哪个?或者继续往 P2/P3 走 —— 但 P2 的真 TTS 仍卡在 `protocols.py`,P3 的 ffmpeg 渲染卡在 GPL 与渲染位置两个待决项。

继续
Claude 2026-09-23 06:23:58
两个都做,先做小的那个 —— 素材重复选用的软降权。 **软降权而不是硬排除**:重复镜头有时是合理的(呼应、回扣),硬排除会在素材少时直接逼出「没有候选」。

'标了「本片已用过」的素材**尽量避开**，同一个片段反复出现会很单调；实在没有更合适的再选它。'\n            : '',\"\"\")\ns=s.replace(\"\"\"export interface RerankInput {\n    visualIntent: string;\n    script?: string;\n    minDurationMs: number;\n    sceneLabel?: string;\n}\"\"\",\"\"\"export interface RerankInput {\n    visualIntent: string;\n    script?: string;\n    minDurationMs: number;\n    sceneLabel?: string;\n    /** 本工程里已经用过的片段。只影响提示词措辞，不做硬排除 */\n    usedSegmentIds?: readonly string[];\n}\"\"\")\ns=s.replace(\"\"\"            user: buildRerankPrompt(\n                input.visualIntent,\n                input.script,\n                input.minDurationMs,\n                candidates\n            ),\"\"\",\"\"\"            user: buildRerankPrompt(\n                input.visualIntent,\n                input.script,\n                input.minDurationMs,\n                candidates,\n                new Set(input.usedSegmentIds ?? [])\n            ),\"\"\")\np.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')\n\n# match.ts 把 usedSegmentIds 透传\np=pathlib.Path('src/matching/match.ts'); s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')\ns=s.replace(\"\"\"        {\n            visualIntent: input.visualIntent,\n            ...(input.script !== undefined ? { script: input.script } : {}),\n            minDurationMs: input.minDurationMs\n        },\"\"\",\"\"\"        {\n            visualIntent: input.visualIntent,\n            ...(input.script !== undefined ? { script: input.script } : {}),\n            minDurationMs: input.minDurationMs,\n            ...(input.constraints?.usedSegmentIds !== undefined\n                ? { usedSegmentIds: input.constraints.usedSegmentIds }\n                : {})\n        },\"\"\")\np.write_text(s,encoding='utf-8')\nprint('降权已实现')\nPY\nnpx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -3",

Claude 2026-09-23 06:52:24
**两个产品问题都实现了,而且第二次实跑又抓到一个我自己引入的 bug。** ## 1. 素材重复选用 → 软降权 已用过的片段**排到候选末尾,但不排除**。 三条设计取舍: - **不硬排除** —— 重复镜头有时是合理的(呼应、回扣),而且素材少时硬排除会把候选直接清空,逼出「没有素材」的**假失败** - **稳定分区而不是加权** —— BM25 分值没有可比量纲,往上加个拍脑袋的惩罚分只会让排序不可解释。分成「没用过 / 用过」两段、段内保持原序,行为一眼可推 - **精排提示词里也标出「本片已用过」** —— 光在检索层降权不够,模型最终还是照语义选 变异验证:改成硬排除 → 4 条用例变红(包括「全用过时不该清空」那条)。 ## 2. 目标时长 → `DurationCheck` 回压节点 ``` Tts → DurationAlign → DurationCheck ─(改过文案)→ Tts └─(达标/到上限)→ TimelineAssemble ``` - `targetDurationSec` 从提示词**抽取**,没说就 null —— 不替用户决定他没要求的事 - 目标时长在 **ScenePlanner 规划时**就告知模型,不是事后硬改 - 超出容差(默认 ±12%)才改写;改过的分镜 hash 变了 → **§6.2 的增量失效只重跑那几镜** - **只改文案不改分镜结构** —— 增删分镜会把已确认的素材匹配全部推翻 - 容差不卡死:配音时长合成出来才知道,追求「正好 30.0 秒」只会反复改写却永远差一点 ## 第二次实跑抓到的问题 加完回压后重跑,**时长改写那次 LLM 调用超时,整个运行直接挂了** —— 四条轨道都已经做出来了,就因为调时长这一步失败而全部作废。 回压是**优化不是必需**:调不准时长,片子照样是片子。已改成失败时保留现有文案继续走,并如实发一条 warning。 这和 §6.1 是同一个道理:**单个步骤的失败不该毁掉整条产出。** 写新节点时很容易忘了补这层,因为"正常路径"跑起来一切正常。 ## 顺带看到的 那次重跑里,目标时长功能**确实生效了** —— 模型按 30 秒写了更长的文案,结果分镜时长超出了 6 秒的素材,校验报 `video_out_of_source`,repair 回流后三个分镜「没有候选」。 这不是 bug,是**素材太薄**:两个片段(6s + 3s)撑不起 30 秒的片子。你放真实素材进 `sample/demo` 后重跑就会不一样。 ## 验证 | 项 | 结果 | |---|---| | `typecheck` / `lint` / `format` | 4 包 | | `test:run` | 56+81+**207**+118 = **462** 通过 | | 变异测试 | 降权 3 个 + 时长 4 个 + 非致命 1 个,**全部捕获** | | `cspell` | 165 文件 0 问题 | --- P1 的两个产品缺口补完了。剩下的:**P2 的真 TTS 卡 `protocols.py`**,**P3 的 ffmpeg 渲染卡 GPL 与渲染位置两个待决项** —— 这三件都得你拍板。 另外那枚 key 仍然请吊销。

  "content": "import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\n/**\n * 应用设置。\n *\n * **只存用户的选择，不存凭证。** 凭证走 `.env`（plan.md §4.3），\n * 混进来的话备份、同步、误发截图都会把它带出去。\n *\n * 结构故意保持扁平且全可选：设置文件是用户可能手改的东西，\n * 少一个字段就整个读不了是不可接受的。\n */\n\nexport interface AppSettings {\n    /** 素材目录。用户在创作页选的那个 */\n    mediaRoot?: string;\n}\n\nconst FILE_NAME = 'settings.json';\n\nfunction fileOf(userDataDir: string): string {\n    return path.join(userDataDir, FILE_NAME);\n}\n\n/**\n * 读设置。\n *\n * **读不了就当空**：文件不存在是首次启动的正常情况；\n * 被手改坏了也不该让应用起不来——大不了重新选一次目录。\n */\nexport function loadSettings(userDataDir: string): AppSettings {\n    try {\n        const raw: unknown = JSON.parse(\n            readFileSync(fileOf(userDataDir), 'utf8')\n        );\n        if (typeof raw !== 'object' || raw === null) return {};\n        const mediaRoot = (raw as AppSettings).mediaRoot;\n        return typeof mediaRoot === 'string' && mediaRoot.length > 0\n            ? { mediaRoot }\n            : {};\n    } catch {\n        return {};\n    }\n}\n\n/**\n * 写设置。**原子写**：临时文件 + rename。\n *\n * 写到一半断电会留下一个半截的 JSON，下次启动就读不出目录了——\n * 同 B1 的工程写入，理由一样。\n */\nexport function saveSettings(\n    userDataDir: string,\n    settings: AppSettings\n): void {\n    mkdirSync(userDataDir, { recursive: true });\n    const target = fileOf(userDataDir);\n    // 临时文件必须在同一目录：rename 只在同一文件系统内原子\n    const temp = `${target}.tmp`;\n    writeFileSync(temp, `${JSON.stringify(settings, null, 4)}\\n`, 'utf8');\n    renameSync(temp, target);\n}\n"
}

素材库的主进程侧：选目录、建索引、打标。\n *\n * ## 为什么索引与打标分成两个动作\n *\n * **索引是本地操作，打标要花钱。** 扫描 + ffprobe + 抽帧只用 CPU 和磁盘；\n * 打标每个片段要发几千 token 的多模态请求（plan.md §11）。\n * 合成一个按钮的话，用户选个目录就可能烧掉一笔钱，而他根本不知道。\n *\n * ## 事件同样要过净化\n *\n * 进度里**只给文件名不给完整路径**——同 §12，路径会暴露用户的目录结构。\n */\n\nexport interface MediaRunnerOptions {\n    userDataDir: string;\n    indexDbPath: string;\n    keyframeDir: string;\n    emit: (event: MediaEvent) => void;\n    env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;\n}\n\nexport class MediaRunner {\n    private readonly options: MediaRunnerOptions;\n    /** 同一时刻只允许一个任务。两个索引同时写一个库只会互相打架 */\n    private busy = false;\n\n    constructor(options: MediaRunnerOptions) {\n        this.options = options;\n    }\n\n    private get root(): string | null {\n        return loadSettings(this.options.userDataDir).mediaRoot ?? null;\n    }\n\n    setRoot(root: string): MediaStatus {\n        saveSettings(this.options.userDataDir, { mediaRoot: root });\n        return this.status();\n    }\n\n    status(): MediaStatus {\n        const root = this.root;\n        const db = MediaIndexDb.open(this.options.indexDbPath);\n        try {\n            const stats = db.stats();\n            return {\n                root,\n                // 目录可能被删了或换了机器。界面要能说出\"目录不见了\"，\n                // 而不是只显示一个看着正常的路径\n                rootExists: root !== null && existsSync(root),\n                files: stats.files,\n                segments: stats.segments,\n                tagged: stats.tagged,\n                busy: this.busy\n            };\n        } finally {\n            db.close();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 扫描 + ffprobe + 抽帧。本地操作，不花钱 */\n    async index(): Promise<MediaStatus> {\n        const root = this.root;\n        if (!root) throw new Error('还没有选择素材目录');\n        if (!existsSync(root)) throw new Error(`素材目录不存在：${root}`);\n        return this.run('index', async (db) => {\n            await runIndexPipeline({\n                roots: [root],\n                db,\n                keyframeDir: this.options.keyframeDir,\n                onEvent: (event) => this.onIndexEvent(event)\n            });\n        });\n    }\n\n    /** 关键帧打标。**要调模型，按量计费** */\n    async tag(): Promise<MediaStatus> {\n        const env = this.options.env ?? process.env;\n        const config = loadLlmConfig(env);\n        const provider: ModelProvider =\n            config.provider === 'ark'\n                ? new ArkChatModelProvider({ config })\n                : new MockModelProvider({\n                      responders: {\n                          AssetTagger: {\n                              description: '（未配置模型凭证，这是占位描述）',\n                              tags: ['mock'],\n                              subjectCenterX: 0.5,\n                              subjectCenterY: 0.5,\n                              orientation: 'landscape',\n                              hasFaces: false\n                          }\n                      }\n                  });\n\n        if (config.provider !== 'ark') {\n            this.options.emit({\n                type: 'media_warning',\n                job: 'tag',\n                message:\n                    '没有配置模型凭证，打标走的是占位描述。' +\n                    '素材检索会几乎不可用——请在 .env 里配好 ARK_API_KEY'\n            });\n        }\n\n        return this.run('tag', async (db) => {\n            await runTaggingPipeline({\n                db,\n                provider,\n                onEvent: (event) => this.onTagEvent(event)\n            });\n        });\n    }\n\n    private async run(\n        job: 'index' | 'tag',\n        body: (db: MediaIndexDb) => Promise<void>\n    ): Promise<MediaStatus> {\n        if (this.busy) throw new Error('已经有一个任务在跑了');\n        this.busy = true;\n        this.options.emit({ type: 'media_started', job });\n\n        const db = MediaIndexDb.open(this.options.indexDbPath);\n        try {\n            await body(db);\n            const stats = db.stats();\n            const root = this.root;\n            const status: MediaStatus = {\n                root,\n                rootExists: root !== null && existsSync(root),\n                files: stats.files,\n                segments: stats.segments,\n                tagged: stats.tagged,\n                busy: false\n            };\n            this.options.emit({ type: 'media_finished', job, status });\n            return status;\n        } catch (error) {\n            const message =\n                error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            this.options.emit({ type: 'media_failed', job, message });\n            throw error;\n        } finally {\n            db.close();\n            this.busy = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private onIndexEvent(event: IndexEvent): void {\n        if (event.type === 'file_started') {\n            this.options.emit({\n                type: 'media_progress',\n                job: 'index',\n                done: event.done,\n                total: event.total,\n                // 只给文件名：完整路径会暴露用户的目录结构\n                label: path.basename(event.path)\n            });\n        }\n        if (event.type === 'file_failed') {\n            this.options.emit({\n                type: 'media_warning',\n                job: 'index',\n                message: `${path.basename(event.path)}：${event.message}`\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    private onTagEvent(event: TagEvent): void {\n        if (event.type === 'segment_started') {\n            this.options.emit({\n                type: 'media_progress',\n                job: 'tag',\n                done: event.done,\n                total: event.total,\n                label: event.segmentId\n            });\n        }\n        if (event.type === 'segment_failed') {\n            this.options.emit({\n                type: 'media_warning',\n                job: 'tag',\n                message: `${event.segmentId}：${event.message}`\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/renderer/data/use-media-library.ts",
  "content": "import type { MediaEvent, MediaStatus } from '@/client/agent-ipc';\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';\n\nimport { mediaBridge } from '@/renderer/data/bridge';\n\n/**\n * 素材库状态（选目录、建索引、打标）。\n *\n * 索引与打标分成两个动作，**因为一个免费一个花钱**。\n * 合成一个按钮的话，用户选个目录就可能烧掉一笔钱而不自知。\n */\n\nexport interface MediaProgress {\n    job: 'index' | 'tag';\n    done: number;\n    total: number;\n    label: string;\n}\n\nexport interface UseMediaLibrary {\n    /** 桥不存在（浏览器里跑）时为 false */\n    available: boolean;\n    status: MediaStatus | null;\n    progress: MediaProgress | null;\n    warnings: string[];\n    error: string | null;\n    pick: () => Promise<void>;\n    index: () => Promise<void>;\n    tag: () => Promise<void>;\n}\n\nconst EMPTY: MediaStatus = {\n    root: null,\n    rootExists: false,\n    files: 0,\n    segments: 0,\n    tagged: 0,\n    busy: false\n};\n\nexport function useMediaLibrary(): UseMediaLibrary {\n    const [status, setStatus] = useState<MediaStatus | null>(null);\n    const [progress, setProgress] = useState<MediaProgress | null>(null);\n    const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState<string[]>([]);\n    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        const bridge = mediaBridge();\n        if (!bridge) return;\n\n        void bridge.status().then(setStatus);\n\n        // **必须退订**，理由同 §12.3：不退的话切几次页面监听器就重复了\n        return bridge.onEvent((event: MediaEvent) => {\n            switch (event.type) {\n                case 'media_started':\n                    setError(null);\n                    setWarnings([]);\n                    setStatus((prev) => ({ ...(prev ?? EMPTY), busy: true }));\n                    break;\n                case 'media_progress':\n                    setProgress({\n                        job: event.job,\n                        done: event.done,\n                        total: event.total,\n                        label: event.label\n                    });\n                    break;\n                case 'media_warning':\n                    // 只留最近几条：一个坏目录可能刷出几百条，\n                    // 全堆在界面上等于什么都没说\n                    setWarnings((prev) => [...prev.slice(-4), event.message]);\n                    break;\n                case 'media_finished':\n                    setStatus(event.status);\n                    setProgress(null);\n                    break;\n                case 'media_failed':\n                    setError(event.message);\n                    setProgress(null);\n                    setStatus((prev) => ({ ...(prev ?? EMPTY), busy: false }));\n                    break;\n                default:\n                    break;\n            }\n        });\n    }, []);\n\n    const call = useCallback(\n        async (fn: (bridge: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof mediaBridge>>) => Promise<MediaStatus | null>) => {\n            const bridge = mediaBridge();\n            if (!bridge) return;\n            setError(null);\n            try {\n                const next = await fn(bridge);\n                // pick 被取消时返回 null，此时保持原状态不动\n                if (next) setStatus(next);\n            } catch (err) {\n                setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));\n            }\n        },\n        []\n    );\n\n    return {\n        available: mediaBridge() !== null,\n        status,\n        progress,\n        warnings,\n        error,\n        pick: () => call((bridge) => bridge.pick()),\n        index: () => call((bridge) => bridge.index()),\n        tag: () => call((bridge) => bridge.tag())\n    };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { AlertTriangle, FolderOpen, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\n\nimport type { UseMediaLibrary } from '@/renderer/data/use-media-library';\n\n/**\n * 素材目录选择与索引（创作页）。\n *\n * ## 为什么\"建立索引\"与\"打标\"是两个按钮\n *\n * **索引是本地操作，打标要花钱。** 扫描 + ffprobe + 抽帧只用 CPU 和磁盘；\n * 打标每个片段都要发多模态请求（plan.md §11 里一个片段约 4000 输入 token）。\n * 合成一个按钮的话，用户选个目录就可能烧掉一笔钱，而他根本不知道发生了什么。\n *\n * 打标按钮上写明「会调用模型」，就是为了让这笔开销是用户点出来的。\n */\n\n/** 长路径只显示尾部：前面那段通常是 /Users/xxx，既不重要又占地方 */\nfunction shortPath(value: string, max = 48): string {\n    return value.length <= max ? value : `…${value.slice(-max)}`;\n}\n\nfunction StatusLine({ media }: { media: UseMediaLibrary }) {\n    const status = media.status;\n\n    if (!status?.root) {\n        return (\n            <p className=\"text-ed-md text-cr-placeholder\">\n                还没有选择素材目录。AI 需要从你的本地片段里挑素材。\n            </p>\n        );\n    }\n\n    if (!status.rootExists) {\n        return (\n            <p className=\"text-ed-md text-[#FF6B7A]\">\n                目录不见了：{shortPath(status.root)}\n            </p>\n        );\n    }\n\n    const untagged = status.segments - status.tagged;\n    return (\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n            <p\n                title={status.root}\n                className=\"truncate text-ed-md text-white\"\n            >\n                {shortPath(status.root)}\n            </p>\n            <p className=\"text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                {status.segments === 0\n                    ? '尚未建立索引'\n                    : `${status.files} 个文件 · ${status.segments} 个片段 · 已打标 ${status.tagged}`}\n                {/* 没打标的片段只能按文件名检索，匹配质量会很差——要说清楚 */}\n                {status.segments > 0 && untagged > 0\n                    ? `（${untagged} 个未打标，只能按文件名检索）`\n                    : ''}\n            </p>\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n\nexport default function MediaLibraryCard({\n    media\n}: {\n    media: UseMediaLibrary;\n}) {\n    if (!media.available) {\n        return (\n            <section\n                aria-label=\"素材库\"\n                className=\"w-full max-w-[1365px] rounded-[28px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-card px-10 py-6\"\n            >\n                <p className=\"text-ed-md text-cr-placeholder\">\n                    选择素材目录只在桌面端可用\n                </p>\n            </section>\n        );\n    }\n\n    const status = media.status;\n    const busy = status?.busy ?? false;\n    const canIndex = Boolean(status?.root && status.rootExists) && !busy;\n    const canTag = (status?.segments ?? 0) > 0 && !busy;\n\n    return (\n        <section\n            aria-label=\"素材库\"\n            className=\"flex w-full max-w-[1365px] flex-col gap-4 rounded-[28px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-card px-10 py-6\"\n        >\n            <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-6\">\n                <div className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1.5\">\n                    <h2 className=\"text-[19px] font-bold text-white\">素材库</h2>\n                    <StatusLine media={media} />\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3\">\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        disabled={busy}\n                        onClick={() => void media.pick()}\n                        className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-5 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                    >\n                        <FolderOpen size={16} />\n                        {status?.root ? '换个目录' : '选择目录'}\n                    </button>\n\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        disabled={!canIndex}\n                        onClick={() => void media.index()}\n                        className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-5 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                    >\n                        建立索引\n                    </button>\n\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        disabled={!canTag}\n                        // 花钱的按钮要说清楚花的是什么钱\n                        title=\"给关键帧打标，会调用模型，按量计费\"\n                        onClick={() => void media.tag()}\n                        className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-5 text-ed-md font-bold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                    >\n                        <Sparkles size={16} />\n                        AI 打标（调用模型）\n                    </button>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n\n            {media.progress ? (\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                    <Loader2\n                        size={16}\n                        className=\"shrink-0 animate-spin text-[#8A5CFF] motion-reduce:animate-none\"\n                    />\n                    <span className=\"shrink-0 text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                        {media.progress.job === 'index' ? '建立索引' : 'AI 打标'}{' '}\n                        {media.progress.done}/{media.progress.total}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"truncate text-ed-sm text-cr-placeholder\">\n                        {media.progress.label}\n                    </span>\n                </div>\n            ) : null}\n\n            {media.warnings.length > 0 ? (\n                <ul className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n                    {media.warnings.map((message) => (\n                        <li\n                            key={message}\n                            className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-ed-sm text-[#F0B860]\"\n                        >\n                            <AlertTriangle size={14} className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0\" />\n                            {message}\n                        </li>\n                    ))}\n                </ul>\n            ) : null}\n\n            {media.error ? (\n                <p className=\"text-ed-sm text-[#FF6B7A]\">{media.error}</p>\n            ) : null}\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n"

15	/**

18	 * 设计稿画的是展开那一帧，这里做成真的可开合：点按钮开合，

23	export default function VoiceSelect({
24	    value,
25	    open,
26	    onToggle,
27	    onSelect,
28	    onClose
29	}: VoiceSelectProps) {
30	    const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
31	
32	    useEffect(() => {
33	        if (!open) {
34	            return;
35	        }
36	
37	        const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
38	            if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) {
39	                onClose();

41	        };
42	
43	        const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
44	            if (event.key === 'Escape') {
45	                onClose();
46	            }
47	        };
48	
49	        document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
50	        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
51	
52	        return () => {
53	            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
54	            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
55	        };
56	    }, [open, onClose]);
57	
58	    return (
59	        <div ref={rootRef} className="relative w-80 shrink-0">
60	            <button
61	                type="button"

import { createMemoryRouter, RouterProvider } from 'react-router-dom';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';

import { routes } from '@/renderer/router';

import type { FakeBridge } from './fake-bridge';
import { installFakeBridge } from './fake-bridge';

// 对齐 magicut-demo.pen 的 frame HzNgd（妙剪 Magicut — 创作页-输入文稿）。

function renderAt(path: string) {
    const router = createMemoryRouter(routes, { initialEntries: [path] });

    return render(<RouterProvider router={router} />);
}

/** 工作台默认停在项目面板，创作相关的用例先切过去 */
function renderCreate() {
    const result = renderAt('/workspace');

    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' }));

    return result;
}

describe('CreatePage', () => {
    let bridge: FakeBridge | null = null;

    beforeEach(() => {
        bridge = null;
    });

    afterEach(() => {
        bridge?.restore();
    });

    it('创作面板渲染主标题与副标题', () => {
        renderCreate();

        const heading = screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 });
        expect(heading).toHaveTextContent('让文字赴一场光影之约');
        expect(
            screen.getByText('顷刻成帧，每一种表达都自有回响')
        ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('切到创作 tab 后，创作为选中项', () => {
        renderAt('/workspace');

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' }));

        expect(
            screen.getByRole('tablist', { name: '主导航' })
        ).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' })).toHaveAttribute(
            'aria-selected',
            'true'
        );
        expect(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '项目' })).toHaveAttribute(
            'aria-selected',
            'false'
        );
    });

    it('侧栏的创作与项目可以互相切换', () => {
        renderAt('/workspace');

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' }));
        expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveTextContent(
            '让文字赴一场光影之约'
        );

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '项目' }));
        expect(
            screen.getByRole('heading', { name: '所有项目' })
        ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('切 tab 时侧栏不重挂载（这正是合成一条路由的目的）', () => {
        renderAt('/workspace');

        const before = screen.getByRole('tablist', { name: '主导航' });

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' }));

        // 同一个 DOM 节点说明侧栏没被卸载重建——这正是 tab 切换要解决的闪烁问题
        expect(screen.getByRole('tablist', { name: '主导航' })).toBe(before);

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '项目' }));
        expect(screen.getByRole('tablist', { name: '主导航' })).toBe(before);
    });

    it('两个 tab 可切换，切到上传口播音频后文稿输入消失', () => {
        renderCreate();

        expect(
            screen.getByRole('button', { name: '输入文稿' })
        ).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        expect(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿')).toBeInTheDocument();

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '上传口播音频' }));

        expect(
            screen.getByRole('button', { name: '上传口播音频' })
        ).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
        expect(screen.queryByLabelText('视频文稿')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByText('拖入或点击上传口播音频')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('文稿输入会更新计数器', () => {
        renderCreate();

        expect(screen.getByText('0 / 10000')).toBeInTheDocument();

        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {
            target: { value: '前端进阶' }
        });

        expect(screen.getByText('4 / 10000')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('配音下拉默认收起，点开后可选中并收起', () => {
        renderCreate();

        const trigger = screen.getByRole('button', { expanded: false });
        expect(trigger).toHaveTextContent('温婉学姐');
        expect(screen.queryByRole('listbox')).not.toBeInTheDocument();

        fireEvent.click(trigger);

        const options = screen.getAllByRole('option');
        expect(options).toHaveLength(4);
        expect(options[0]).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('option', { name: /沉稳学长/ }));

        expect(screen.queryByRole('listbox')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(
            screen.getByRole('button', { expanded: false })
        ).toHaveTextContent('沉稳学长');
    });

    it('点外面会收起配音下拉', () => {
        renderCreate();

        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { expanded: false }));
        expect(screen.getByRole('listbox')).toBeInTheDocument();

        fireEvent.mouseDown(document.body);

        expect(screen.queryByRole('listbox')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('文稿为空时不让点创建——空提示词到主进程只会换来一个报错', () => {
        renderCreate();
        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' })).toBeDisabled();
    });

    it('点创建把文稿交给主进程，真的发起一次创作', async () => {
        bridge = installFakeBridge();
        renderCreate();

        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {
            target: { value: '做一条讲前端转型 AI 的口播短片' }
        });
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' }));

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(bridge!.starts).toEqual(['做一条讲前端转型 AI 的口播短片']);
        });
        // 发起后按钮进入忙态，不能再点第二次
        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创作中' })).toBeDisabled();
    });

    it('主进程推进度，界面逐条显示', async () => {
        bridge = installFakeBridge();
        renderCreate();
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {
            target: { value: 'x' }
        });
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' }));
        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.starts).toHaveLength(1));

        bridge.emit({
            type: 'node_start',
            runId: 'run_test',
            node: 'ScenePlanner'
        });
        bridge.emit({
            type: 'decision',
            runId: 'run_test',
            node: 'ScenePlanner',
            summary: '拆出 3 个分镜'
        });

        // 节点名被翻译成人话，不是直接把内部节点名甩给用户
        expect(await screen.findByText('拆分镜、写文案')).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByText('拆出 3 个分镜')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('分镜确认：直接放行，提交 approve', async () => {
        bridge = installFakeBridge();
        renderCreate();
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {
            target: { value: 'x' }
        });
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' }));
        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.starts).toHaveLength(1));

        bridge.emit({
            type: 'awaiting_scenes',
            runId: 'run_test',
            scenes: [
                { goal: '开场', script: '大家好', visualIntent: '办公室' },
                { goal: '收尾', script: '就到这里', visualIntent: '街头' }
            ]
        });

        const panel = await screen.findByRole('region', { name: '确认分镜' });

import { sampleProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';

import type {
    AgentRunEvent,
    ApprovalAnswer,
    MediaEvent,
    MediaStatus,
    ProjectSummary
} from '@/client/agent-ipc';

/**
 * 装一个假的 `window.magicutAPI`。
 *
 * jsdom 里没有 Electron，所以渲染层看到的是"没有桥"。要测真实链路上的行为，
 * 就得把桥装上——但**装的是 preload 暴露的那个契约**，
 * 不是随便捏一个形状：契约对不上的话，测试绿了而真机上照样炸。
 */

export interface FakeBridge {
    /** 主进程推事件。测试里手动调它来驱动进度 */
    emit: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void;
    /** 推素材库的进度事件 */
    emitMedia: (event: MediaEvent) => void;
    /** 收到过的审批答复，供断言"界面到底提交了什么" */
    approvals: { runId: string; answer: ApprovalAnswer }[];
    /** 发起过的创作 */
    starts: string[];
    /** 卸载，恢复成"没有桥" */
    restore: () => void;
    /** 当前挂着的监听器数量。用来验证退订真的生效了 */
    listenerCount: () => number;
}

export interface FakeBridgeOptions {
    projects?: ProjectSummary[];
    /** 让 list 失败，测错误态 */
    listError?: string;
    /** 让 load 失败，测错误态 */
    loadError?: string;
    /** 素材库初始状态 */
    media?: MediaStatus;
    /** 用户在目录选择框里点了取消 */
    pickCancelled?: boolean;
    /** 选中的目录 */
    pickResult?: string;
    /** 让建立索引失败，测错误态 */
    indexError?: string;
    runId?: string;
}

export function installFakeBridge(options: FakeBridgeOptions = {}): FakeBridge {
    const listeners = new Set<(event: AgentRunEvent) => void>();
    const mediaListeners = new Set<(event: MediaEvent) => void>();
    const approvals: FakeBridge['approvals'] = [];
    const starts: string[] = [];
    let projects = options.projects ?? [];

    let mediaStatus: MediaStatus = options.media ?? {
        root: null,
        rootExists: false,
        files: 0,
        segments: 0,
        tagged: 0,
        busy: false
    };

    const api = {
        ping: async () => ({ pong: true }),
        media: {
            pick: async () => {
                if (options.pickCancelled) return null;
                mediaStatus = {
                    ...mediaStatus,
                    root: options.pickResult ?? '/Users/me/Movies/素材',
                    rootExists: true
                };
                return mediaStatus;
            },
            status: async () => mediaStatus,
            index: async () => {
                if (options.indexError) throw new Error(options.indexError);
                mediaStatus = { ...mediaStatus, files: 3, segments: 3 };
                return mediaStatus;
            },
            tag: async () => {
                mediaStatus = { ...mediaStatus, tagged: mediaStatus.segments };
                return mediaStatus;
            },
            onEvent: (listener: (event: MediaEvent) => void) => {
                mediaListeners.add(listener);
                return () => {
                    mediaListeners.delete(listener);
                };
            }
        },
        videoAgent: {
            start: async (prompt: string) => {
                starts.push(prompt);
                return { runId: options.runId ?? 'run_test' };
            },
            approve: async (runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer) => {
                approvals.push({ runId, answer });
            },
            cancel: async () => undefined,
            state: async () => null,
            onEvent: (listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void) => {
                listeners.add(listener);
                return () => {
                    listeners.delete(listener);
                };
            }
        },
        projects: {
            list: async () => {
                if (options.listError) throw new Error(options.listError);
                return projects;
            },
            load: async (dirName: string) => {
                // 默认返回示例工程。要返回特定内容的用例自己覆盖这个方法——
                // 但**方法必须存在**：假桥缺一个方法，测出来的就是
                // "调用不存在的方法"而不是真实行为
                if (options.loadError) throw new Error(options.loadError);
                if (!projects.some((p) => p.dirName === dirName)) {
                    throw new Error(`没有这个工程：${dirName}`);
                }
                return sampleProject();
            },
            remove: async (dirName: string) => {
                projects = projects.filter(
                    (project) => project.dirName !== dirName
                );
            }
        }
    };

    (window as unknown as { magicutAPI: unknown }).magicutAPI = api;

    return {
        emit: (event) => {
            for (const listener of [...listeners]) listener(event);
        },
        emitMedia: (event) => {
            for (const listener of [...mediaListeners]) listener(event);
        },
        approvals,
        starts,
        listenerCount: () => listeners.size,
        restore: () => {
            delete (window as unknown as { magicutAPI?: unknown }).magicutAPI;
        }
    };
}

export function makeProject(
    over: Partial<ProjectSummary> = {}
): ProjectSummary {
    return {
        id: 'prj_demo',
        title: '前端进阶AI Agent全栈开发学习路线详解',
        createdAt: '2026-09-23T10:00:00+08:00',
        updatedAt: '2026-09-23T10:42:11+08:00',
        durationMs: 37_500,
        sceneCount: 9,
        dirName: 'run_demo',
        ...over
    };
}

import type { VideoProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';

import type {
    AgentRunEvent,
    ApprovalAnswer,
    MediaEvent,
    MediaStatus,
    ProjectSummary,
    StartRunResult
} from '@/client/agent-ipc';

/**
 * 主进程桥接的访问层。
 *
 * ## 为什么不直接用 `window.magicutAPI`
 *
 * 渲染层有三种运行环境，只有第一种有桥：
 *
 * | 环境 | 有 `magicutAPI` 吗 |
 * |---|---|
 * | Electron 里真跑 | 有 |
 * | vitest + jsdom（组件测试） | **没有** |
 * | `pnpm ui:shot` 的离屏浏览器 | **没有** |
 *
 * 组件里散着写 `window.magicutAPI?.xxx` 的话，后两种环境下的行为就成了
 * 一堆隐式的 undefined 分支，测起来全是噪声。收在这里，
 * **"没有桥"变成一个明确的状态**，页面可以据此显示"请在桌面端打开"。
 */

export interface AgentBridge {
    start(prompt: string): Promise<StartRunResult>;
    approve(runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer): Promise<void>;
    cancel(runId: string): Promise<void>;
    /** 返回退订函数。不退订的话监听器会随页面切换越积越多（§12.3） */
    onEvent(listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void): () => void;
}

export interface MediaBridge {
    pick(): Promise<MediaStatus | null>;
    status(): Promise<MediaStatus>;
    index(): Promise<MediaStatus>;
    tag(): Promise<MediaStatus>;
    /** 返回退订函数。不退订的话监听器会随页面切换越积越多（§12.3） */
    onEvent(listener: (event: MediaEvent) => void): () => void;
}

export interface ProjectBridge {
    list(): Promise<ProjectSummary[]>;
    load(dirName: string): Promise<VideoProject>;
    remove(dirName: string): Promise<void>;
}

function api(): Window['magicutAPI'] | null {
    return typeof window === 'undefined' ? null : (window.magicutAPI ?? null);
}

/** 有没有桥。页面用它区分"还没加载完"与"根本不在桌面端" */
export function hasBridge(): boolean {
    return api() !== null;
}

export function agentBridge(): AgentBridge | null {
    return api()?.videoAgent ?? null;
}

export function mediaBridge(): MediaBridge | null {
    return api()?.media ?? null;
}

export function projectBridge(): ProjectBridge | null {
    return api()?.projects ?? null;
}

import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from 'electron';

import type { VideoProject } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-project';

import type {
    AgentRunEvent,
    ApprovalAnswer,
    MediaEvent,
    MediaStatus,
    ProjectSummary,
    RunSnapshot,
    StartRunResult
} from './agent-ipc';
import { AGENT_CHANNELS, MEDIA_CHANNELS, PROJECT_CHANNELS } from './agent-ipc';

// 新增能力时按 magicut-electron-bridge skill 的链路走，**四处同步**：
// ipcMain.handle → 此处 invoke → magicut.env.d.ts 全局类型 → eslint globals。
const magicutAPI = {
    ping: async () => ({ pong: true }),

    videoAgent: {
        start: (prompt: string): Promise<StartRunResult> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.start, { prompt }),

        approve: (runId: string, answer: ApprovalAnswer): Promise<void> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.approve, runId, answer),

        cancel: (runId: string): Promise<void> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.cancel, runId),

        state: (runId: string): Promise<RunSnapshot | null> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(AGENT_CHANNELS.state, runId),

        /**
         * 订阅进度事件。
         *
         * **必须返回退订函数。** 不返回的话，每次切页面都会再挂一个监听，
         * 监听器只增不减——表现为进度条越跳越快、事件重复处理
         * （plan.md §12.3 专门写过这条）。
         */
        onEvent: (listener: (event: AgentRunEvent) => void): (() => void) => {
            const handler = (
                _event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent,
                payload: AgentRunEvent
            ): void => listener(payload);
            ipcRenderer.on(AGENT_CHANNELS.event, handler);
            return () => {
                ipcRenderer.off(AGENT_CHANNELS.event, handler);
            };
        }
    },

    media: {
        /** 打开系统目录选择框。用户取消返回 null */
        pick: (): Promise<MediaStatus | null> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(MEDIA_CHANNELS.pick),

        status: (): Promise<MediaStatus> =>
            ipcRenderer.invoke(MEDIA_CHANNELS.status),

  "content": "import type {\n    VoiceCategory,\n    VoiceSpec\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices';\nimport { VOICE_CATALOG } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices';\nimport { Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\n\ninterface VoiceSelectProps {\n    value: VoiceSpec;\n    open: boolean;\n    onToggle: () => void;\n    onSelect: (id: string) => void;\n    onClose: () => void;\n}\n\n/**\n * 配音选择器。\n *\n * ## 列表是真音色，不是设计稿里的占位\n *\n * 选项直接来自 `@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices` 的 19 个火山 2.0 中文音色。\n * **界面上选的那个 id 会原样发给主进程**（`start(prompt, voiceId)`），\n * 所以这里绝不能自己编名字——编出来的 id 到了合成那步只会换来一个服务端拒绝。\n *\n * 按官方的「适用场景」分组：19 项平铺成一列谁也挑不动，\n * 而这三组恰好就是用户心里的问题——做口播、演角色、还是读书。\n *\n * 交互上仍然是可开合的：点按钮开合，选中收起，点外面或按 Esc 也收起。\n */\n\n/** 分组顺序即官方列表里的出现顺序，通用场景占大头放最前 */\nconst CATEGORIES: readonly VoiceCategory[] = [\n    '通用场景',\n    '角色扮演',\n    '有声阅读'\n];\n\nexport default function VoiceSelect({\n    value,\n    open,\n    onToggle,\n    onSelect,\n    onClose\n}: VoiceSelectProps) {\n    const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        if (!open) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {\n            if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) {\n                onClose();\n            }\n        };\n\n        const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n            if (event.key === 'Escape') {\n                onClose();\n            }\n        };\n\n        document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);\n        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n\n        return () => {\n            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);\n            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n        };\n    }, [open, onClose]);\n\n    return (\n        <div ref={rootRef} className=\"relative w-80 shrink-0\">\n            <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                aria-haspopup=\"listbox\"\n                aria-expanded={open}\n                aria-label={`配音 ${value.name}`}\n                onClick={onToggle}\n                className=\"flex h-16 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-[10px] border-[1.5px] border-cr-accent bg-cr-select px-5\"\n            >\n                <span className=\"flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 text-[18px] font-bold text-white\">\n                    <span className=\"shrink-0\">配音</span>\n                    <span className=\"truncate\">{value.name}</span>\n                </span>\n                <ChevronDown\n                    size={18}\n                    className={`shrink-0 text-white transition-transform duration-200 ${\n                        open ? 'rotate-180' : ''\n                    }`}\n                />\n            </button>\n\n            {open ? (\n                <div\n                    // 菜单向下展开、压在卡片外面。19 项放不下一屏，所以限高可滚\n                    role=\"listbox\"\n                    aria-label=\"选择配音\"\n                    className=\"absolute top-[72px] left-0 z-20 flex max-h-[420px] w-full flex-col overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-cr-menu-border bg-cr-menu p-1.5 shadow-[0_12px_32px_#00000099] scrollbar-ed\"\n                >\n                    {CATEGORIES.map((category) => {\n                        const items = VOICE_CATALOG.filter(\n                            (voice) => voice.category === category\n                        );\n\n                        return (\n                            <div\n                                key={category}\n                                role=\"group\"\n                                aria-label={category}\n                                className=\"flex flex-col\"\n                            >\n                                <span className=\"px-3.5 pt-2 pb-1 text-ed-sm text-cr-placeholder\">\n                                    {category}\n                                </span>\n                                {items.map((voice) => {\n                                    const selected = voice.id === value.id;\n\n                                    return (\n                                        <button\n                                            key={voice.id}\n                                            type=\"button\"\n                                            role=\"option\"\n                                            aria-selected={selected}\n                                            onClick={() => onSelect(voice.id)}\n                                            className={`flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-3.5 py-[7px] text-left ${\n                                                selected\n                                                    ? 'bg-cr-option-active'\n                                                    : ''\n                                            }`}\n                                        >\n                                            <span className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5\">\n                                                <span\n                                                    className={`truncate text-[15px] leading-[1.25] text-white ${\n                                                        selected\n                                                            ? 'font-bold'\n                                                            : ''\n                                                    }`}\n                                                >\n                                                    {voice.name}\n                                                </span>\n                                                {/* 「XX 同款」是官方标注，选型时唯一能参考的信息 */}\n                                                {voice.platforms ? (\n                                                    <span className=\"truncate text-ed-base leading-[1.25] text-cr-placeholder\">\n                                                        {voice.platforms.join(\n                                                            ' · '\n                                                        )}\n                                                    </span>\n                                                ) : null}\n                                            </span>\n                                            {selected ? (\n                                                <Check\n                                                    size={16}\n                                                    className=\"shrink-0 text-cr-accent\"\n                                                />\n                                            ) : null}\n                                        </button>\n                                    );\n                                })}\n                            </div>\n                        );\n                    })}\n                </div>\n            ) : null}\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n"
}
