{
  "file_path": "/Volumes/G/miaoma-magicut-1-notes/magicut-react-demo/apps/desktop/renderer/components/create/MediaPicker.tsx",
  "content": "import { AlertTriangle, FolderOpen, Loader2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\n\nimport type { UseMediaLibrary } from '@/renderer/data/use-media-library';\n\n/**\n * 素材目录选择（创作页操作行里的「选择素材」）。\n *\n * ## 为什么是一个按钮 + 浮层，而不是一张独立的卡\n *\n * 选素材和选配音是同一类事：**创作前的一次性设置**。放进同一行，\n * 用户从左到右扫一遍就知道这条片子用谁的声音、用哪堆素材。\n * 单开一张卡会把文稿输入挤下去，而输入才是这页的主角。\n *\n * ## 为什么「建立索引」与「AI 打标」是两个按钮\n *\n * **索引是本地操作，打标要花钱。** 扫描 + ffprobe + 抽帧只用 CPU 和磁盘；\n * 打标每个片段都要发多模态请求（plan.md §11 里一个片段约 4000 输入 token）。\n * 合成一个按钮的话，用户选个目录就可能烧掉一笔钱，而他根本不知道发生了什么。\n *\n * 打标按钮上写明「调用模型」，就是为了让这笔开销是用户点出来的。\n */\n\n/** 长路径只显示尾部：前面那段通常是 /Users/xxx，既不重要又占地方 */\nfunction shortPath(value: string, max = 40): string {\n    return value.length <= max ? value : `…${value.slice(-max)}`;\n}\n\nfunction StatusLine({ media }: { media: UseMediaLibrary }) {\n    const status = media.status;\n\n    if (!status?.root) {\n        return (\n            <p className=\"text-ed-md text-cr-placeholder\">\n                还没有选择素材目录。AI 要从你的本地片段里挑素材。\n            </p>\n        );\n    }\n\n    if (!status.rootExists) {\n        return (\n            <p className=\"text-ed-md text-[#FF6B7A]\">\n                目录不见了：{shortPath(status.root)}\n            </p>\n        );\n    }\n\n    const untagged = status.segments - status.tagged;\n    return (\n        <div className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1\">\n            <p title={status.root} className=\"truncate text-ed-md text-white\">\n                {shortPath(status.root)}\n            </p>\n            <p className=\"text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                {status.segments === 0\n                    ? '尚未建立索引'\n                    : `${status.files} 个文件 · ${status.segments} 个片段 · 已打标 ${status.tagged}`}\n                {/* 没打标的片段只能按文件名检索，匹配质量会很差——要说清楚 */}\n                {status.segments > 0 && untagged > 0\n                    ? `（${untagged} 个未打标，只能按文件名检索）`\n                    : ''}\n            </p>\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n\ninterface MediaPickerProps {\n    media: UseMediaLibrary;\n    open: boolean;\n    onToggle: () => void;\n    onClose: () => void;\n}\n\nexport default function MediaPicker({\n    media,\n    open,\n    onToggle,\n    onClose\n}: MediaPickerProps) {\n    const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        if (!open) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {\n            if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) {\n                onClose();\n            }\n        };\n\n        const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {\n            if (event.key === 'Escape') {\n                onClose();\n            }\n        };\n\n        document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);\n        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n\n        return () => {\n            document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);\n            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n        };\n    }, [open, onClose]);\n\n    if (!media.available) {\n        return (\n            <span className=\"flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-5 text-ed-md text-cr-placeholder\">\n                选择素材仅桌面端可用\n            </span>\n        );\n    }\n\n    const status = media.status;\n    const busy = status?.busy ?? false;\n    const canIndex = Boolean(status?.root && status.rootExists) && !busy;\n    const canTag = (status?.segments ?? 0) > 0 && !busy;\n    // 有片段就算配好了：部分未打标仍然能跑，只是匹配差一些\n    const ready = (status?.segments ?? 0) > 0;\n\n    return (\n        <div ref={rootRef} className=\"relative shrink-0\">\n            <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                aria-haspopup=\"dialog\"\n                aria-expanded={open}\n                onClick={onToggle}\n                className=\"flex h-16 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-select px-5 text-[18px] font-bold text-white\"\n            >\n                {busy ? (\n                    <Loader2\n                        size={18}\n                        className=\"animate-spin text-[#8A5CFF] motion-reduce:animate-none\"\n                    />\n                ) : (\n                    <FolderOpen size={18} />\n                )}\n                选择素材\n                {/* 配好了给个安静的确认；没配好不在按钮上喊，浮层里会说 */}\n                {ready ? (\n                    <span className=\"text-ed-md font-normal text-pj-text-2\">\n                        {status?.segments} 个片段\n                    </span>\n                ) : null}\n            </button>\n\n            {open ? (\n                <div\n                    role=\"dialog\"\n                    aria-label=\"素材库\"\n                    className=\"absolute top-[72px] left-0 z-20 flex w-[520px] flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-cr-menu-border bg-cr-menu p-5 shadow-[0_12px_32px_#00000099]\"\n                >\n                    <StatusLine media={media} />\n\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            disabled={busy}\n                            onClick={() => void media.pick()}\n                            className=\"flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-4 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                        >\n                            <FolderOpen size={16} />\n                            {status?.root ? '换个目录' : '选择目录'}\n                        </button>\n\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            disabled={!canIndex}\n                            onClick={() => void media.index()}\n                            className=\"flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-4 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                        >\n                            建立索引\n                        </button>\n\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            disabled={!canTag}\n                            // 花钱的按钮要说清楚花的是什么钱\n                            title=\"给关键帧打标，会调用模型，按量计费\"\n                            onClick={() => void media.tag()}\n                            className=\"flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-4 text-ed-md font-bold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40\"\n                        >\n                            <Sparkles size={16} />\n                            AI 打标（调用模型）\n                        </button>\n                    </div>\n\n                    {media.progress ? (\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                            <Loader2\n                                size={16}\n                                className=\"shrink-0 animate-spin text-[#8A5CFF] motion-reduce:animate-none\"\n                            />\n                            <span className=\"shrink-0 text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2\">\n                                {media.progress.job === 'index'\n                                    ? '建立索引'\n                                    : 'AI 打标'}{' '}\n                                {media.progress.done}/{media.progress.total}\n                            </span>\n                            <span className=\"truncate text-ed-sm text-cr-placeholder\">\n                                {media.progress.label}\n                            </span>\n                        </div>\n                    ) : null}\n\n                    {media.warnings.length > 0 ? (\n                        <ul className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n                            {media.warnings.map((message) => (\n                                <li\n                                    key={message}\n                                    className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-ed-sm text-[#F0B860]\"\n                                >\n                                    <AlertTriangle\n                                        size={14}\n                                        className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0\"\n                                    />\n                                    {message}\n                                </li>\n                            ))}\n                        </ul>\n                    ) : null}\n\n                    {media.error ? (\n                        <p className=\"text-ed-sm text-[#FF6B7A]\">\n                            {media.error}\n                        </p>\n                    ) : null}\n                </div>\n            ) : null}\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import {\n    DEFAULT_VOICE_ID,\n    findVoice,\n    VOICE_CATALOG\n} from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices';\nimport { Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\n\nimport MediaPicker from '@/renderer/components/create/MediaPicker';\nimport VoiceSelect from '@/renderer/components/create/VoiceSelect';\nimport type { CreateTab } from '@/renderer/data/create-fixtures';\nimport {\n    SCRIPT_MAX_LENGTH,\n    SCRIPT_PLACEHOLDER,\n    tabs\n} from '@/renderer/data/create-fixtures';\nimport type { UseMediaLibrary } from '@/renderer/data/use-media-library';\n\ninterface ScriptCardProps {\n    /** 把文稿和选中的音色交出去。真正的创作在页面层发起 */\n    onCreate: (input: { script: string; voiceId: string }) => void;\n    /** 正在创作时禁用，避免重复发起 */\n    busy?: boolean;\n    /**\n     * 不能开跑的原因。有值就禁用创建按钮并把原因显示出来。\n     *\n     * 与 `busy` 分开是因为两者**对用户的含义完全不同**：忙是\"等着\"，\n     * 拦是\"你还得去做件事\"。混成一个的话按钮会写着\"创作中\"却什么都没在跑。\n     */\n    blockedReason?: string | null;\n    media: UseMediaLibrary;\n}\n\nexport default function ScriptCard({\n    onCreate,\n    busy = false,\n    blockedReason = null,\n    media\n}: ScriptCardProps) {\n    const [tab, setTab] = useState<CreateTab>('script');\n    const [script, setScript] = useState('');\n    const [voiceId, setVoiceId] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_VOICE_ID);\n    const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n    const [mediaOpen, setMediaOpen] = useState(false);\n\n    const voice = findVoice(voiceId) ?? VOICE_CATALOG[0]!;\n\n    return (\n        // 卡片底色不透明：点阵特效由 CreatePage 垫在卡片背后，\n        // 所以输入区里看不到点，不会干扰正在输入的文字\n        <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-[1365px] rounded-[28px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-card px-10 pt-10 pb-9\">\n            <div className=\"flex flex-col\">\n                <div className=\"flex w-fit gap-1.5 rounded-3xl border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-tabs p-1\">\n                    {tabs.map((item) => {\n                        const active = item.id === tab;\n\n                        return (\n                            <button\n                                key={item.id}\n                                type=\"button\"\n                                aria-pressed={active}\n                                onClick={() => setTab(item.id)}\n                                className={`cursor-pointer rounded-[20px] px-6 py-[13px] text-[20px] transition-colors duration-150 ${\n                                    active\n                                        ? 'bg-cr-tab-active font-bold text-white'\n                                        : 'text-pj-nav-text'\n                                }`}\n                            >\n                                {item.label}\n                            </button>\n                        );\n                    })}\n                </div>\n\n                {tab === 'script' ? (\n                    <>\n                        <textarea\n                            aria-label=\"视频文稿\"\n                            value={script}\n                            maxLength={SCRIPT_MAX_LENGTH}\n                            onChange={(event) => setScript(event.target.value)}\n                            placeholder={SCRIPT_PLACEHOLDER}\n                            className=\"mt-10 h-[140px] w-full resize-none bg-transparent text-[24px] text-white caret-white outline-none placeholder:text-cr-placeholder\"\n                        />\n                        <span className=\"mt-2 text-[24px] text-cr-counter\">\n                            {script.length} / {SCRIPT_MAX_LENGTH}\n                        </span>\n                    </>\n                ) : (\n                    <div className=\"mt-10 flex h-[182px] w-full items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-cr-card-border text-[20px] text-cr-placeholder\">\n                        拖入或点击上传口播音频\n                    </div>\n                )}\n\n                <div className=\"mt-6 flex w-full items-center gap-[22px]\">\n                    <VoiceSelect\n                        value={voice}\n                        open={menuOpen}\n                        onToggle={() => setMenuOpen((prev) => !prev)}\n                        onSelect={(id) => {\n                            setVoiceId(id);\n                            setMenuOpen(false);\n                        }}\n                        onClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)}\n                    />\n\n                    <MediaPicker\n                        media={media}\n                        open={mediaOpen}\n                        onToggle={() => setMediaOpen((prev) => !prev)}\n                        onClose={() => setMediaOpen(false)}\n                    />\n\n                    <span className=\"flex-1\" />\n\n                    {/* 拦住的原因写在按钮旁边：按钮灰着而不说为什么最气人 */}\n                    {blockedReason ? (\n                        <span className=\"text-ed-md text-[#F0B860]\">\n                            {blockedReason}\n                        </span>\n                    ) : null}\n\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        // 文稿为空时不让点：空提示词到主进程只会换来一个报错\n                        disabled={\n                            busy ||\n                            blockedReason !== null ||\n                            script.trim().length === 0\n                        }\n                        onClick={() =>\n                            onCreate({ script: script.trim(), voiceId })\n                        }\n                        className=\"flex h-13 w-[122px] shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] shadow-[0_6px_24px_#B04FE066] transition-transform duration-150 hover:scale-[1.03] active:scale-95 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:scale-100\"\n                    >\n                        <Sparkles size={18} className=\"text-white\" />\n                        <span className=\"text-[20px] font-bold text-white\">\n                            {busy ? '创作中' : '创建'}\n                        </span>\n                    </button>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n"

import { opendir, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

import type { ScannedFile } from './types';

/** 默认认作视频素材的扩展名。大小写不敏感 */
export const DEFAULT_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = [
    '.mp4',
    '.mov',
    '.m4v',
    '.mkv',
    '.webm',
    '.avi',
    '.mpg',
    '.mpeg'
] as const;

export interface ScanOptions {
    extensions?: readonly string[];
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    /** 每发现一个文件回调一次，供上层做进度提示 */
    onFound?: (file: ScannedFile) => void;
}

function isHidden(name: string): boolean {
    return name.startsWith('.');
}

/**
 * 递归遍历素材目录。
 *
 * 三条刻意的取舍：
 * - **跳过符号链接**：目录软链会成环，走进去就出不来了
 * - **跳过点开头的条目**：`.DS_Store`、`.Trash`、`@eaDir` 这类不是素材
 * - **单个目录读失败不中断整轮**：一个权限不足的子目录不该让 3000 个文件白扫
 *
 * 返回值按路径排序，让两次扫描的处理顺序稳定——续跑时更好对照进度。
 */
export async function scanMediaDirectory(
    roots: readonly string[],
    options: ScanOptions = {}
): Promise<ScannedFile[]> {
    const allowed = new Set(
        (options.extensions ?? DEFAULT_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS).map((e) =>
            e.toLowerCase()
        )
    );
    const found: ScannedFile[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();

    const walk = async (dir: string): Promise<void> => {
        options.signal?.throwIfAborted();

        let entries;
        try {
            entries = await opendir(dir);
        } catch {
            // 读不了就跳过这棵子树，不影响其余目录
            return;
        }

        for await (const entry of entries) {
            options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
            if (isHidden(entry.name)) continue;

            const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
            if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) continue;

            if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                await walk(full);
                continue;
            }
            if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
            if (!allowed.has(path.extname(entry.name).toLowerCase())) continue;
            if (seen.has(full)) continue;

            let info;
            try {
                info = await stat(full);
            } catch {

结果
            } catch {
                continue;
            }

            const file: ScannedFile = {
                path: full,
                sizeBytes: info.size,
                // mtimeMs 是浮点。列是 integer，不取整会出现"存进去 1.7e12，读出来差 0.5"的假变更
                mtimeMs: Math.round(info.mtimeMs)
            };
            seen.add(full);
            found.push(file);
            options.onFound?.(file);
        }
    };

    for (const root of roots) {
        await walk(path.resolve(root));
    }

    found.sort((a, b) => (a.path < b.path ? -1 : a.path > b.path ? 1 : 0));
    return found;
}

/**
 * 增量判据：`size:mtime`。
 *
 * 不用内容哈希——3000 个视频文件跑一遍 sha256 要读几十 GB，
 * 而剪辑素材几乎不会"内容变了但 size 和 mtime 都不变"。
 * 真需要内容级校验的地方（B9 落工程时）单独对选中的十几个文件算。
 */
export function contentKeyOf(file: ScannedFile): string {
    return `${file.sizeBytes}:${file.mtimeMs}`;
}

import { chmod, mkdir, readFile, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { MediaIndexDb } from '@/db';
import type { FfmpegBinaries } from '@/ffmpeg';
import { runIndexPipeline } from '@/pipeline';
import type { IndexEvent } from '@/types';

import {
    hasFfmpeg,
    makeBrokenVideo,
    makeTempDir,
    makeTestVideo
} from './helpers';

let available = false;

beforeAll(async () => {
    available = await hasFfmpeg();
});

interface Env {
    root: string;
    db: MediaIndexDb;
    keyframeDir: string;
    events: IndexEvent[];
}

async function makeEnv(fileCount: number, withBroken = false): Promise<Env> {
    const base = await makeTempDir('media-index-pipe-');
    const root = path.join(base, 'media');
    const keyframeDir = path.join(base, 'keyframes');
    await mkdir(root, { recursive: true });

    for (let i = 0; i < fileCount; i += 1) {
        await makeTestVideo(root, {
            // 文件名带语义，用来验证打标前就能检索
            name: `clip-办公室-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}.mp4`,
            seconds: 3,
            width: 640,
            height: 360,
            fps: 25,
            withAudio: i % 2 === 0
        });
    }
    if (withBroken) await makeBrokenVideo(root, 'clip-坏文件.mp4');

    return {
        root,
        keyframeDir,
        db: MediaIndexDb.open(path.join(base, 'index.db')),
        events: []
    };
}

结果
- `CreativeBriefSchema` 加 `targetDurationSec`：从提示词**抽取**，没说就填 null，
  不替用户决定他没要求的事
- 目标时长在 **ScenePlanner 规划时**就告知模型，不是事后硬改
- `Tts → DurationAlign → DurationCheck`：超出容差（默认 ±12%）就让模型改写文案，
  改过的分镜 `scriptHash` 变了 → §6.2 的增量失效只重跑那几镜 → 回 `Tts`
- **只改文案不改分镜结构**：增删分镜会把已确认的素材匹配全部推翻
- 容差不卡死：配音时长是合成出来才知道的，追求「正好 30.0 秒」只会反复改写却永远差一点

### 第二次实跑又抓到一个我自己引入的问题

加完回压后重跑，**时长改写那次 LLM 调用超时，整个运行直接挂了**——
四条轨道都已经做出来了，就因为调时长的那一步失败而全部作废。

回压是**优化不是必需**：调不准时长，片子照样是片子。已改成失败时保留现有文案
继续走，并如实发一条 warning。有专门用例，变异验证过。

> 这条和 §6.1 是同一个道理：**单个步骤的失败不该毁掉整条产出。**
> 写新节点时很容易忘记给它补上这层，因为"正常路径"跑起来一切正常。

  "command": "python3 - <<'PY'\np='docs/video-agent/tasks.md'\ns=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()\nold=\"\"\"> 这条和 §6.1 是同一个道理：**单个步骤的失败不该毁掉整条产出。**\n> 写新节点时很容易忘记给它补上这层，因为\"正常路径\"跑起来一切正常。\n\n## 测试计划\"\"\"\nnew=\"\"\"> 这条和 §6.1 是同一个道理：**单个步骤的失败不该毁掉整条产出。**\n> 写新节点时很容易忘记给它补上这层，因为\"正常路径\"跑起来一切正常。\n\n---\n\n## 创作页：选素材 + 真音色（2026-09-23，用户需求）\n\n实跑之后用户提的两件事，都是\"界面上做不到、只能靠命令行\"的缺口。\n\n### 1. 选素材：在本地目录里直接挑 `.mp4`\n\n之前素材目录只能靠 CLI 的 `--root` 或环境变量指定。\n\n- 入口放在**操作行里**（配音 · 选择素材 · 创建），不单开一张卡——\n  选素材和选配音是同一类事：创作前的一次性设置；单开卡会把文稿输入挤下去\n- 系统对话框挑的是**视频文件，可多选**（`openFile` + `multiSelections` + 视频扩展名过滤）。\n  macOS 上额外允许挑目录；Windows/Linux 的对话框**不能同时当文件与目录选择器**，\n  两个都传会退化成只能选目录，那就挑不了 `.mp4` 了\n- `media-index` 的 `scanMediaDirectory` 随之扩成 **roots 里文件、目录都认**，\n  显式点名的文件仍要过扩展名白名单（挑中一个 `.txt` 只会让 ffprobe 失败）\n- 选中的路径存进 `settings.json`（原子写，**不存任何凭证**）；\n  旧版本的单个 `mediaRoot` 仍读得出来，不让人重选一遍\n- **「建立索引」与「AI 打标」是两个按钮**：索引是本地操作，打标要花钱\n  （一个片段约 4000 输入 token）。合成一个的话，用户选个目录就可能烧掉一笔钱而不自知\n- 素材库为空时拦住「创建」并**说出原因**，而不是把按钮写成\"创作中\"——\n  什么都没在跑却显示忙态，是我上一版引入的错\n\n### 2. 配音下拉换成真音色\n\n设计稿里的四个（温婉学姐、沉稳学长……）是占位，服务端根本没有。\n现在直接读 `@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices` 的 19 个火山 2.0 中文音色，\n按官方「适用场景」分三组。\n\n为此给 video-agent 开了 `./voices` 子路径导出：包主入口拖着 langchain、sqlite、`node:*`，\n渲染层引进去会直接构建失败。**`voices.ts` 必须保持零 import。**\n\n更要紧的是：**选中的音色现在真的发给主进程了**（`start(prompt, voiceId)`）。\n在此之前下拉纯属摆设，实际音色一直取自 `TTS_VOICE`。主进程侧用\n`resolveVoiceId` 过音色目录白名单——**渲染层送来的值是输入，不可信**，\n不认识就退回配置，原样转发只会在合成那步换来一个看不懂的服务端错误。\n\n### 变异验证\n\n六个载荷点各降一次，对应用例全部变红后复原：\n\n| 变异 | 变红的用例 |\n|---|---|\n| 打标不再要求先建索引 | 建立索引之后才解锁打标 |\n| 去掉\"选中的全没了\"守卫 | 文件不见了时明确说出来 |\n| 进度事件改回完整路径 | 只给文件名不给完整路径（§12 安全边界） |\n| 音色白名单直接放行 | 目录里没有的一律不转发 |\n| 界面选的音色不发出去 | 选中的音色真的发给主进程 |\n| 空素材库不拦创建 | 拦住创建时说的是原因 |\n\n`scanMediaDirectory` 的两个新行为（文件当 root、点名文件仍过白名单）同样变异验证过。\n\n## 测试计划\"\"\"\nassert old in s\nopen(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s.replace(old,new,1))\nPY\nsed -n 1,6p docs/video-agent/tasks.md",
  "description": "Record the batch in tasks.md"
}

  "content": "import { copyFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { createRequire } from 'node:module';\nimport path from 'node:path';\n\nimport type { Plugin } from 'vite';\nimport { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\n/**\n * 把 `node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm` 复制到主进程产物旁边。\n *\n * ## 为什么必须复制\n *\n * 打包后的 `main.js` 是 **Vite 把 JS 全部内联进来的一个文件**，但 `.wasm` 不是 JS——\n * 它是运行时用 `readFileSync(__dirname + '/node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm')` 读的二进制。\n * 没有它，主进程一碰索引库就抛 `ENOENT: ...node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm`，\n * 而**构建期一切正常**——这正是它容易漏掉的原因。\n *\n * ## 为什么不改成 external\n *\n * 让它保持 external、运行时从 `node_modules` 解析看着更省事，但在打包后的 app 里\n * 那条路径要跨过 asar 与 pnpm 的 hoisted 布局，多一层不确定。\n * 复制一个 1MB 的文件到产物目录，行为在开发和打包两种形态下完全一致。\n */\nfunction copySqliteWasm(): Plugin {\n    const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);\n\n    return {\n        name: 'magicut:copy-sqlite-wasm',\n        // 每次写完产物都跑：dev 下 Forge 会重建主进程，产物目录会被清掉\n        writeBundle(options) {\n            // 从包的入口反推同目录下的 wasm，不写死 node_modules 路径——\n            // hoisted 布局下它可能在仓库根，也可能在 .pnpm 虚拟目录里\n            const entry = require.resolve('node-sqlite3-wasm');\n            const source = path.join(\n                path.dirname(entry),\n                'node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm'\n            );\n            const outDir = options.dir ?? path.resolve('.vite/build');\n\n            mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });\n            copyFileSync(source, path.join(outDir, 'node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm'));\n        }\n    };\n}\n\nexport default defineConfig({\n    plugins: [copySqliteWasm()]\n});\n"
}

'./fake-bridge';\n\n/**\n * 创作页的素材选择（用户提的需求）。\n *\n * 之前素材目录只能靠 CLI 的 `--root` 或环境变量指定，界面上无从设置。\n *\n * 入口是操作行里的「选择素材」，与「配音」并排——两者都是创作前的一次性设置。\n * **点下去直接开系统文件框**，挑的是本地视频（可多选），中间不隔任何浮层。\n */\n\nlet bridge: FakeBridge | null = null;\n\nfunction renderCreate() {\n    const router = createMemoryRouter(routes, {\n        initialEntries: ['/workspace']\n    });\n    const result = render(<RouterProvider router={router} />);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('tab', { name: '创作' }));\n    return result;\n}\n\nfunction pickButton() {\n    return screen.getByRole('button', { name: /选择素材/ });\n}\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n    bridge = null;\n});\n\nafterEach(() => {\n    bridge?.restore();\n});\n\ndescribe('素材选择', () => {\n    it('没选过素材时挡住创建，并说明要先做什么', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({ media: EMPTY_MEDIA });\n        renderCreate();\n\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {\n            target: { value: '做一条短片' }\n        });\n\n        // 没有素材就创作，图跑到匹配那步必然放弃所有分镜\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' })).toBeDisabled();\n        expect(screen.getByText('先选素材并建立索引')).toBeInTheDocument();\n        // 拦住时说的是原因，不是「创作中」——什么都没在跑\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByRole('button', { name: '创作中' })\n        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    /**\n     * **点一下只该发生一件事**：开系统文件框。\n     * 之前中间隔着一个浮层，里面还要再点一次「选择视频」，那一层什么也没解决。\n     */\n    it('点「选择素材」直接开系统文件框，不先弹别的东西', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: EMPTY_MEDIA,\n            pickResult: ['/Users/me/Movies/我的素材/开场.mp4']\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n\n        fireEvent.click(pickButton());\n\n        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.picks).toBe(1));\n        // 没有浮层、没有第二个「选择视频」按钮\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByRole('button', { name: '选择视频' })\n        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    /**\n     * **挑完直接建索引**：索引是本地操作，只花 CPU 和磁盘。\n     * 用户刚亲手挑完文件，再让他点一次「建立索引」纯属多余。\n     */\n    it('挑完文件自动建索引，不用再点一次', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: EMPTY_MEDIA,\n            pickResult: ['/m/a.mp4', '/m/b.mov']\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n\n        fireEvent.click(pickButton());\n\n        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.indexes).toBe(1));\n        // 索引完就有片段了，创建随之解锁\n        expect(\n            await screen.findByText(/3 个片段 · 3 个未打标/)\n        ).toBeInTheDocument();\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByRole('button', { name: '建立索引' })\n        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    it('用户点了取消：既不改选择，也不去索引上一次的东西', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: EMPTY_MEDIA,\n            pickCancelled: true\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n\n        fireEvent.click(pickButton());\n\n        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.picks).toBe(1));\n        expect(bridge.indexes).toBe(0);\n    });\n\n    /**\n     * **打标要花钱，必须是用户自己点的**：每个片段都要发多模态请求。\n     * 顺手替他打了，就是替他花钱。\n     */\n    it('打标是单独一个按钮，且写明会调用模型', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: {\n                paths: ['/m/a.mp4'],\n                missing: [],\n                files: 1,\n                segments: 3,\n                tagged: 0,\n                busy: false\n            }\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n\n        const tag = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /AI 打标/ });\n        expect(tag).toHaveAccessibleName(/调用模型/);\n        expect(bridge.tags).toBe(0);\n\n        fireEvent.click(tag);\n        await waitFor(() => expect(bridge!.tags).toBe(1));\n    });\n\n    it('全部打过标就不再出现打标按钮——没有要打的了', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge();\n        renderCreate();\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /AI 打标/ })\n        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n        expect(screen.getByText(/3 个片段 · 已全部打标/)).toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    it('有素材后解锁创建', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge();\n        renderCreate();\n        await screen.findByText(/3 个片段/);\n\n        fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('视频文稿'), {\n            target: { value: '做一条短片' }\n        });\n        expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' })).toBeEnabled();\n    });\n\n    it('文件不见了时明确说出来——而不是显示一个看着正常的数字', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: {\n                paths: ['/m/还在.mp4', '/m/已经被删掉的.mp4'],\n                missing: ['/m/已经被删掉的.mp4'],\n                files: 1,\n                segments: 1,\n                tagged: 1,\n                busy: false\n            }\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n\n        expect(\n            await screen.findByText(/1 个文件已不存在：已经被删掉的\\.mp4/)\n        ).toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    it('进度逐条显示', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge();\n        renderCreate();\n        await screen.findByText(/3 个片段/);\n\n        bridge.emitMedia({ type: 'media_started', job: 'index' });\n        bridge.emitMedia({\n            type: 'media_progress',\n            job: 'index',\n            done: 2,\n            total: 5,\n            label: 'office.mp4'\n        });\n\n        expect(\n            await screen.findByText(/建立索引 2\\/5 · office\\.mp4/)\n        ).toBeInTheDocument();\n        // 跑着的时候不能再点，两个索引同时写一个库只会互相打架\n        expect(pickButton()).toBeDisabled();\n    });\n\n    it('坏文件的警告显示出来，但只留最近一条', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge();\n        renderCreate();\n        await screen.findByText(/3 个片段/);\n\n        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {\n            bridge.emitMedia({\n                type: 'media_warning',\n                job: 'index',\n                message: `坏文件 ${i}`\n            });\n        }\n\n        // 一个坏目录可能刷出几百条，全堆上去等于什么都没说\n        expect(await screen.findByText('坏文件 7')).toBeInTheDocument();\n        expect(screen.queryByText('坏文件 6')).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    it('索引失败时把原因显示出来', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge({\n            media: EMPTY_MEDIA,\n            pickResult: ['/m/a.mp4'],\n            indexError: '找不到可执行文件 ffprobe'\n        });\n        renderCreate();\n        await waitFor(() => expect(pickButton()).toBeEnabled());\n\n        fireEvent.click(pickButton());\n\n        expect(\n            await screen.findByText(/找不到可执行文件 ffprobe/)\n        ).toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n\n    it('「选择素材」与「配音」同在操作行，和「创建」一排', async () => {\n        bridge = installFakeBridge();\n        renderCreate();\n\n        const pick = await screen.findByRole('button', { name: /选择素材/ });\n        const voice = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /^配音/ });\n        const create = screen.getByRole('button', { name: '创建' });\n\n        // 三者同一行：创作前的设置从左到右扫一遍就完事\n        expect(pick.parentElement?.parentElement).toBe(create.parentElement);\n        expect(voice.parentElement?.parentElement).toBe(create.parentElement);\n    });\n\n    it('没有桥时说明只在桌面端可用', () => {\n        renderCreate();\n\n        // 浏览器里没有系统文件框可开，所以连按钮都不给——给了点下去也只会没反应\n        expect(screen.getByText('选择素材仅桌面端可用')).toBeInTheDocument();\n        expect(\n            screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /选择素材/ })\n        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    });\n});\n"

两件事都修了。 **启动崩溃（`ENOENT: node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm`）** 打包后的 `main.js` 是 Vite 把 JS 全部内联进来的一个文件，但 `.wasm` 不是 JS——它是运行时用 `readFileSync(__dirname + '/node-sqlite3-wasm.wasm')` 读的二进制，没人复制过去。`vite.main.config.ts` 里加了个插件，每次写产物都把它从包的入口同目录复制到 `.vite/build/`。没改成 external，是因为打包后那条路径要跨 asar 和 pnpm 的 hoisted 布局，多一层不确定；复制一个文件在 dev 和打包两种形态下行为完全一致。 已验证：`.vite/build/` 和 `app.asar` 里都有这个文件，字节是合法 wasm，打包后的 app 启动无任何异常输出。这类问题 `typecheck + test` 全绿也照样发生——改主进程依赖后必须真打一次包。 **选择素材：点下去就是系统文件框** 浮层删了。现在点「选择素材」直接开对话框挑本地视频（多选，macOS 上也能整个目录选），**挑完自动建索引**——索引是本地操作，只花 CPU 和磁盘，你刚亲手挑完文件还要再点一次"建立索引"纯属多余。 只有「AI 打标（调用模型）」还是独立按钮，而且只在有未打标片段时出现：那一步每个片段都要发多模态请求，是花钱的，不能顺手替你点了。按钮旁边一行小字说状态（`3 个片段 · 3 个未打标` / 索引进度 / 坏文件警告 / 错误），取消选择时既不改选择也不去索引上一次的东西。 验证：153 个桌面端用例全过（56 + 88 + 210 也全过），lint/typecheck/cspell 干净，打包通过。新规则逐个变异验证——「取消后照样索引」「挑完不自动索引」「顺手把打标也跑了」三个变异分别让对应用例变红，其中打标那条有一句 `expect(bridge.tags).toBe(0)` 专门盯着。tasks.md 已记录，包括 wasm 这个坑。

import { stages, stageStateAt } from '@magicut-react/agent';
import type { Storyboard } from '@magicut-react/schema';

import type { VideoAgentScene } from '../../shared/video-agent';

import type { AgentRunStage } from './agent-run-stage';
import { STAGE_LABELS, stageIndexOfRun } from './agent-run-stage';

/**
 * 创作消息页要显示的真实数据。
 *
 * 这一层的存在理由是「不编造」：设计稿上那些内容（「0:00-0:25 开场问题引入」
 * 「科技蓝紫 MG 动画」「Inter 承载标题与正文」）看起来像系统分析出来的结论，
 * 其实一条都不是——它们是画稿时写的示意文字。把它们当成真值显示，用户会
 * 据此以为系统真的做了那些决定。
 *
 * 所以这里只产出**有据可依**的值：分镜来自草稿、时长来自时间轴、规格来自
 * `spec`、素材数来自用户挑的文件。系统还没有产出的东西（视觉风格、配色、
 * 字体）就不显示，而不是填一个像模像样的假值。
 */

/** `m:ss`。和时间轴上的刻度一个格式 */
export function formatClock(ms: number): string {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));

    return `${Math.floor(total / 60)}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/** `约 3 分 05 秒`。不足一分钟时只说秒，免得出现「约 0 分 12 秒」 */
export function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
    const total = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));
    const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60);
    const seconds = total % 60;

    return minutes === 0
        ? `约 ${seconds} 秒`
        : `约 ${minutes} 分 ${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')} 秒`;
}

export interface OutlineItem {
    id: string;
    /** `0:00-0:04` */
    time: string;
    /** 这一镜的文案。空镜头没有口播，显示占位说明 */
    text: string;
}

/**
 * 文稿结构。
 *
 * 直接来自草稿的分镜，不做二次概括——概括需要模型，而这一步是纯本地规则
 * 切出来的。给出真实的时间段与文案，比编一句「开场问题引入」诚实。

/**

export function outlineFromScenes(scenes: VideoAgentScene[]): OutlineItem[] {
    let cursor = 0;

    return scenes.map((scene) => {
        const startMs = cursor;
        cursor += scene.estimatedMs;

        return {
            id: `scene-${scene.index}`,
            time: `${formatClock(startMs)}-${formatClock(cursor)}`,
            text:
                scene.script.trim() === ''
                    ? scene.visualIntent.trim() === ''
                        ? '（纯画面，无口播）'
                        : scene.visualIntent
                    : scene.script
        };
    });
}

export function buildOutline(draft: Storyboard): OutlineItem[] {
    return draft.shots.map((shot) => ({
        id: shot.id,
        time: `${formatClock(shot.range.startMs)}-${formatClock(shot.range.endMs)}`,
        text: shot.script.trim() === '' ? '（纯画面，无口播）' : shot.script
    }));
}

/** 口播文稿：把各分镜的文案按顺序拼回去，就是实际要念的内容 */
export function spokenScript(draft: Storyboard): string {
    return draft.shots
        .map((shot) => shot.script)
        .filter((text) => text.trim() !== '')
        .join('\n');
}

export interface RequirementRow {
    field: string;
    detail: string;
}

    draft: Storyboard;
    voiceLabel: string;
    /** 用户挑了多少个素材文件或目录 */
    materialCount: number;
}

/** 设计稿里的顶部时间是「18:26」，这里用草稿的创建时间 */
function formatClock(iso: string) {
    const at = new Date(iso);
    const pad = (value: number) => String(value).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${pad(at.getHours())}:${pad(at.getMinutes())}`;
}

import {
    createHashRouter,
    Navigate,
    type RouteObject,
    useNavigate,
    useParams
} from 'react-router-dom';

import { useProject } from '../data/use-project';
import EditorPage from '../pages/EditorPage';
import RouteError from '../pages/RouteError';
import WorkspaceLayout from '../pages/WorkspaceLayout';

/**
 * 编辑器的路由入口，`/`、`/editor`、`/editor/:projectId` 三条都走它。
 *
 * 这里目前只做一件路由层的事：注入「回首页」的导航。
 *
 * ⚠️ `:projectId` 暂时**没有被消费**。B11 才把它换成真的加载 `project.json`；
 * 在那之前从路由参数硬猜标题只会给人「已经接上了」的错觉。
 *
 * 解析与导航都不放进页面里，EditorPage 才能脱离 Router 直接渲染，
 * 组件测试不用为了这两样去套 RouterProvider。
 */
function EditorRoute() {
    // `:projectId` 其实是工程**目录名**——工程 id 在 JSON 里，
    // 而路由要能在不读文件的情况下定位，所以用目录名
    const { projectId } = useParams();
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const state = useProject(projectId);

    // 设计稿里没有「首页」这一页，侧栏导航里的首页也标着未实现。
    // 工作台是目前唯一的落地页，先指到它；有了真正的首页改这一行即可。
    const home = () => navigate('/workspace');

    // 四种状态各说各的话。统一成"空"会让人以为工程丢了
    switch (state.status) {
        case 'ready':
            return <EditorPage project={state.project} onHome={home} />;
        case 'loading':
            return <EditorPage notice="正在打开工程…" onHome={home} />;
        case 'failed':
            return (
                <EditorPage
                    notice={`打开失败：${state.message}`}
                    onHome={home}
                />
            );
        case 'unavailable':
            return <EditorPage notice="工程只能在桌面端打开" onHome={home} />;
        default:
            // 没带 id：设计稿预览，用示例工程
            return <EditorPage onHome={home} />;
    }
}

// 每条路由都挂同一个兜底页：渲染期抛错时顶掉 React Router 的开发态错误屏
const withErrorBoundary = (route: RouteObject): RouteObject => ({
    ...route,
    errorElement: <RouteError />
    matches: MatchPreview[];
    savedPath: string | null;
    error: string | null;
}

export const routes: RouteObject[] = [
    {
        path: '/',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        path: '/editor',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        path: '/editor/:projectId',
        element: <EditorRoute />
    },
    {
        // 项目与创作合在这一条路由里，靠左侧胶囊导航 tab 切换。
        // 不拆成两条路由：切路由会让侧栏连同两团 blur 光晕重新挂载，视觉上闪一下。
        path: '/workspace',
        element: <WorkspaceLayout />
    },
    {
        // 兜底：匹配不上的 hash 一律回首屏，而不是掉进 React Router 的错误屏。
        // 典型场景是路由改过名之后，窗口里还留着旧 hash（比如已删掉的 #/projects），
        // 桌面端没有地址栏，用户在那一屏是走不出去的。
        path: '*',
        element: <Navigate to="/" replace />
    }
].map(withErrorBoundary);

// Electron 打包后以 file:// 加载页面，使用 hash 路由避免刷新丢失路由
export const router = createHashRouter(routes);

import { useState } from 'react';

import ProjectSidebar from '@/renderer/components/projects/ProjectSidebar';
import type { WorkspaceTab } from '@/renderer/data/project-fixtures';
import CreatePage from '@/renderer/pages/CreatePage';
import ProjectsPage from '@/renderer/pages/ProjectsPage';

/**
 * 工作台：项目与创作在同一个页面里，左侧胶囊导航当 tab 切。
 *
 * 只占一条路由。之前给两个面板各配一条路由，切换时侧栏会被卸载重建，
 * 两团 blur 光晕跟着重新绘制，视觉上闪一下——tab 切换没有这个问题，
 * 侧栏从头到尾就是同一个实例。
 *
 * 代价是「当前在哪个面板」不进 URL，刷新后回到默认的项目面板，
 * 也没法直接深链到创作面板。需要的话可以把 tab 提到 query 参数上。
 */
export default function WorkspaceLayout() {
    const [tab, setTab] = useState<WorkspaceTab>('projects');

    return (
        <div className="flex h-full w-full bg-pj-bg font-ed">
            <ProjectSidebar active={tab} onChange={setTab} />

            {tab === 'projects' ? (
                <ProjectsPage onCreate={() => setTab('create')} />
            ) : (
                <CreatePage onDone={() => setTab('projects')} />
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

    if (kind === 'warning') {

            <AlertTriangle

                className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-[#F0B860]"

    }

    );
}

export default function RunPanel({
    run,
    onOpenProject
}: {
    run: UseAgentRun;
    onOpenProject: () => void;
}) {
    if (run.phase === 'idle' || run.phase === 'unavailable') return null;

    return (
        <section
            aria-label="创作进度"
            className="flex w-full max-w-[1365px] flex-col gap-6 rounded-[28px] border border-cr-card-border bg-cr-card px-10 py-8"
        >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {run.phase === 'running' ? (
                    <Loader2
                        size={18}
                        className="animate-spin text-[#8A5CFF] motion-reduce:animate-none"
                    />
                ) : null}
                <h2 className="text-[22px] font-bold text-white">
                    {run.phase === 'finished'
                        ? '创作完成'
                        : run.phase === 'failed'
                          ? '创作失败'
                          : (run.node ?? '准备中')}
                </h2>
            </div>

            <RunLog run={run} />

            {run.phase === 'awaiting_scenes' ? (
                <SceneApproval run={run} />
            ) : null}
            {run.phase === 'awaiting_matches' ? (
                <MatchApproval run={run} />
            ) : null}

            {run.phase === 'failed' ? (
                <p className="text-ed-md text-[#FF6B7A]">{run.error}</p>
            ) : null}

            {run.phase === 'finished' ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={onOpenProject}
                        className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white"
                    >
                        去项目列表看看
                    </button>
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={run.reset}
                        className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white"
                    >
                        再做一条
                    </button>
                </div>

  "content": "import type { AgentRunPhase } from '@/renderer/data/use-agent-run';\n\n/**\n * 创作过程的四个阶段。\n *\n * ## 为什么要在节点之上再盖一层\n *\n * 图里有 14 个节点（`CollectInput`、`DurationCheck`、`AbandonUnfixable`…），\n * 逐个报给用户只会让他数不清还剩多少。四个阶段是**用户视角的分法**：\n * 先准备、再有分镜、再有声音、最后成片。\n *\n * ## 状态一律从智能体的真实进度推出来\n *\n * 不做任何\"看着像在跑\"的动画：某个阶段亮着，是因为图**确实**停在它辖下的某个节点。\n * 节点名不认识时保持上一个阶段，而不是猜一个——猜错了就是在骗用户。\n */\n\nexport type StageId = 'prepare' | 'storyboard' | 'voice' | 'video';\n\nexport type StageStatus =\n    /** 还没轮到 */\n    | 'pending'\n    /** 正在跑 */\n    | 'running'\n    /** 停在中断点，等用户确认 */\n    | 'waiting'\n    | 'done'\n    | 'failed';\n\nexport interface StageView {\n    id: StageId;\n    label: string;\n    status: StageStatus;\n}\n\nexport const STAGE_LABELS: Record<StageId, string> = {\n    prepare: '准备阶段',\n    storyboard: '创建分镜',\n    voice: '配音生成',\n    video: '视频生成'\n};\n\nconst ORDER: readonly StageId[] = ['prepare', 'storyboard', 'voice', 'video'];\n\n/**\n * 节点 → 阶段。\n *\n * 素材匹配（`AssetMatcher` / `MatchApproval`）归在「创建分镜」下：\n * 分镜要配上素材才算立得住，而且那个中断点确认的正是\"这镜用哪段素材\"。\n *\n * 字幕与配乐没有独立节点，它们在 `TimelineAssemble` 里一并做掉。\n */\nconst NODE_STAGE: Record<string, StageId> = {\n    CollectInput: 'prepare',\n    AssetScan: 'prepare',\n    CreativeBrief: 'prepare',\n    ScenePlanner: 'storyboard',\n    SceneApproval: 'storyboard',\n    AssetMatcher: 'storyboard',\n    MatchApproval: 'storyboard',\n    AbandonUnfixable: 'storyboard',\n    Tts: 'voice',\n    DurationAlign: 'voice',\n    DurationCheck: 'voice',\n    TimelineAssemble: 'video',\n    Validation: 'video',\n    ProjectSave: 'video'\n};\n\n/** 节点属于哪个阶段。不认识的节点返回 null——**宁可不显示也不猜** */\nexport function stageOfNode(node: string | null): StageId | null {\n    if (node === null) return null;\n    return NODE_STAGE[node] ?? null;\n}\n\nexport interface RunProgress {\n    phase: AgentRunPhase;\n    node: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * 当前该点亮哪个阶段。\n *\n * 图里有回环（`DurationCheck` 不满意会退回 `Tts`），所以这里**不记最远到过哪**，\n * 只看当前节点——退回配音时就该显示在配音，显示成\"已完成\"是撒谎。\n */\nexport function stagesOf(run: RunProgress): StageView[] {\n    const current = stageOfNode(run.node);\n    const currentIndex = current === null ? -1 : ORDER.indexOf(current);\n\n    return ORDER.map((id, index) => ({\n        id,\n        label: STAGE_LABELS[id],\n        status: statusOf(run, index, currentIndex)\n    }));\n}\n\nfunction statusOf(\n    run: RunProgress,\n    index: number,\n    currentIndex: number\n): StageStatus {\n    // 跑完了就是四个阶段全done，不管最后停在哪个节点\n    if (run.phase === 'finished') return 'done';\n    // 还没开跑（含没有桥的情况）：全是灰的，不要伪装成\"准备中\"\n    if (run.phase === 'idle' || run.phase === 'unavailable') return 'pending';\n\n    // 连第一个节点事件都还没到：刚发起，算在准备阶段\n    if (currentIndex === -1) {\n        return index === 0\n            ? run.phase === 'failed'\n                ? 'failed'\n                : 'running'\n            : 'pending';\n    }\n\n    if (index < currentIndex) return 'done';\n    if (index > currentIndex) return 'pending';\n\n    if (run.phase === 'failed') return 'failed';\n    // 停在中断点等人：和\"正在跑\"要分开说，否则用户会一直等一个不会自己动的进度\n    if (run.phase === 'awaiting_scenes' || run.phase === 'awaiting_matches') {\n        return 'waiting';\n    }\n    return 'running';\n}\n"
}

</div>\n\n            {/* 文稿原样显示：跑起来之后它就不可改了，但用户要能看见自己提交了什么 */}\n            <section\n                aria-label=\"本次文稿\"\n                className=\"w-full max-w-[1365px] rounded-[28px] border   "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nimport type { StageId, StageStatus } from '@/renderer/data/run-stages';\nimport { stageOfNode, stagesOf } from '@/renderer/data/run-stages';\nimport type { RunPhase } from '@/renderer/data/use-agent-run';\n\n/**\n * 四个阶段的状态推导。\n *\n * 这一层的全部意义是「**不编造进度**」：亮哪个阶段完全由智能体当前停在哪个节点决定。\n */\n\nfunction statuses(phase: RunPhase, node: string | null): StageStatus[] {\n    return stagesOf({ phase, node }).map((stage) => stage.status);\n}\n\ndescribe('节点 → 阶段', () => {\n    it('14 个节点各归其位', () => {\n        const cases: [string, StageId][] = [\n            ['CollectInput', 'prepare'],\n            ['AssetScan', 'prepare'],\n            ['CreativeBrief', 'prepare'],\n            ['ScenePlanner', 'storyboard'],\n            ['SceneApproval', 'storyboard'],\n            // 素材匹配归在分镜下：分镜要配上素材才算立得住\n            ['AssetMatcher', 'storyboard'],\n            ['MatchApproval', 'storyboard'],\n            ['AbandonUnfixable', 'storyboard'],\n            ['Tts', 'voice'],\n            ['DurationAlign', 'voice'],\n            ['DurationCheck', 'voice'],\n            ['TimelineAssemble', 'video'],\n            ['Validation', 'video'],\n            ['ProjectSave', 'video']\n        ];\n\n        for (const [node, stage] of cases) {\n            expect(stageOfNode(node)).toBe(stage);\n        }\n    });\n\n    it('不认识的节点返回 null——**宁可不显示也不猜**', () => {\n        expect(stageOfNode('SomeFutureNode')).toBeNull();\n        expect(stageOfNode(null)).toBeNull();\n    });\n});\n\ndescribe('阶段状态', () => {\n    it('没开跑时四个阶段都是灰的，不伪装成\"准备中\"', () => {\n        expect(statuses('idle', null)).toEqual([\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        expect(statuses('unavailable', null)).toEqual([\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('刚发起、第一条节点事件还没到：算在准备阶段', () => {\n        expect(statuses('running', null)).toEqual([\n            'running',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('跑到哪个节点就亮哪个阶段，前面的算完成', () => {\n        expect(statuses('running', 'CreativeBrief')).toEqual([\n            'running',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        expect(statuses('running', 'Tts')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'running',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        expect(statuses('running', 'ProjectSave')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'running'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    /**\n     * 「等你确认」必须和「正在跑」分开。\n     *\n     * 两者看着都是\"没完成\"，但**要不要动手完全相反**——\n     * 混成一个的话用户会一直等一个不会自己动的进度。\n     */\n    it('停在中断点时是「等你确认」，不是「进行中」', () => {\n        expect(statuses('awaiting_scenes', 'SceneApproval')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'waiting',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        expect(statuses('awaiting_matches', 'MatchApproval')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'waiting',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('失败时标在出事的那个阶段上，前面的仍算完成', () => {\n        expect(statuses('failed', 'Tts')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'failed',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        // 连节点都没来得及报就挂了：算在准备阶段\n        expect(statuses('failed', null)).toEqual([\n            'failed',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('跑完了四个全完成，不管最后停在哪个节点', () => {\n        expect(statuses('finished', 'ProjectSave')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'done'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    /**\n     * 图里有回环：`DurationCheck` 觉得时长不对会退回 `Tts` 重做。\n     * 这时**必须退回配音阶段**——显示成\"配音已完成\"是撒谎。\n     */\n    it('回环退回配音时，配音重新变回进行中', () => {\n        expect(statuses('running', 'DurationCheck')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'running',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n        expect(statuses('running', 'Tts')).toEqual([\n            'done',\n            'done',\n            'running',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('不认识的节点不乱标，保持在准备阶段而不是跳到最后', () => {\n        expect(statuses('running', 'SomeFutureNode')).toEqual([\n            'running',\n            'pending',\n            'pending',\n            'pending'\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('顺序与中文名固定：准备阶段 → 创建分镜 → 配音生成 → 视频生成', () => {\n        expect(stagesOf({ phase: 'idle', node: null }).map((s) => s.label)).toEqual(\n            ['准备阶段', '创建分镜', '配音生成', '视频生成']\n        );\n    });\n});\n"
}

做好了。点「创建」现在跳到 `/creating` 这一页，上面是四个阶段： | 阶段 | 辖下的图节点 | |---|---| | 准备阶段 | `CollectInput` `AssetScan` `CreativeBrief` | | 创建分镜 | `ScenePlanner` `SceneApproval` `AssetMatcher` `MatchApproval` `AbandonUnfixable` | | 配音生成 | `Tts` `DurationAlign` `DurationCheck` | | 视频生成 | `TimelineAssemble` `Validation` `ProjectSave` | 每个阶段五种状态：未开始 / 进行中 / 等你确认 / 已完成 / 失败。**全部从智能体的真实节点推出来**，没有任何定时器推着走的假进度——图停在哪个节点就亮哪个阶段。几个具体判断： - **「等你确认」单列一种**：它和「进行中」看着都是没完成，但要不要动手完全相反。混一起的话用户会一直等一个不会自己动的进度。 - **不记"最远到过哪"**，只看当前节点。图里有回环（`DurationCheck` 觉得时长不对会退回 `Tts`），退回配音时就得显示在配音，标成"已完成"是撒谎。 - **中断点认 phase 不认 node**：`awaiting_scenes/matches` 事件本身已经说明停在哪；只认节点的话，节点事件还没到时会错标成"准备阶段进行中"。 - **不认识的节点返回 null、保持不动**——宁可不显示也不猜。 两个确认点（分镜/素材）仍在这一页等答复，进度日志、失败原因、跑完后的「去项目列表看看」也都在。运行由这一页自己发起（文稿和音色走路由 state 带过来）——让上一页发起的话，跳页时它一卸载进度就断了。素材匹配我放在「创建分镜」下：分镜要配上素材才算立得住，而那个中断点确认的正是"这镜用哪段素材"。 素材匹配的归属是我替你定的，觉得它更该算「视频生成」的话说一声，改一行映射就行。 验证：169 个桌面端用例全过（另外三个包 56/88/210 也全过），lint/typecheck/cspell 干净，渲染层构建通过。四个变异逐个验过——把「等你确认」并进「进行中」、改成记最远进度、给不认识的节点瞎猜阶段、去掉「只发起一次」的守卫，对应用例分别变红；最后那个更狠，去掉后直接跑成死循环把测试挂住了，也就是说没有它每次渲染都会再发起一次创作。tasks.md 已记录。

# Using the `execute` tool on the pen.dev canvas

- The `execute` tool executes a small javascript snippet to modify the document.
- Split work into multiple smaller `execute` calls focused on each section.

- In case of an error, all modifications and the created globals will be reverted.
- When an `execute` call fails, ALWAYS fix it with the `edits` parameter and the `editId` from the failure message - never resend the snippet. If the patched snippet fails again, keep fixing it with further `edits` under the same `editId`; `find` must then match the snippet as already patched.
- A list of warnings will be returned in the response message. Always Fix them in the next execute call.

- Use normal JavaScript to generate repeated design structure: arrays, `for...of` loops, computed values, conditionals, object spreads, helper functions, and template strings are all useful.
- Be smart about writing JavaScript to remove duplication and minimize the length of the generated code.
- Prefer loops/spreads/helpers over long handwritten repetitive code when creating nav items, table rows, cards, metrics, menus, or similar repeated UI.
- Do not include comments in the generated `execute` JavaScript snippet. Keep the input small.

- You MUST set the `name` property with a human readable name on every node and child node you add. This will make the document cleaner and easier to understand. A mapping from names to ids will be returned at the end of each `execute` call so you can reference the created nodes in the next calls.

- When creating style objects that are then spread when creating nodes. Make sure to include `type` in the style object.
- Never set `id` when creating, copying, or replacing nodes or components. pen.dev will always generate unique random IDs and override the input.

- Always prefer the returned node id in the `ref` property when creating instances.
- Use `Get` to read node data, including nodes created earlier in the same call.
- `Insert`/`Copy`/`Replace` return plain id strings. To access the children of a newly created node, read its subtree with `Get` first, e.g. `Get(rowId, {depth: 1}).children`.

- Each `execute` is executed in its own scope. Local variables and helper functions are NOT shared between `execute` calls. To persist values between calls, don't use `const` or `let` when declaring variables, use `myNodeId = Insert(...)`.

## `execute` API

Only these functions are supported in `execute`. Use other tools for other operations.

```ts
const document: string; // predefined root node

// Mutations
function Insert(parent: string, nodeData: Child): string; // returns the inserted node's id
function Copy(path: string, parent: string, copyNodeData?: Child): string; // returns the copied node's id (descendants get new ids - Get the copy to read them)
function Update(path: string, updateData: Child): void;
function Replace(path: string, nodeData: Child): string; // returns the replacement node's id
function Move(path: string, parent: string | undefined, index?: number): void;
function Delete(path: string): void;
function Generate(nodeId: string, type: "ai" | "svg" | "stock", prompt: string): void; // generate image or SVG
function SetVariables(variables: Record<string, VariableDefinition>, replace?: boolean): void;

// Reading
function Get(path: string, options?: GetOptions): Child; // one node, children nested
function Get<T>(path: string, visit: Visit<T>, options?: GetOptions): T[]; // visit a subtree
function Get<T>(visit: Visit<T>, options?: GetOptions): T[]; // visit the whole document
function GetVariables(): { variables: Record<string, VariableDefinition>; themes?: Record<string, string[]> };
function FindEmptySpace(input: { width: number; height: number; direction?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"; padding?: number; nodeId?: string }): { x: number; y: number; parentId?: string };
function Print(...values: unknown[]): void; // add a line to the execute response: strings raw, other values as JSON, joined with spaces
function TakeScreenshot(nodeIds: string[]): void;
function Export(nodeIds: string[], format: "png" | "jpeg" | "webp" | "pdf" | "html-tailwind" | "html-css", outputPath: string, options?: ExportOptions): void; // export nodes to image or HTML files

type Visit<T> = (node: Child, ctx: Ctx) => T | undefined; // returning undefined collects nothing for this node

interface ExportOptions {
  scale?: number; // image scale factor, default 2
  quality?: number; // JPEG/WEBP quality 1-100
  includeHtmlScaffold?: boolean; // html: full document scaffold, default true
  includeLayerNames?: boolean; // html: layer names as data attributes, default true
  includeLayerIds?: boolean; // html: layer ids as data attributes, default false
}

interface GetOptions {
  depth?: number; // 0 = the node itself; elided children appear as "..."
  resolveVariables?: boolean; // computed values instead of $variable references
  resolveInstances?: boolean; // expand component instances into full subtrees
  includePathGeometry?: boolean;
}

interface Ctx {
  node: Child; // the visited node (= visit's first argument)
  parentCtx?: Ctx; // parent's context; undefined at the top - follow the chain for ancestors
  depth: number;
  index: number; // position among siblings
  bounds: Rect; // resolved bounds in the parent's coordinate space (same space as node x/y)
  problems?: "partially clipped" | "fully clipped"; // node sticks out of its parent
  skipChildren(): void; // don't descend into this node's children
}
```

`Get` arguments are recognized by type, so unused ones are simply omitted: `Get(screen, visit)`, `Get(visit)`, `Get(id, {depth: 1})` all work. There is deliberately no visitor-less whole-document read - it would dump the entire serialized document.

The `path` argument (used by `Get`, `Copy`, `Update`, `Replace`, `Move`, `Delete`) is a node ID, or a slash-separated path to a node nested inside a component instance (`instanceId/childId`). Slashes are only valid for component-instance nesting, not normal layer structure, and work for any nesting depth.

Targets - `path` and `Insert`'s `parent` - are always id/path strings: never pass a node object; when holding a node from `Get`, pass its `.id`. Returned ids concatenate directly: `cardId + "/childId"`, `{[metricLabelId]: {...}}`. To operate on a node you only know by name, find it with a visitor:

```js
Get(n => n.name === "Primary Button" && Insert(n.id, {type: "text", name: "Button Label", content: "RESERVE NOW", fontFamily: "Inter", fontSize: 13, fill: "#111111"}))
```

### Insert

- Insert a new node at the end of the children array of the specified parent node.
- An insert can only be a single node, if you want to add children to it, use the returned id in the next Insert call.
- When working with components (reusable: true), insert their instances as refs with their properties overridden. Override descendant properties inline with the `descendants` map, or with subsequent Update operations.
- Use the Replace to override children inside a component instance, e.g. `Replace("myInstance/childId",{type:"text",...})`
- Returns the inserted node's id as a string.
- To access the children of a newly inserted node, read its subtree with `Get` first (it reflects nodes created earlier in the same call): `Get(rowId, {depth: 1}).children`.

### Copy

- "path": The ID of the existing node to copy. If you want to customize some properties of the copied node, just add them next to the `path` property. If you want to customize nested nodes _under_ the copied one, use the same kind of `descendants` map that `ref` nodes use!

- When copying a node and modifying its descendants, you MUST use the "descendants" property in the Copy operation itself. DO NOT use separate Update operations for descendants of copied nodes, as this will fail due to ID mismatches. The copied node and its descendants receive new IDs, so Update operations referencing the original descendant IDs will fail.
- `descendants`: Optional, used for components. Keys may be node IDs/paths or unique descendant names inside the referenced component. If a name matches multiple descendants, use the node ID/path instead.

- Copying a reusable node creates a connected instance (a `ref` node).
- Returns the copied node's id as a string. The copy's descendants all get new ids - read them with `Get(copiedId)` if you need to modify them individually.

### Update

- Update the properties of existing nodes, without listing their children.
- DO NOT use this to update the node's `children`, use Replace function for that.
- This function CANNOT change the `id`, `type` or `ref` properties of any node!
- `path`: The node to update.

- `updateData`: The node data to update

### Replace

- Replace a node with a new node. All properties including the x/y are replaced.
- This tool is ideal for swapping out parts of a component instance with new nodes.
- Returns the replacement node's id as a string
- `path`: The path of the node which will be replaced
- `nodeData`: The properties of the new node

### Move

- Move a node to a different location in the node tree in a .pen file.
- `path`: The node to move.
- `parent`: Optional. The new parent node. If omitted, the node stays under its current parent.
- `index`: Optional new position of the moved node among its siblings. If omitted, the node is placed at the end.

### Delete

- Delete a node from a .pen file.
- `path`: The node to delete.
- Cannot delete descendants of component instances - emulate the deletion by overriding the descendant's `enabled` property with `false` instead.

### SetVariables

- Define or update the variables and themes of the .pen file. Read existing variables with `Print(GetVariables())` first.
- `variables`: An object keyed by variable name. Each value MUST be an object with a `type` (`"color"`, `"number"`, or `"string"`) and a `value`. Passing a bare value like `"#A3B59A"` or `16` will fail.
- Variable names are arbitrary strings and MUST NOT begin with a dollar sign. The `$` prefix is only used when referencing a variable from a property (e.g. `fill: "$accent"`).
- `replace` (optional, default `false`): when `false`, the variables are merged into the existing definitions. Pass `true` to completely replace the document's existing variable definitions.
- Don't specify themes separately. If a variable uses theming, theme axes and values that aren't yet present in the document are registered automatically. For themed values, pass an array of `{value, theme}` entries.

```js
SetVariables({
  accent: {type:"color",value:"#A3B59A"},
  "spacing-unit": {type:"number",value:16},
  "font-heading": {type:"string",value:"Playfair Display"},
  background: {type:"color",value:[
    {value:"#F8F5F0",theme:{mode:"light"}},
    {value:"#1A1A1A",theme:{mode:"dark"}}
  ]}
})
```

### GetVariables

- Returns the variables and themes currently defined in the .pen file, including changes made earlier in the same `execute` call.
- Use the result to reference existing variables, to avoid overwriting them with `SetVariables`, or to create global CSS rules when generating code from a design.
- Combine with `Print` to read the variables in the tool response: `Print(GetVariables())`.

### Get

- Reflects changes made earlier in the same `execute` call, so you can read back what you just created or modified.
- `path` is a node ID or instance path (with `resolveInstances`, expanded node ids are full `instanceId/childId` paths that `Update`/`Replace` accept).
- Without `visit`, the returned node is pure schema data that round-trips straight into `Insert`/`Copy`/`Update`/`Replace`.
- With `visit`, every read node is visited top-down. Only an `undefined` return collects nothing - a `false` from a `cond && Update(...)` visitor is collected, which is fine when the result is discarded. Skipped nodes' children are still visited unless you call `ctx.skipChildren()`.
- Use `ctx.bounds`/`ctx.problems` to verify layout instead of guessing; `bounds` compares directly against the node's `x`/`y` and feeds straight into `Update`.
- Use `visit` to `Print` one compact row per node you care about, to apply an operation to every matching node in one pass, or to collect nodes when you need the list itself (sorting, slicing, driving loops).
- Keep visitors compact with single-letter parameter names: `(n, c) => ({id: n.id, name: n.name, w: c.bounds.width})`.
- Don't store large `Get` results in globals; only ids and small values are worth persisting between calls.

```js
Print(Get("Xk9f2", {depth: 3}))  // read a node subtree
Get(n => n.reusable && Print(n.id, n.name))  // list all components
Get(screen, n => n.type === "text" && n.fontSize < 12 && Update(n.id, {fontSize: 12}), {resolveVariables: true})  // query and modify in one pass
Get(screen, (n, c) => Print(n.id, n.name, c.depth, c.bounds.width))  // compact overview of a subtree
Get(screen, (n, c) => c.problems && Print(n.name, "in", c.parentCtx?.node.name, ":", c.problems))  // layout problems check
Get(card, (n, c) => c.parentCtx && Math.abs(c.bounds.x + c.bounds.width / 2 - c.parentCtx.bounds.width / 2) > 1 && Print(n.name, "off-center"))
const texts = Get(screen, n => n.type === "text" ? n : undefined)  // collect only when you need the list (sorting, slicing, driving loops)
```

### Print

- Adds one line to the `execute` response so you can read it after the call completes. Each argument is printed raw if it's a string and as JSON otherwise, joined with spaces. Print only JSON-compatible values.
- Keep responses small: for row-shaped data, print compact positional lines from a `Get` visitor instead of JSON objects - your own `Print` call documents what the columns mean. Reserve JSON for single structured values.
- Values printed by a failed `execute` call are not returned.

```js
Get(root, n => Print(n.id, "=", n.name, n.reusable ? "✓" : ""))  // one compact row per node
Get(screen, (n, c) => c.problems && Print(n.name, "|", c.parentCtx?.node.name, "|", c.problems))
Print(GetVariables())
Print(FindEmptySpace({width:1440,height:1024}))
```

### TakeScreenshot

- Renders the given nodes and attaches the screenshots as images to the `execute` response, one per node id. Returns nothing.
- `nodeIds`: the nodes to screenshot; use `"document"` to screenshot the entire document.
- The screenshots reflect the changes made earlier in the same `execute` call.
- Good practice: when an `execute` call finishes a whole section or design, end that same call with a `TakeScreenshot` of it. There is no need to finish the generation first and issue a separate tool call just to screenshot the result.
- Screenshots are expensive - use them sparingly. Take one only after a complete section is done, not in every `execute` call.
- Prefer the smallest meaningful node (a section frame, not the whole document) - large nodes use more tokens and obscure detail.
- Use `Get` with a visitor (`ctx.bounds` carries the resolved bounds) for structural/sizing checks; reach for a screenshot only when visual fidelity (color, type, alignment) is what you need to verify.
- Screenshots of a failed `execute` call are not returned.

```js
heroId=Insert(pageId,{type:"frame",name:"Hero",layout:"vertical",gap:24,padding:64,width:"fill_container"})
Insert(heroId,{type:"text",name:"Headline",content:"Ship faster.",fontSize:64,fontWeight:"bold",fill:"$text-primary"})
Insert(heroId,{type:"text",name:"Subhead",content:"Design at the speed of thought.",fontSize:20,fill:"$text-secondary"})
TakeScreenshot([heroId])
```

### Export

- Exports nodes to files on disk. Returns nothing; the absolute paths of the written files are listed in the response.
- `outputPath`: for image formats a directory - each node is written as `<nodeId>.<ext>`; for HTML formats the path of the output file.
- Image formats (`png`, `jpeg`, `webp`, `pdf`): each node is exported as a separate file at 2x scale by default. For `pdf`, all nodes are combined into a single multi-page `export.pdf`.
- HTML formats (`html-tailwind`, `html-css`): all nodes are exported into one HTML file. Image assets are referenced with relative paths, never embedded.
- Use Export to deliver final assets or hand a design off to code - not to check your work; verify visuals with `TakeScreenshot` instead.

```js
Export([heroId, pricingId], "png", "./exports")
Export([pageId], "html-tailwind", "./landing.html")
```

### Generate image or SVG

- IMPORTANT: There is NO `image` node type! Images are applied as FILLS to
  existing nodes; SVGs are transformed into paths and added to a parent frame.
- For `"ai"` and `"svg"`, Generate is an async, non-blocking operation. It
  returns nothing and finishes independently of the execute progress.
  (`"stock"` is the exception: its fill is applied during the call itself.)
- The result lands in the document after the `execute` call that started it has
  already returned. The target node stays empty or unfilled until then, and
  screenshots taken right away will not show it. That is expected. Never
  re-generate it, draw it by hand, or add children to a frame you generated an
  SVG into.
- The frame an SVG is generated into keeps `placeholder: true` while the
  drawing is in progress; the flag is cleared when the generation finishes.
  Check on it with a cheap read in a later `execute` call - never with
  screenshots: `Print(Get(logoFrameId, {depth: 0}).placeholder)`.
- Generations are slow: SVGs can take multiple minutes. While the placeholder
  flag is still set, don't wait idly: continue with the rest of the design and
  re-check only occasionally, e.g. after finishing another section - not after
  every execute call.
- Only when no other work is left, poll with that tiny Get/Print call, leaving
  a generous interval between checks (do other verification passes in
  between). Never fire checks back-to-back.
- Screenshot the generated result only after the placeholder flag is cleared.
  If the flag is cleared but the frame is still empty, the generation failed -
  that is the one case where calling Generate again on the same node is
  correct.

#### Generating an image (`type: "ai"` or `type: "stock"`)

- Never guess or invent URLs for image fills. Always use the Generate function
  to get an image from a stock or AI service.
- To display an image: first Insert a frame or rectangle, then use Generate to
  apply the image as a fill to that node.
- `nodeId`: The ID of the node to apply the image fill to.
- `type`: "ai" for AI-generated images, "stock" for stock photos from Unsplash.
- `prompt`:
  - For "ai": a detailed descriptive prompt.
  - For "stock": a 1-3 keyword search query following the Stock query rules
    (simple, concrete, no use-case or abstract terms).
- `"stock"` fills are applied during the call; if no matching photo is found,
  a warning is returned and the node is left without an image fill.

```js
const pos = FindEmptySpace({width: 1440, height: 800, padding: 80, nodeId: logoFrameId})
heroId = Insert(document, {type: "frame", name: "Section", x: pos.x, y: pos.y, width: 1440, height: 800, placeholder: true})
Generate(heroId, "ai", "Tropical jungle canopy, dense green foliage, sunlight filtering through trees, cinematic aerial view, vibrant greens, moody atmospheric lighting, nature photography")
```

#### Generating an SVG (`type: "svg"`)

- SVG generation is the only way to produce freeform vector artwork, and it is currently the slowest and most expensive operation in Pencil. Use it deliberately - it is not the default way to fill visual space.
- Generate an SVG only when the artwork itself is the point:
  - the user asks you to draw, illustrate, or create a logo, mark, mascot, or illustration,
  - the design is for a brand or product that needs its own logo mark and the document doesn't already contain one,
  - a section is carried by a custom illustration or diagram that cannot be assembled from icons, shapes, or an image.
- Do NOT generate an SVG for these - each has a cheaper, better option:
  - icons, arrows, chevrons, checkmarks, UI glyphs -> an `icon` node (`lucide`, `feather`, `Material Symbols`, `phosphor`)
  - photos, textures, hero and background imagery, avatars, product shots -> an image fill via `Generate` with `type: "stock"` or `type: "ai"`
  - badges, tags, pills, buttons, cards, dividers, blobs, glows, gradient backgrounds, abstract patterns, charts -> frames, shapes, strokes, gradient fills, and layout
  - artwork that already exists in the document -> `Copy` it or instance it
- Budget: be mindful about the number of generated SVG per design. Turn it into a component and reuse it whenever needed. Never generate a variant per screen, section, or card.
- When you're unsure whether artwork is needed, build the design without it first. Adding one generated graphic afterwards is cheap; deleting several that weren't wanted is not.
- To display an SVG: first Insert a frame with the desired width and height (no other element type is allowed), then use Generate. The resulting path elements are scaled to fit the frame's bounding box and inserted as its children.
- `nodeId`: The ID of the frame to insert the SVG into.
- `type`: "svg".
- `prompt`: a detailed descriptive prompt. The generator sees nothing of the document, so state the subject, composition, line/fill style, and colors explicitly. One generation per prompt - don't ask for a set of variants.

```js
const pos = FindEmptySpace({width: 400, height: 400, padding: 80})
logoFrameId = Insert(document, {type: "frame", name: "Logo", x: pos.x, y: pos.y, width: 400, height: 400, placeholder: true})
Generate(logoFrameId, "svg", "A cute fox logo, minimalist vector style, colourful, simple, clean, modern flat design, suitable for a brand logo.")
```

### FindEmptySpace

- Finds an empty `width` x `height` area.
- When placing objects directly to document root and you don't have an exact position, use `FindEmptySpace` at the start of your `execute` to find an empty area for your content. Never overlap root objects.
- Don't just pick random coordinates unless you know exact position from the context or the user request.
- For multiple sequential screens, use the previous element's ID as the `nodeId` parameter in `FindEmptySpace`.
- `direction` (optional, default "right"): where to search, one of "top", "right", "bottom", "left".
- `padding` (optional, default 0): minimum distance from other elements.
- `nodeId` (optional): anchor node used for chaining multiple screens together.
- Returns `{x, y, parentId?}`. Insert or Copy into `parentId` (or `document` if absent) at the returned `x`/`y`.

## Examples

Create the reusable `Metric` component (a vertical frame with a label and a value text), capturing the returned ids:

```js
const pos=FindEmptySpace({width:240,height:96,direction:"top", padding:80})
metricCardId=Insert(document,{type:"frame",name:"Metric",x:pos.x,y:pos.y,reusable:true,layout:"vertical",gap:4,placeholder:true})
metricLabelId=Insert(metricCardId,{type:"text",name:"Label",fontFamily:"Inter",fontSize:13,fill:"$text-secondary",content:"Label"})
metricValueId=Insert(metricCardId,{type:"text",name:"Value",fontFamily:"Inter",fontSize:28,fill:"$text-primary",content:"0"})
Update(metricCardId,{placeholder:false})
```

Insert a screen at the document root and fill it with a loop:

```js
const pos=FindEmptySpace({width:1440,height:1024,padding:80})
pageId=Insert(document,{type:"frame",name:"Landing Page",x:pos.x,y:pos.y,layout:"vertical",width:1440,padding:40,gap:24,clip:true,placeholder:true})

const navItem={type:"text",fontFamily:"Inter",fontSize:14,fill:"$text-secondary"}
navId=Insert(pageId,{type:"frame",name:"Nav",gap:32,alignItems:"center",width:"fill_container"})
for (const label of ["Home","Our Story","Visit","Journal"]) {
  Insert(navId,{...navItem,name:label,content:label})
}
```

Instantiate the component in a loop (even in the same `execute`), keyed by the captured `metricLabelId`/`metricValueId` ids:

```js
rowId=Insert(pageId,{type:"frame",name:"Metrics",gap:16,width:"fill_container"})
for (const [label,value] of [["Orders","1,284"],["Revenue","$48.2K"],["Customers","9,431"]]) {
  Insert(rowId,{type:"ref",ref:metricCardId,name:label,width:"fill_container",descendants:{[metricLabelId]:{content:label},[metricValueId]:{content:value}}})
}

Update(pageId,{placeholder:false})
```

Copy an existing screen, customize its descendants in the same `Copy` call, and delete a node:

```js
const pos=FindEmptySpace({width:1440,height:1024,padding:80})
dashboardV2Id=Copy("Xk9f2",document,{name:"Dashboard V2",x:pos.x,y:pos.y,placeholder:true,descendants:{"Jd6Ru":{fill:"#0F172A"},"Pc2Ny/Gh9Kf":{content:"Reports"}}})
Update(dashboardV2Id,{placeholder:false})

Delete("Vn4kP")
```

Define the design tokens first, then reference them with `$` when building. Themed values are passed as `{value, theme}` arrays (the `dark` axis value is registered on the fly), so `$bg`/`$text-primary` references resolve per theme automatically:

```js
SetVariables({
  "bg":{type:"color",value:[
    {value:"#FAFAF7",theme:{mode:"light"}},
    {value:"#141414",theme:{mode:"dark"}}
  ]},
  "text-primary":{type:"color",value:[
    {value:"#1A1A1A",theme:{mode:"light"}},
    {value:"#F5F5F5",theme:{mode:"dark"}}
  ]},
  "font-body":{type:"string",value:"Inter"},
  "gap-md":{type:"number",value:16}
})

cardId=Insert(document,{type:"frame",name:"Card",layout:"vertical",fill:"$bg",padding:"$gap-md",gap:"$gap-md",x:80,y:80})
Insert(cardId,{type:"text",name:"Title",fontFamily:"$font-body",fontSize:20,fill:"$text-primary",content:"Tokens applied"})
```

30-    /* 编辑器字号梯度。设计稿用的是 9-20px 的自定义梯度，和 Tailwind 默认的
31-       text-xs/sm/base 对不上，散落成 text-[13px] 这类 arbitrary value 会重复几十处。
32:       按 Tailwind 工程实践的"抽象阶梯"，重复且属于设计语言的值应当升级为 @theme 令牌。 */

/* 只用 webkit 伪元素，不写 scrollbar-width / scrollbar-color：
   Chromium 里一旦出现标准属性就会忽略这组伪元素，退回 macOS 的 overlay 滚动条，
   不滚动时完全看不见——暗色面板里需要的是常驻可见的滚动条。 */
@utility scrollbar-ed {
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
    }

    &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: transparent;
    }

    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: var(--color-ed-scroll);
        border-radius: 9999px;
    }

    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: var(--color-ed-text-3);

  "content": "import type { StageStatus, StageView } from '@/renderer/data/run-stages';\nimport { STATUS_TEXT } from '@/renderer/data/run-stages';\n\n/**\n * 对话流里的四个阶段（设计稿 frame OrZJP 的 Steps）。\n *\n * 一行 = 圆点 + 标题/说明 + 右侧状态，行距 12。\n * 状态与圆点的颜色都由**智能体的真实进度**决定，见 `run-stages.ts`。\n */\n\n/** 设计稿：进行中是琥珀，未开始是 ed-text-3，完成是绿 */\nconst DOT: Record<StageStatus, string> = {\n    pending: 'bg-ed-text-3',\n    running: 'bg-msg-running',\n    waiting: 'bg-msg-running',\n    done: 'bg-msg-done',\n    failed: 'bg-ed-accent'\n};\n\nconst STATUS_TONE: Record<StageStatus, string> = {\n    pending: 'text-ed-text-2',\n    running: 'text-msg-running',\n    waiting: 'text-msg-running',\n    done: 'text-msg-done',\n    failed: 'text-ed-accent'\n};\n\nexport default function StageSteps({ stages }: { stages: StageView[] }) {\n    return (\n        <ol aria-label=\"创作阶段\" className=\"flex w-full flex-col gap-3\">\n            {stages.map((stage) => (\n                <li\n                    key={stage.id}\n                    aria-current={\n                        stage.status === 'running' || stage.status === 'waiting'\n                            ? 'step'\n                            : undefined\n                    }\n                    className=\"flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4\"\n                >\n                    <span className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n                        <span\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                            className={`size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${DOT[stage.status]}`}\n                        />\n                        <span className=\"flex flex-col gap-1\">\n                            <span className=\"text-ed-lg font-bold text-ed-text\">\n                                {stage.ordinal} {stage.label}\n                            </span>\n                            <span className=\"text-ed-base text-ed-text-2\">\n                                {stage.desc}\n                            </span>\n                        </span>\n                    </span>\n\n                    <span\n                        className={`shrink-0 text-ed-base ${STATUS_TONE[stage.status]}`}\n                    >\n                        {STATUS_TEXT[stage.status]}\n                    </span>\n                </li>\n            ))}\n        </ol>\n    );\n}\n"
