  "content": "import { findVoice } from '@magicut-react-demo/video-agent/voices';\n\n/**\n * 对话流顶部的「你」的消息卡（设计稿 frame OrZJP 的 XAtwj）。\n *\n * 卡里三样东西**全是用户刚才真的提交过的**：文稿原文、两枚配置胶囊、素材路径。\n * 设计稿里那句「/Users/heyi/Downloads/videos」是画稿时写的示意值，\n * 照抄会让人以为系统认得那个目录——这里换成用户自己选的素材。\n */\n\ninterface UserMessageCardProps {\n    script: string;\n    voiceId?: string | undefined;\n    /** 用户选中的素材路径。空数组时这一行不显示 */\n    materialPaths: string[];\n}\n\nfunction Chip({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {\n    return (\n        <span className=\"flex w-fit items-center overflow-hidden rounded-md\">\n            <span className=\"bg-msg-chip px-2.5 py-[7px] text-ed-base text-ed-text\">\n                {label}\n            </span>\n            <span className=\"bg-msg-chip-value px-2.5 py-[7px] text-ed-base text-ed-text\">\n                {value}\n            </span>\n        </span>\n    );\n}\n\n/** 一项时给完整路径，多项时只说个数——十几行路径堆在消息卡里没人看 */\nfunction materialSummary(paths: string[]): string | null {\n    if (paths.length === 0) return null;\n    return paths.length === 1 ? paths[0]! : `已选 ${paths.length} 项素材`;\n}\n\nexport default function UserMessageCard({\n    script,\n    voiceId,\n    materialPaths\n}: UserMessageCardProps) {\n    const voice = voiceId === undefined ? undefined : findVoice(voiceId);\n    const material = materialSummary(materialPaths);\n\n    return (\n        // 左边留 103px：设计稿里用户的消息比助手的窄一截，靠右站\n        <div className=\"w-full pl-[103px]\">\n            <section\n                aria-label=\"本次文稿\"\n                className=\"flex w-full flex-col gap-4 rounded-[14px] bg-msg-card px-[22px] pt-[22px] pb-5\"\n            >\n                <div className=\"flex w-full items-center justify-between\">\n                    <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2.5\">\n                        <span\n                            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n                            className=\"size-[22px] rounded-full bg-linear-135 from-[#5DB8FF] to-[#1E6FD9]\"\n                        />\n                        <span className=\"text-ed-lg font-bold text-ed-text\">\n                            你\n                        </span>\n                    </span>\n                </div>\n\n                <p className=\"text-ed-lg leading-[1.6] whitespace-pre-line text-ed-text\">\n                    {script}\n                </p>\n\n                <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n                    {/* 「智能匹配素材」是实情：素材由 AssetMatcher 从索引库里挑 */}\n                    <Chip label=\"视频画面\" value=\"智能匹配素材\" />\n                    {voice ? (\n                        <Chip label=\"旁白配音\" value={voice.name} />\n                    ) : null}\n                </div>\n\n                {material ? (\n                    <p\n                        title={materialPaths.join('\\n')}\n                        className=\"truncate text-ed-base text-ed-text-2\"\n                    >\n                        {material}\n                    </p>\n                ) : null}\n            </section>\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { AlertTriangle, Check } from 'lucide-react';\n\nimport type { StageView } from '@/renderer/data/run-stages';\nimport type { RunLogItem } from '@/renderer/data/use-agent-run';\nimport { labelOfNode } from '@/renderer/data/use-agent-run';\n\n/**\n * 对话流里的状态胶囊（设计稿 frame OrZJP 的 Status Pills 与 Pill 组织说明）。\n *\n * ## 胶囊里写的是真发生过的事\n *\n * 设计稿上那三句（「本地素材扫描完成。」…）是画稿时的示意文字。照抄的话，\n * 用户会以为系统真做了那几件事。这里改成**智能体自己报上来的事件**——\n * 节点说了什么就显示什么，没说就不显示。\n *\n * 末尾那枚跳动的胶囊代表「正在做」，文案取当前节点的人话名。\n */\n\nfunction Pill({ item }: { item: RunLogItem }) {\n    const warning = item.kind === 'warning';\n\n    return (\n        <li className=\"flex w-fit items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[10px] bg-msg-card px-5 py-[13px]\">\n            {warning ? (\n                <AlertTriangle size={16} className=\"shrink-0 text-msg-running\" />\n            ) : (\n                <Check size={16} className=\"shrink-0 text-msg-done\" />\n            )}\n            <span className=\"text-ed-lg text-ed-text\">{item.text}</span>\n        </li>\n    );\n}\n\n/** 三颗跳动的点。设计稿里「正在…」的胶囊靠它表示还在动 */\nfunction Dots() {\n    return (\n        <span aria-hidden=\"true\" className=\"flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1\">\n            {[0, 1, 2].map((index) => (\n                <span\n                    key={index}\n                    className=\"size-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-msg-running motion-reduce:animate-none\"\n                    style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 160}ms` }}\n                />\n            ))}\n        </span>\n    );\n}\n\ninterface RunFeedProps {\n    log: RunLogItem[];\n    /** 当前节点。null 表示还没有节点事件 */\n    node: string | null;\n    /** 当前所在阶段，用作小标题 */\n    current: StageView | undefined;\n    /** 还在跑吗。停下来之后不该再显示跳动的点 */\n    active: boolean;\n}\n\nexport default function RunFeed({ log, node, current, active }: RunFeedProps) {\n    return (\n        <div className=\"flex w-full flex-col\">\n            {log.length > 0 ? (\n                <ul aria-label=\"创作动态\" className=\"flex flex-col gap-3\">\n                    {log.map((item) => (\n                        <Pill key={item.key} item={item} />\n                    ))}\n                </ul>\n            ) : null}\n\n            {active && current ? (\n                <>\n                    <h2 className=\"mt-[30px] text-ed-xl font-bold text-ed-text\">\n                        {current.label}\n                    </h2>\n                    <div className=\"mt-[18px] flex w-fit items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[10px] bg-msg-card px-4 py-3\">\n                        <span className=\"text-ed-md text-ed-text\">\n                            {node === null\n                                ? '正在启动'\n                                : `正在${labelOfNode(node)}`}\n                        </span>\n                        <Dots />\n                    </div>\n                </>\n            ) : null}\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n"

function SceneApproval({ run }: { run: UseAgentRun }) {
    const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<string[]>([]);

    // 分镜到了才初始化文案；用 key 重挂载更省事，但那样输入焦点会丢
    useEffect(() => {
        setScripts(run.scenes.map((scene) => scene.script));
    }, [run.scenes]);

    const changed = run.scenes.some(
        (scene, i) => scripts[i] !== undefined && scripts[i] !== scene.script
    );

    return (
        <section aria-label="确认分镜" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <h3 className="text-[19px] font-bold text-white">
                确认分镜（{run.scenes.length} 段）
            </h3>
            <ul className="flex max-h-[320px] flex-col gap-3 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-ed">
                {run.scenes.map((scene, index) => (
                    <li
                        key={`${scene.goal}-${index}`}
                        className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-cr-card-border p-3.5"
                    >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2">
                                分镜 {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ·{' '}
                                {scene.goal}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-ed-xs text-cr-placeholder">
                                {scene.visualIntent}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <textarea
                            aria-label={`分镜 ${index + 1} 文案`}
                            value={scripts[index] ?? ''}
                            onChange={(event) =>
                                setScripts((prev) => {
                                    const next = [...prev];
                                    next[index] = event.target.value;
                                    return next;
                                })
                            }
                            className="min-h-[64px] w-full resize-none bg-transparent text-ed-md leading-ed text-white caret-white outline-none"
                        />
                    </li>
                ))}
            </ul>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void run.approveScenes()}
                    className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white"
                >
                    就这样，继续
                </button>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!changed}
                    onClick={() => void run.approveScenes(scripts)}
                    className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                    用修改后的文案
                </button>
                {/* 改了文案却点了「就这样」，改动就白费了。
                    与其禁用，不如明确提示哪个按钮才是他想要的 */}
                {changed ? (
                    <span className="text-ed-sm text-[#F0B860]">
                        文案有改动，记得点右边那个
                    </span>
                ) : null}
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

function MatchApproval({ run }: { run: UseAgentRun }) {
    const [rejected, setRejected] = useState<number[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        setRejected([]);
    }, [run.matches]);

    const toggle = (index: number): void => {
        setRejected((prev) =>
            prev.includes(index)
                ? prev.filter((i) => i !== index)
                : [...prev, index]
        );
    };

    return (
        <section aria-label="确认素材" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <h3 className="text-[19px] font-bold text-white">确认素材匹配</h3>
            <ul className="flex max-h-80 flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-ed">
                {run.matches.map((match, index) => (
                    <li
                        key={`${match.goal}-${index}`}
                        className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-cr-card-border px-3.5 py-3"
                    >
                        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
                            <span className="text-ed-md text-white">
                                分镜 {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ·{' '}
                                {match.goal}
                            </span>
                            <span className="truncate text-ed-sm text-pj-text-2">
                                {match.abandoned
                                    ? '没有配上素材，已跳过'
                                    : (match.assetName ?? '未选中')}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        {match.abandoned ? null : (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                aria-pressed={rejected.includes(index)}
                                onClick={() => toggle(index)}
                                className={`h-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-lg border px-4 text-ed-sm ${
                                    rejected.includes(index)
                                        ? 'border-[#F06AB0] text-[#F06AB0]'
                                        : 'border-cr-card-border text-pj-text-2'
                                }`}
                            >
                                {rejected.includes(index)
                                    ? '已标记换一个'
                                    : '换一个'}
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </li>
                ))}
            </ul>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void run.approveMatches()}
                    className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-white"
                >
                    就这样，继续
                </button>
                <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={rejected.length === 0}
                    onClick={() => void run.approveMatches(rejected)}
                    className="flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] border border-cr-card-border px-6 text-ed-md text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                    重挑标记的 {rejected.length} 个
                </button>
            </div>
        </section>
    );
}

script={handoff.script}\n                    voiceId={handoff.voiceId}\n                    materialPaths={media.status?.paths ?? (\n                    <div className=\"mt-[30px] rounded-[14px] bg-msg-card p-[22px]\">\n                        <MatchApproval run={run} />\n                    </div>\n                ) : null}\n\n                {run.phase === 'failed' ? (\n                    <p className=\"mt-[30px] text-ed-lg text-ed-accent\">\n                        创作失败：{run.error}\n                    </p>\n                ) : null}\n\n                {run.phase === 'finished' ? (\n                    <div className=\"mt-[30px] flex items-center gap-3\">\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={onDone}\n                            className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-ed-text\"\n                        >\n                            去项目列表看看\n                        </button>\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={onBack}\n                            className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] border border-msg-border px-6 text-ed-md text-ed-text\"\n                        >\n                            再做一条\n                        </button>\n                    </div>\n                ) : null}\n\n                {!run.available ? (\n                    <p className=\"mt-[30px] text-ed-lg text-ed-text-3\">\n                        创作只能在桌面端运行\n                    </p>\n                ) : null}\n            </div>\n\n            <OutlineCard stages={stages} />\n        </main>\n    );\n}\n"

(\n                    <div className=\"mt-[30px] flex items-center gap-3\">\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={onDone}\n                            className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] bg-linear-to-r from-[#F06AB0] to-[#8A5CFF] px-6 text-ed-md font-bold text-ed-text\"\n                        >\n                            去项目列表看看\n                        </button>\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={onBack}\n                            className=\"flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-[10px] border border-msg-border px-6 text-ed-md text-ed-text\"\n                        >\n                            再做一条\n                        </button>\n                    </div>\n                ) : null}\n\n                {!run.available ? (\n                    <p className=\"mt-[30px] text-ed-lg text-ed-text-3\">\n                        创作只能在桌面端运行\n                    </p>\n                ) : null}\n            </div>\n\n            <OutlineCard stages={stages} />\n        </main>\n    );\n}\n"
}

// 渲染层实跑截图。用于 Pencil 闭环的第三段（代码 ↔ 设计稿一致性校验），
// 也用于任何 UI 改动的交付证据。
//
// 用法：
//   pnpm ui:shot --route=/editor --out=.ui-out/editor.png
//   pnpm ui:shot --route=/editor --out=.ui-out/rail.png --selector='nav[aria-label="素材类型"]'
//   pnpm ui:shot --route=/editor --out=.ui-out/a.png --width=1440 --height=620 --no-build
//
// 参数：
//   --route      hash 路由，默认 /
//   --out        输出 PNG 路径，默认 .ui-out/<route>.png
//   --width      窗口宽，默认 1920
//   --height     窗口高，默认 1094（与 magicut.pen 编辑器 frame 一致）
//   --selector   只截某个元素，CSS 选择器
//   --click      截图前先点击这个选择器，用于验证交互后的状态
//                多步交互用 ' >>> ' 分隔，按顺序点：--click='A >>> B'
//                执行顺序固定为 --fill → --click → --scroll
//   --clip       只截某块区域，格式 x,y,w,h
//   --scroll     截图前先滚动某个容器，格式 选择器@偏移，偏移写 end 表示滚到底
//                例：--scroll='aside[aria-label="音乐"] ul@end'
//   --fill       截图前给输入框灌值，格式 选择器@文本
//                例：--fill='textarea[aria-label="视频文稿"]@很多前端同学在焦虑一件事。'
//   --settle     首屏加载后等待毫秒数，默认 2000
//   --after      交互（fill/click/scroll）之后再等待毫秒数，默认 0。
//                页面里有动画或自动推进时用它等状态稳定
//   --no-build   复用上一次的构建产物，反复截图时用

import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const rootDir = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const desktopDir = path.join(rootDir, 'apps/desktop');
const buildDir = path.join(rootDir, '.ui-out/build');

const args = new Map(
    process.argv.slice(2).map((arg) => {
        const [key, ...rest] = arg.replace(/^--/, '').split('=');
        return [key, rest.length > 0 ? rest.join('=') : 'true'];
            '--emptyOutDir'
        ],
        { cwd: desktopDir, stdio: 'inherit' }
    );
}

execFileSync(
    'pnpm',
    [
        'exec',
        'electron',
        path.join(rootDir, 'scripts/ui-capture.cjs'),
        JSON.stringify({
            buildDir,
            route,
            out,
            clip,
            selector: args.get('selector') || null,
            click: args.get('click') || null,
            scroll,
            fill,
            width: Number.parseInt(args.get('width') || '1920', 10),
            height: Number.parseInt(args.get('height') || '1094', 10),
            // 写成 --after 3000（空格）时这里会拿到 'true'，兜一下避免静默变 NaN
            settleMs: Number.parseInt(args.get('settle') || '2000', 10) || 2000,
            afterMs: Number.parseInt(args.get('after') || '0', 10) || 0
        })
    ],
    { cwd: desktopDir, stdio: 'inherit' }
);

import { z } from 'zod';

import type { StructuredOutputMethod, ThinkingMode } from './types';
import { ModelProviderConfigError } from './types';

/**
 * LLM 配置。**一处都不写死**——端点、模型、策略、思考开关全部从环境变量读，
 * 同 plan.md §10 的原则。
 *
 * 凭证只在主进程读取，绝不进渲染进程。
 */

const methodSchema = z.enum(['functionCalling', 'jsonSchema', 'jsonMode']);

export const llmConfigSchema = z.object({
    provider: z.enum(['ark', 'mock']).default('mock'),
    baseUrl: z.string().url(),
    apiKey: z.string().min(1),
    model: z.string().min(1),
    /**
     * 策略候选，**有序**。第一个是首选，后面是降级目标。
     *
     * 默认首选 `jsonSchema` —— 这是实测结论：同一提示词各跑 6 次，
     * `jsonSchema` 6/6 成功，`functionCalling` 只有 1/6（plan.md §4.2.1）。
     * 原因是 LangChain 在单工具时会强制 `tool_choice`，而方舟在强制模式下
     * 经常返回空的 `tool_calls`。
     */
    methods: z
        .array(methodSchema)
        .min(1)
        .default(['jsonSchema', 'functionCalling']),
    thinking: z.enum(['disabled', 'enabled']).default('disabled'),
    /** 单次请求超时。多模态打标会慢一些，默认给足 */
    timeoutMs: z.int().positive().default(120_000),
    /** 瞬时错误（限流 / 5xx / 超时）的重试次数 */
    maxRetries: z.int().nonnegative().default(2)
});

export type LlmConfig = z.infer<typeof llmConfigSchema>;

/** mock provider 不需要凭证——没网络没 key 也要能跑通整条流水线 */
const MOCK_DEFAULTS = {
    baseUrl: 'http://mock.invalid',
    apiKey: 'mock',
    model: 'mock-model'
} as const;

function splitMethods(raw: string | undefined): string[] | undefined {
    if (!raw) return undefined;
    const parts = raw
        .split(/[,\s]+/)
        .map((p) => p.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts : undefined;
}

/**
 * 从环境变量装配配置。
 *
 * **在启动阶段校验一次**：缺项、格式错、策略名不认识，都要在这里就报清楚，
 * 而不是跑到第 9 个节点才崩。
 */
export function loadLlmConfig(
    env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env
): LlmConfig {
    const provider = env['LLM_PROVIDER'] ?? 'mock';
    const isMock = provider === 'mock';

    const raw = {
        provider,
        baseUrl:
            env['ARK_BASE_URL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.baseUrl : undefined),
        apiKey:
            env['ARK_API_KEY'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.apiKey : undefined),
        model: env['LLM_MODEL'] ?? (isMock ? MOCK_DEFAULTS.model : undefined),
        methods: splitMethods(env['LLM_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_METHOD']),
        thinking: env['LLM_THINKING'],
        timeoutMs: env['LLM_TIMEOUT_MS']
            ? Number(env['LLM_TIMEOUT_MS'])
            : undefined,

# ── 火山方舟（LLM） ──
ARK_BASE_URL=https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
«已打码»

# 默认 jsonSchema 优先：functionCalling 经由 LangChain 打方舟只有 1/6 成功率（§4.2.1）
LLM_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_METHOD=jsonSchema,functionCalling

# 结构化输出策略：functionCalling | jsonSchema | jsonMode（§4.5）
# 关闭思考。在 json_schema 路径上这是**真实的成本开关**（reasoning 325 → 0）；
# 在强制 tool calling 路径上它是 no-op（那条路本来就不产生 reasoning）。
# 需要模型真正推理的节点（ScenePlanner）可按请求单独打开。
LLM_THINKING=disabled
